en.understanding: This verse introduces Jesus as "the Word," a powerful idea for both Jews and Greeks at that time. It tells us that Jesus wasn't created; He has existed with God from the very beginning. John makes it absolutely clear: Jesus is not just a messenger *from* God, He fully *is* God.
en.livingItOut: Since Jesus is the eternal Word of God, His teachings are not just good suggestions; they are life-giving truth. When we read the Gospels, let's remember we are reading the very words of God Himself. This should inspire us to listen carefully and obey what He says with reverence and trust.
en.godsLove: Isn't it amazing that the eternal God did not want to remain a distant mystery? He revealed Himself to us personally through Jesus, the Word who became flesh. This shows God's deep desire to be known by us and to have a close relationship with us.
en.reflection: How does knowing that Jesus is fully God, and not just a good teacher, change the way you listen to His words and approach Him in prayer?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakilala sa talatang ito si Jesus bilang "ang Salita" o "the Word," na isang malalim na konsepto para sa mga Judio at Griyego noon. Sinasabi dito na hindi Siya nilikha; kasama na Niya ang Diyos mula pa sa simula. Malinaw ang punto ni John: si Jesus ay hindi lang *galing* sa Diyos, Siya mismo *ay* Diyos.
tl.livingItOut: Dahil si Jesus ang mismong Salita ng Diyos, ang Kanyang mga turo ay hindi lang magagandang payo—ito ay katotohanang nagbibigay-buhay. Kapag binabasa natin ang Bibliya, alalahanin nating salita mismo ng Diyos ang ating naririnig. Magsilbi sana itong inspirasyon para pakinggan natin Siya nang mabuti at sundin Siya nang may paggalang at tiwala.
tl.godsLove: Napakabuti ng Diyos dahil hindi Niya nais manatiling isang hiwaga sa atin. Ipinakilala Niya ang Kanyang sarili sa personal na paraan sa pamamagitan ni Jesus, ang Salitang naging tao. Pinapakita nito kung gaano Niya tayo kamahal at kung gaano Niya ninanais na makilala natin Siya nang malapitan.
tl.reflection: Paano binabago ng kaalaman na si Jesus ay Diyos (at hindi lang isang mabuting guro) ang paraan ng iyong pakikinig sa Kanyang mga salita at pakikipag-usap sa Kanya?

en.understanding: The opening of John's book, where this verse is found, reads like a beautiful song or poem used by the first Christians. It introduces us to the big ideas of the whole story that is about to unfold. It prepares our hearts to see Jesus as the Light who brings the gift of new life.
en.livingItOut: Just as this verse sets the stage for the story of Jesus, we can let Jesus set the tone for our day. When we start our morning with Him in prayer or by reading His Word, we invite the One who was there "in the beginning" to be at the center of our story today.
en.godsLove: God’s love for you was not a last-minute decision or a "Plan B." This verse shows us that Jesus, the ultimate expression of God's love, was with the Father from the very start. His plan to reach out to you in love is as old as eternity itself.
en.reflection: How does it give you confidence today to know that Jesus was part of God's loving plan for you before your life even began?

tl.understanding: Ang simula ng aklat ni John, kung saan galing ang talatang ito, ay parang isang magandang awit na kinakanta ng mga unang Kristiyano. Inihahanda nito ang ating mga puso para sa buong kwento ni Jesus. Ipinapakilala nito si Jesus bilang Ilaw na nagbibigay ng bagong buhay.
tl.livingItOut: Kung paanong inihanda ng talatang ito ang kwento ni Jesus, hayaan din nating si Jesus ang magtakda ng takbo ng ating araw. Kapag sinimulan natin ang umaga kasama Siya sa panalangin, inaanyayahan natin ang Diyos na Siyang "nasa simula pa" na maging sentro ng kwento natin ngayon.
tl.godsLove: Hindi "Plan B" o biglaang desisyon lang ng Diyos ang pagmamahal Niya sa iyo. Ipinapakita ng talatang ito na si Jesus, ang sukdulang patunay ng pag-ibig ng Diyos, ay kasama na ng Ama mula pa sa simula. Ang Kanyang plano na mahalin ka ay kasing-tanda na ng panahon.
tl.reflection: Paano nagbibigay sa iyo ng lakas ng loob ngayon ang kaalaman na si Jesus ay bahagi na ng mapagmahal na plano ng Diyos para sa'yo bago ka pa man isilang?

en.understanding: This verse reveals that Jesus is the Creator of everything we see. The Tyndale note highlights that because Jesus is God (the "Logos" or Word), His work in creation is God's own divine work in action. Nothing exists that He did not make.
en.livingItOut: When you feel overwhelmed, step outside and look at the sky or a simple flower. Remember that the same powerful Jesus who created the universe is also personally involved in the details of your life, and you can trust Him with it all.
en.godsLove: God's love is so deep that the very One who created the entire universe chose to step into it for our sake. The Creator became part of His creation, all to rescue us and bring us back to Himself. What an incredible, personal love!
en.reflection: In what area of your life do you need to be reminded that Jesus, the Creator of all things, has the power to work?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita sa talatang ito na si Jesus ang Lumikha ng lahat ng bagay. Sinasabi sa atin na dahil si Jesus ay Diyos (ang "Logos" o Salita), ang Kanyang paglikha sa sanlibutan ay gawa mismo ng Diyos. Walang anumang bagay na umiral na hindi Niya ginawa.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag feeling mo na-o-overwhelm ka, lumabas ka sandali at tumingin sa langit o sa isang bulaklak. Alalahanin mo na ang makapangyarihang Hesus na lumikha niyan ay Siya ring may pakialam sa bawat detalye ng buhay mo, kaya't maaari kang magtiwala sa Kanya.
tl.godsLove: Napakalalim ng pag-ibig ng Diyos; ang mismong Lumikha ng buong sanlibutan ay piniling pumasok dito para sa atin. Ang Creator ay naging bahagi ng Kanyang creation para iligtas tayo at ibalik sa Kanya. Ganyan ka-personal ang pagmamahal Niya sa'yo!
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon kailangan mong maalala na si Hesus, ang Lumikha ng lahat, ay may kapangyarihang kumilos?

en.understanding: This verse tells us that Jesus is the very source of life, going all the way back to creation. But He offers more than just physical life; He gives us a brand new spiritual life, which acts like a light to guide us out of darkness. Jesus is offering us a spiritual "re-creation" and a fresh start.
en.livingItOut: Because Jesus is our light, we don't have to walk around in spiritual darkness or confusion anymore. Let's allow His life to shine through our actions and decisions today. In moments of uncertainty, we can pause and ask, "Lord, what is the path of light here?"
en.godsLove: Isn't it amazing that God's love doesn't just rescue us *from* darkness, but gives us *something* beautiful—a new life? He loves us so much that He didn't want us to be lost. He sent Jesus to be our constant source of life and our guiding light home.
en.reflection: In what specific area of your life—a relationship, a decision, or a worry—do you need to invite the light of Jesus to shine today?

tl.understanding: Sinasabi rito na si Hesus mismo ang pinagmumulan ng buhay, mula pa noong umpisa ng paglikha. Pero higit pa sa pisikal na buhay, nag-aalok Siya ng isang bago at espirituwal na buhay. Ang buhay na ito ay parang ilaw na gumagabay sa atin para makaalis sa kadiliman.
tl.livingItOut: Dahil si Hesus ang ating ilaw, hindi na natin kailangang manatili sa kadiliman ng takot o pagkalito. Hayaan nating ang Kanyang liwanag ang maging gabay sa ating mga desisyon at pakikitungo sa iba ngayong araw. Sa mga pagkakataong hindi tayo sigurado, huminto tayo at manalangin, "Panginoon, ano po ang landas ng liwanag dito?"
tl.godsLove: Nakakamangha ang pag-ibig ng Diyos; hindi lang Niya tayo iniligtas *mula* sa kadiliman, kundi binigyan din Niya tayo *ng* isang napakagandang bagong buhay. Mahal na mahal Niya tayo at ayaw Niyang tayo'y maligaw, kaya isinugo Niya si Hesus upang maging ating buhay at liwanag na gabay.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng iyong buhay—sa isang relasyon, desisyon, o alalahanin—ang kailangan mong anyayahan ang liwanag ni Hesus na magbigay-gabay ngayon?

en.understanding: This verse is a powerful promise. The "darkness" wasn't just confused; it was actively hostile and tried to destroy Jesus, the Light. But no matter how hard it tried, it could never put out His light.
en.livingItOut: When you face your own 'dark' moments—like worry, sadness, or sin—remember this truth. Invite Jesus, the Light, into that situation, knowing that His presence is more powerful than any darkness you're facing.
en.godsLove: God's love is so great that He didn't abandon us to the darkness. He sent His own Son, Jesus, as a powerful, unstoppable Light to rescue us. This victory wasn't for Himself, but for you.
en.reflection: In what area of your life do you need to invite Jesus' unconquerable light to shine today?

tl.understanding: Ang talatang ito ay isang napakatibay na pangako. Ang 'kadiliman' dito ay hindi lang basta hindi nakaunawa; ito'y aktibong kumalaban at sinubukang wasakin si Hesus, ang Ilaw. Pero kahit anong gawin nito, hinding-hindi nito kayang patayin ang Kanyang liwanag.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag dumadaan ka sa mga 'madilim' na sandali—tulad ng pag-aalala, kalungkutan, o kasalanan—alalahanin mo ang katotohanang ito. Anyayahan mo si Hesus, ang Ilaw, sa sitwasyong iyan, dahil ang Kanyang presensya ay mas makapangyarihan kaysa anumang dilim na iyong hinaharap.
tl.godsLove: Napakadakila ng pag-ibig ng Diyos dahil hindi Niya tayo pinabayaan sa kadiliman. Ipinadala Niya ang Kanyang Anak, si Hesus, bilang isang makapangyarihan at di-mapipigilang Ilaw para iligtas tayo. Ang tagumpay na ito ay hindi para sa Kanya, kundi para sa iyo.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon kailangan mong anyayahan ang hindi matatalong liwanag ni Hesus?

en.understanding: The Gospel of John starts by preparing our hearts for Jesus' arrival. John the Baptist wasn't just a random person; he was a real man with a special mission directly from God. His entire purpose was to act as an announcer, getting people ready to meet the true Light of the World.
en.livingItOut: Just as God sent John with a purpose, He sends you with one, too. Your mission is to point others to Jesus in your own unique way, through your words and your actions. In your family, work, or community, be a signpost that lovingly leads people to Him.
en.godsLove: God's love is so thoughtful and detailed. He didn't just send His Son into the world unannounced; He first sent a messenger to prepare the way and get everyone's attention. He lovingly makes sure we have every opportunity to see and receive Jesus.
en.reflection: Who is one person in your life God might be asking you to gently point toward Jesus this week?

tl.understanding: Inihahanda tayo ng Ebanghelyo ni Juan para sa pagdating ni Jesus. Si Juan Bautista ay hindi lang basta kung sino; siya ay isang totoong tao na may espesyal na misyon mula mismo sa Diyos. Ang buong layunin niya ay maging tagapagpakilala, para ihanda ang mga tao na salubungin ang tunay na Ilaw ng sanlibutan.
tl.livingItOut: Kung paanong isinugo ng Diyos si Juan na may layunin, isinusugo ka rin Niya na may purpose. Ang misyon mo ay ituro sa iba ang daan patungo kay Jesus sa iyong sariling paraan, sa salita at sa gawa. Sa iyong pamilya, trabaho, o komunidad, maging isang "signpost" ka na nagtuturo sa mga tao kung nasaan si Kristo.
tl.godsLove: Napaka-maalalahanin at detalyado ng pag-ibig ng Diyos. Hindi Niya basta na lang isinugo ang Kanyang Anak; nagpadala muna Siya ng mensahero para ihanda ang daan at makuha ang ating atensyon. Tinitiyak Niyang mayroon tayong lahat ng pagkakataon na makita at tanggapin si Jesus.
tl.reflection: Sino ang isang tao sa buhay mo na marahil ay nais ng Diyos na dahan-dahan mong ituro patungo kay Jesus sa linggong ito?

en.understanding: The beginning of John's gospel is like a beautiful song about Jesus being the Light of the world. In this verse, John the Baptist isn't the Light himself, but he's like a spotlight operator. His whole purpose was to point everyone to the main star—Jesus—so they could believe in Him.
en.livingItOut: Like John the Baptist, our lives are meant to point others to Jesus. We don't have to be the source of light, but we can reflect His light to our family, friends, and co-workers through our kindness and our story. Let your life be a sign that points to Him.
en.godsLove: God’s love is so great that He didn't just send the Light; He also sent a messenger to make sure we wouldn't miss it! He loves people so much that He makes the way clear for them to find Jesus and believe. He truly desires for everyone to come to Him.
en.reflection: In what simple way can my life serve as a "spotlight," pointing someone I know toward the love and light of Jesus this week?

tl.understanding: Ang simula ng aklat ni Juan ay parang isang magandang awit tungkol kay Hesus bilang Ilaw ng sanlibutan. Sa talatang ito, si John the Baptist ay hindi ang Ilaw, pero siya ay parang taga-hawak ng spotlight. Ang tanging layunin niya ay ituro ang lahat sa tunay na Bida—si Hesus—upang sila ay maniwala.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni John the Baptist, ang buhay natin ay dapat maging direksyon na nagtuturo sa iba papunta kay Hesus. Hindi kailangang tayo ang maging ilaw, pero kaya nating ipakita ang Kanyang liwanag sa ating pamilya, kaibigan, at katrabaho sa pamamagitan ng ating kabaitan at kwento. Hayaan mong maging sign post ang buhay mo patungo sa Kanya.
tl.godsLove: Napakadakila ng pag-ibig ng Diyos; hindi lang Niya ipinadala ang Ilaw, nagpadala pa Siya ng mensahero para siguradohing makikita natin ito! Mahal na mahal Niya ang mga tao kaya ginagawa Niyang malinaw ang daan para matagpuan nila si Hesus at manampalataya.
tl.reflection: Sa anong simpleng paraan pwedeng maging "spotlight" ang buhay ko para maituro ang isang kakilala ko sa pag-ibig at liwanag ni Hesus ngayong linggo?

en.understanding: This verse makes it clear that John the Baptist was not the Messiah, even though some people thought he was. His God-given role was incredibly important: to be a witness who pointed everyone to Jesus, the one true Light. John was the signpost, but Jesus was the destination.
en.livingItOut: Like John, our lives have a beautiful purpose: to point others to Jesus. Instead of seeking attention for ourselves, let's use our words and actions to show others how wonderful He is. Our lives can be a testimony that directs people to the real source of hope and salvation.
en.godsLove: God's love is so thoughtful. He didn't just send Jesus into the world; He lovingly sent a messenger first to prepare everyone's hearts. This shows how much He wants us to find and know Jesus, the true Light of our lives.
en.reflection: In what small way can your life be a signpost that points someone toward Jesus's love and light this week?

tl.understanding: Nililinaw ng talatang ito na si John the Baptist ay hindi ang Tagapagligtas, kahit iyon ang akala ng iba. Napakahalaga ng kanyang misyon mula sa Diyos: ang maging saksi na nagtuturo sa lahat patungo kay Hesus, ang tunay na Ilaw. Si John ang "signpost," pero si Hesus ang destinasyon.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ni John, may magandang misyon din ang buhay natin: ang ituro ang iba kay Hesus. Sa halip na tayo ang maging bida, gamitin natin ang ating salita at gawa para ipakita sa iba kung gaano kabuti ang Panginoon. Ang buhay natin ay pwedeng maging patotoo na nagdidirekta sa mga tao sa tunay na pag-asa.
tl.godsLove: Napakamaalalahanin ng pag-ibig ng Diyos. Hindi Niya lang basta isinugo si Hesus; nagpadala muna Siya ng mensahero para ihanda ang puso ng lahat. Pinapakita nito kung gaano Niya ninanais na makilala natin si Hesus, ang tunay na Ilaw ng ating buhay.
tl.reflection: Sa anong maliit na paraan pwedeng maging isang "signpost" ang buhay mo para maituro ang isang tao sa pag-ibig at liwanag ni Hesus ngayong linggo?

en.understanding: The first few verses of John's Gospel act like an introduction, setting the stage for Jesus's life story. This specific verse introduces the main character, Jesus, as the "true Light." He is the real deal, coming into our dark world to shine His truth and life on every single person.
en.livingItOut: Since Jesus, the true Light, has come, we don't have to live in the darkness of confusion or fear. Today, choose to walk in His light by making choices that honor Him and bring His truth into your situations. Don't hide from Him; run to His light!
en.godsLove: God's love is so immense that He didn't leave us alone in our darkness. He sent His one and only Son, Jesus, as a brilliant Light to guide us, show us the truth, and lead us back to Him. He lovingly pursues us and wants no one to be lost.
en.reflection: Is there any area of your life that you are keeping in the dark, where you need to invite Jesus, the true Light, to shine today?

tl.understanding: Ang mga unang talata sa aklat ni Juan ay parang isang introduction, na inihahanda tayo sa kwento ng buhay ni Hesus. Ipinapakilala ng talatang ito ang bida, si Hesus, bilang ang "tunay na Ilaw" na dumating para bigyang-liwanag ang lahat ng tao.
tl.livingItOut: Dahil dumating na si Hesus, ang tunay na Ilaw, hindi na natin kailangang mamuhay sa dilim ng pagkalito o takot. Ngayon, piliin mong lumakad sa Kanyang liwanag sa pamamagitan ng paggawa ng mga desisyon na nagpaparangal sa Kanya. Huwag kang magtago; tumakbo ka palapit sa Kanyang liwanag!
tl.godsLove: Napakalaki ng pag-ibig ng Diyos kaya't hindi Niya tayo hinayaang mag-isa sa dilim. Isinugo Niya ang Kanyang bugtong na Anak, si Hesus, bilang isang maningning na Ilaw para gabayan tayo, ipakita ang katotohanan, at ibalik tayo sa Kanya.
tl.reflection: Mayroon bang bahagi ng buhay mo na itinatago mo pa rin sa dilim, kung saan kailangan mong anyayahan si Hesus, ang tunay na Ilaw, para magbigay-liwanag ngayon?

en.understanding: This verse highlights a sad truth: Jesus, the Creator, came to the very world He made, but people didn't know who He was. This happened because humanity, caught in sin, preferred living in spiritual darkness rather than accepting His truth and light.
en.livingItOut: It’s easy for us to get busy and overlook Jesus in our daily lives, just like the world did. Let’s make it a habit to intentionally look for Him and acknowledge His presence—in our family, our work, and even in our challenges.
en.godsLove: God’s love is so amazing here. Even though He knew the world He created would not recognize Him, His love was so great that He came anyway. He didn't wait for us to be perfect; He stepped into our darkness to bring us His light.
en.reflection: In what area of my life today might I be overlooking Jesus' presence, and how can I intentionally recognize Him there?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita ng talatang ito ang isang malungkot na katotohanan: si Hesus na Siyang lumikha ng lahat ay pumarito sa mundo, pero hindi Siya nakilala ng mga tao. Nangyari ito dahil mas pinili ng mundong nabubuhay sa kasalanan ang kadiliman kaysa sa liwanag at katotohanan na dala Niya.
tl.livingItOut: Minsan, sa sobrang abala natin, hindi natin napapansin si Hesus sa ating buhay. Sikapin nating hanapin at kilalanin Siya araw-araw—sa ating pamilya, trabaho, at kahit sa gitna ng mga problema.
tl.godsLove: Kahanga-hanga ang pag-ibig ng Diyos dito. Kahit alam Niyang hindi Siya kikilalanin ng mundong Kanyang nilikha, pumarito pa rin Siya para sa atin. Siya ang kusang lumapit para ihatid ang Kanyang liwanag sa ating kadiliman.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay ko ngayon ang maaaring hindi ko napapansin ang pagkilos ni Hesus, at paano ko Siya mas kikilalanin pa sa araw na ito?

en.understanding: This verse introduces a key theme in the story of Jesus: He is the light who came into the world He created. Sadly, the very people He came to save, His own people, did not recognize or welcome Him.
en.livingItOut: This is a powerful reminder to check our own hearts each day. Let's make sure we are not too busy or distracted to "receive" Jesus, actively welcoming His presence and listening to His Word.
en.godsLove: God's love is so incredible here. He knew that Jesus would be rejected, yet His love was so great that He sent Him anyway. He came for us, knowing the pain He would face, all for the chance that we would believe.
en.reflection: In what specific area of your life do you need to more fully welcome Jesus' presence and guidance today?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita ng talatang ito ang isang mahalagang tema: si Hesus, ang ilaw ng mundo, ay pumarito sa Kanyang sariling bayan. Nakakalungkot lang na ang mga taong dapat sana'y unang tatanggap sa Kanya ay hindi Siya kinilala o tinanggap.
tl.livingItOut: Paalala ito na suriin natin ang ating mga puso araw-araw. Siguraduhin nating hindi tayo masyadong abala para tanggapin si Hesus, at sadyain nating i-welcome ang Kanyang presensya at pakinggan ang Kanyang Salita.
tl.godsLove: Kahanga-hanga ang pag-ibig ng Diyos dito. Alam Niyang itatakwil Siya ng Kanyang sariling bayan, pero dahil sa laki ng pagmamahal Niya, isinugo pa rin Niya si Hesus. Dumating Siya para sa atin, kahit alam Niya ang sakit na haharapin, para lang may pagkakataon tayong sumampalataya.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon ang kailangan mong mas bukas-palad na tanggapin ang presensya at gabay ni Hesus?

en.understanding: This verse tells us that becoming a child of God isn't something we can earn or achieve on our own. It's a spiritual rebirth, a gift God gives us the moment we personally choose to believe in Jesus. Our faith is the key that unlocks the door to His family.
en.livingItOut: Today, let's live like the beloved children we are. This means actively trusting Jesus with our daily worries and decisions, not just relying on our own strength. We express our belief by talking to Him throughout the day and choosing to follow His ways.
en.godsLove: God's love is so personal that He doesn't just call us followers; He calls us family. He joyfully gives us the right to become His own children, showing His incredible heart that longs for a close relationship with you and me.
en.reflection: In what specific area of your life today can you more fully live in the confidence and joy of being God's beloved child?

tl.understanding: Sinasabi rito na ang pagiging anak ng Diyos ay hindi natin kayang pagtrabahuhan o abutin sa sariling sikap. Ito ay isang espirituwal na pagbabago, isang regalong ibinibigay ng Diyos sa sandaling personal nating piliing maniwala kay Hesus. Ang ating pananampalataya ang nagsisilbing susi para mapabilang sa Kanyang pamilya.
tl.livingItOut: Ngayong araw, mamuhay tayo bilang mga minamahal na anak ng Diyos. Ibig sabihin, aktibo nating ipagkatiwala kay Hesus ang ating mga alalahanin at desisyon, sa halip na umasa lang sa sarili nating lakas. Naipapakita natin ang ating pananampalataya sa pakikipag-usap sa Kanya at sa pagsunod sa Kanyang kalooban.
tl.godsLove: Napakapersonal ng pag-ibig ng Diyos; hindi lang Niya tayo tinatawag na tagasunod, kundi Kanyang pamilya. Buong galak Niyang ibinibigay sa atin ang karapatang maging Kanyang mga anak, na nagpapakita ng Kanyang pusong naghahangad ng malapit na relasyon sa iyo at sa akin.
tl.reflection: Sa anong partikular na bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon ka maaaring mamuhay nang may buong kumpiyansa at galak bilang minamahal na anak ng Diyos?

en.understanding: This verse reminds us that becoming a child of God isn't based on our family background or our own efforts. It is a miracle given by God Himself. Through His grace, He gives us a new spiritual birth, bringing us out of darkness and into His light.
en.livingItOut: Today, let's release the pressure to be "good enough" for God. Instead of trying to earn His love, we can rest and simply live like the dearly loved child of God that we already are.
en.godsLove: Isn't it amazing that God does all the work to welcome us into His family? His love is so unconditional that He doesn't look at our human abilities or status. He freely gives us a new identity and a new life in Him.
en.reflection: How does knowing your new life is a gift from God, not your own achievement, change how you face your challenges today?

tl.understanding: Sinasabi dito na ang pagiging anak ng Diyos ay hindi dahil sa ating lahi o sariling pagsisikap. Ito ay isang himala na galing mismo sa Diyos. Sa pamamagitan ng Kanyang biyaya, binibigyan Niya tayo ng bagong kapanganakan para ilabas tayo sa kadiliman at dalhin sa Kanyang liwanag.
tl.livingItOut: Ngayong araw, bitawan natin ang pressure na kailangang maging "sapat" para sa Diyos. Sa halip na paghirapang makuha ang pag-ibig Niya, mamuhay na lang tayo bilang minamahal Niyang anak, dahil iyon na talaga ang katayuan natin sa Kanya.
tl.godsLove: Hindi ba't kahanga-hanga na ang Diyos mismo ang gumawa ng lahat para mapabilang tayo sa Kanyang pamilya? Hindi Niya tinitingnan ang ating kakayahan o estado sa buhay. Ang bagong buhay na ito ay Kanyang regalo dahil sa laki ng pagmamahal Niya sa atin.
tl.reflection: Paano binabago ng kaalaman na ang iyong bagong buhay ay regalo mula sa Diyos, at hindi mo ito pinaghirapan, ang paraan ng pagharap mo sa mga hamon ngayon?

en.understanding: This verse tells us something amazing: God the Son, who is the Word, became a real human being in Jesus. He didn't just visit from far away; He "pitched His tent" and lived right here with us. This is like how God's glorious presence filled the Tabernacle in the Old Testament, but now, that glory lives in a person we can know and love.
en.livingItOut: Since Jesus came down to be present with us, let's also be truly present for the people in our lives. We can put down our phones, listen with our whole heart, and show God’s love in practical ways. Let's be the hands and feet of Jesus to someone who needs to feel that God is near.
en.godsLove: God's love is so personal that He didn't want to stay distant. He closed the gap between heaven and earth by becoming one of us in Jesus. He chose to experience our world, our joys, and our pains, all to show us how deeply He cares for us.
en.reflection: How does knowing that Jesus chose to live a real human life, right here among us, change the way you see your own daily struggles and joys?

tl.understanding: Isang kamangha-manghang bagay ang sinasabi ng talatang ito: Ang Salita (si Jesus) ay naging isang totoong tao. Hindi lang Siya bumisita, kundi "nagtayo Siya ng Kanyang tolda" para manirahang kasama natin. Ito ay tulad ng paninirahan ng kaluwalhatian ng Diyos sa Tabernakulo noon, pero ngayon, nasa katauhan na ni Jesus.
tl.livingItOut: Dahil si Jesus ay bumaba para makasama tayo, sikapin din nating maging "present" sa buhay ng mga tao sa paligid natin. Ibaba muna natin ang ating mga cellphone, makinig nang buong puso, at ipakita ang pag-ibig ng Diyos sa mga simpleng paraan. Tayo ang maging kamay at paa ni Jesus para sa mga taong kailangang maramdaman na malapit ang Diyos.
tl.godsLove: Napakalalim ng pag-ibig ng Diyos kaya hindi Siya nanatili sa malayo. Pinili Niyang maging tulad natin sa pamamagitan ni Jesus para maranasan Niya ang ating mundo, ang ating saya at sakit. Ganyan na lang Niya tayo kamahal.
tl.reflection: Paano binabago ng kaalaman na pinili ni Jesus na mamuhay bilang tao—dito mismo kasama natin—ang pagtingin mo sa iyong pang-araw-araw na mga pagsubok at kagalakan?

en.understanding: John the Baptist makes a powerful statement here. In their culture, older people were highly respected, so by saying Jesus "was before me," John wasn't talking about their age on earth. He was declaring that Jesus is eternal and has existed forever, giving Him the ultimate honor.
en.livingItOut: Like John, let's make our lives point to Jesus, not ourselves. In our successes, our conversations, and even our social media posts, let's find ways to give Him the credit and honor He deserves. Our goal is to make Him known.
en.godsLove: Isn't it amazing that the eternal God, who existed before all things, chose to come to earth for us? His love is so great that He humbled Himself to become a man, stepping into the world He created. He did this to draw near to you.
en.reflection: In what specific area of my life this week can I decrease, so that Jesus can increase and receive more honor?

tl.understanding: Napakalakas ng pahayag dito ni Juan Bautista. Sa kanilang kultura, mataas ang respeto sa mga nakatatanda, kaya nang sabihin niyang si Jesus ay "nauna sa akin," hindi niya tinutukoy ang edad nila sa mundo. Pinapahayag niya na si Jesus ay walang hanggan at laging nariyan, kaya binibigay niya ang pinakamataas na karangalan sa Kanya.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ni Juan, gawin nating taga-turo kay Hesus ang ating buhay, hindi sa ating sarili. Sa ating mga tagumpay, pakikipag-usap, at kahit sa ating mga social media post, hanapin natin ang mga paraan para ibigay sa Kanya ang papuri at karangalang nararapat. Ang layunin natin ay ipakilala Siya.
tl.godsLove: Hindi ba't kamangha-mangha na ang Diyos na walang hanggan, na umiiral bago pa ang lahat, ay piniling bumaba sa lupa para sa atin? Napakadakila ng Kanyang pag-ibig na nagpakumbaba Siya para maging tao at pumasok sa mundong Kanyang nilikha. Ginawa Niya ito para mapalapit sa'yo.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay ko ngayong linggo ako pwedeng magpakumbaba, para si Hesus naman ang maitaas at mabigyan ng karangalan?

en.understanding: This beautiful verse is part of what many believe was an early Christian worship song about Jesus. It’s a powerful line celebrating that because of Jesus, God’s grace is not just a one-time gift. It is an endless, overflowing supply that we receive from His fullness every single day.
en.livingItOut: When you feel spiritually empty or you make a mistake, remember that God's grace for you has not run out. Instead of trying harder in your own strength, simply go to Him and receive His fresh forgiveness and help. His supply of grace is new every morning.
en.godsLove: This shows us a God who is incredibly generous and never holds back His goodness. His heart is not stingy; it's a deep well of love that constantly overflows for you. He delights in pouring out His favor, not because we deserve it, but because giving is His nature.
en.reflection: In what area of your life do you need to stop striving and start receiving God's fresh supply of "grace upon grace" today?

tl.understanding: Ang magandang talatang ito ay bahagi ng isang posibleng sinaunang awit ng pagsamba para kay Hesus. Isa itong malakas na pahayag na dahil sa Kanya, ang biyaya ng Diyos ay hindi lang minsanang regalo. Ito ay isang walang katapusan at saganang supply na natatanggap natin mula sa Kanya araw-araw.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag pakiramdam mo ay mahina ka sa spiritual o kapag nagkamali ka, tandaan mong hindi nauubos ang biyaya ng Diyos para sa'yo. Sa halip na magsumikap sa sarili mong lakas, lumapit ka lang sa Kanya at tanggapin ang panibagong kapatawaran at tulong. Ang Kanyang biyaya ay laging bago tuwing umaga.
tl.godsLove: Pinapakita nito na ang Diyos ay sobrang galante at hindi nagdadamot ng Kanyang kabutihan. Ang puso Niya ay hindi kuripot; ito ay isang malalim na balon ng pag-ibig na laging umaapaw para sa iyo. Nagagalak Siyang ibuhos ang Kanyang pabor, hindi dahil karapat-dapat tayo, kundi dahil likas sa Kanya ang pagiging mapagbigay.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo kailangang tumigil sa pagsisikap sa sarili mong lakas, at simulang tanggapin ang panibagong supply ng "biyaya sa ibabaw ng biyaya" ng Diyos ngayon?

en.understanding: The law God gave through Moses was good and pointed everyone to Him. But it was like seeing a preview; in Jesus, we see the full and complete picture of God's grace and truth. The Old Testament hinted at God's love, but Jesus is the full expression of it.
en.livingItOut: Instead of trying to earn God's favor by perfectly following rules, we can rest in our relationship with Jesus. Let's focus on knowing Him more each day, because that's where true grace and life are found. Your walk with God is a relationship, not just a performance.
en.godsLove: God's love is so personal. He didn't just send a rulebook from heaven; He sent Himself in the person of Jesus to walk with us. This shows us He desires a real relationship with you, not just religious obedience.
en.reflection: In what area of your life do you need to stop relying on your own efforts and instead receive the grace that Jesus offers?

tl.understanding: Ang Kautusan na binigay ng Diyos kay Moses ay mabuti at nagtuturo sa mga tao patungkol sa Kanya. Pero para itong isang preview lang; kay Hesus, nakita natin ang buo at kumpletong larawan ng biyaya at katotohanan ng Diyos. Ipinahiwatig ng Lumang Tipan ang pag-ibig Niya, pero si Hesus ang kabuuan nito.
tl.livingItOut: Sa halip na piliting makuha ang pabor ng Diyos sa pagsunod sa mga rules, maaari tayong magpahinga sa ating relasyon kay Hesus. Mas pagtuunan natin ng pansin na kilalanin Siya araw-araw, dahil doon natin matatagpuan ang tunay na biyaya at buhay. Ang iyong spiritual life ay isang relasyon, hindi lang isang performance.
tl.godsLove: Napakapersonal ng pag-ibig ng Diyos. Hindi lang Siya nagpadala ng isang rulebook mula sa langit; ipinadala Niya ang Kanyang sarili sa katauhan ni Hesus para samahan tayo. Ipinapakita nito na ang nais Niya ay isang tunay na relasyon sa'yo, hindi lang basta pagsunod sa relihiyon.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo kailangan mong itigil ang pag-asa sa sarili mong pagsisikap, at sa halip ay tanggapin ang biyayang inaalok ni Hesus?

en.understanding: No one has ever fully seen God the Father, not even great prophets like Moses. But because Jesus is God Himself and is always with the Father, He is the perfect one to show us exactly who God is. Jesus isn't just a messenger; He is the message in person.
en.livingItOut: If you ever wonder what God the Father is like, look at Jesus. Read the stories of how He treated people, how He taught, and how He loved—that’s how you get to know the heart of the Father. To know Jesus is to know God.
en.godsLove: God doesn't want to be a distant, unknown mystery to us. In His great love, He sent His own Son, Jesus, to be the living, breathing picture of who He is. He made Himself knowable and approachable for you and me.
en.reflection: As you think about Jesus's life and actions, what is one quality of God the Father that becomes clearer and more personal to you?

tl.understanding: Walang sinuman ang lubusang nakakita sa Diyos Ama, kahit pa si Moses. Ngunit dahil si Jesus mismo ay Diyos at laging kapiling ng Ama, Siya ang perpektong nagpakilala sa atin kung sino talaga ang Diyos. Si Jesus ay hindi lang tagapagdala ng mensahe; Siya mismo ang Mensahe.
tl.livingItOut: Kung nagtatanong ka kung ano ba ang ugali ng Diyos Ama, tingnan mo lang si Jesus. Basahin mo ang mga kwento kung paano Niya tinrato ang mga tao, nagturo, at nagmahal—diyan mo lubos na makikilala ang puso ng Ama. Ang pagkakilala kay Jesus ay pagkakilala sa Diyos.
tl.godsLove: Hindi nais ng Diyos na manatiling isang malayong misteryo sa atin. Sa Kanyang dakilang pag-ibig, isinugo Niya ang Kanyang Anak na si Jesus upang maging buhay na larawan ng kung sino Siya. Ginawa Niyang posible na Siya'y ating makilala at malapitan.
tl.reflection: Sa pagninilay mo sa buhay at mga gawa ni Jesus, anong isang katangian ng Diyos Ama ang nagiging mas malinaw at personal para sa'yo?

en.understanding: This verse begins the public story of people trying to figure out who Jesus is. As Jesus revealed Himself through His words and actions, people had to choose: either believe in Him or reject Him. John the Baptist's testimony was the official start of this great introduction to the world.
en.livingItOut: Just like the people back then, we too must decide who Jesus is to us. Let's not just be passive listeners; let's actively choose to follow Him every day in our thoughts and actions. Our lives can be our own "testimony" that points others to Him.
en.godsLove: Isn't it amazing that God doesn't force us to follow Him? He lovingly introduces Jesus to the world and invites us into a relationship, giving us the honor of choosing Him for ourselves. His love respects our freedom and patiently waits for us to respond.
en.reflection: When people look at my life, what is the "testimony" they see about who Jesus is to me?

tl.understanding: Dito nagsisimula ang kwento ng pagpapakilala ni Jesus sa mundo. Habang ipinapakita Niya kung sino Siya, kailangang mamili ng mga tao: maniniwala ba sila o hindi? Ang testimonya ni John ang naging hudyat para simulan ang pagpapakilalang ito.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ng mga tao noon, bawat isa sa atin ay kailangang magpasya kung sino si Jesus sa buhay natin. Huwag lang tayong basta makinig; piliin nating sundin Siya araw-araw sa ating isip, salita, at gawa. Ang ating buhay ang nagiging testimonya natin para sa Kanya.
tl.godsLove: Kaybuti ng Diyos dahil hindi Niya tayo pinipilit na maniwala. Sa halip, buong pagmamahal Niyang ipinakilala si Jesus sa atin at binigyan tayo ng kalayaang piliin Siya. Ang pag-ibig Niya ay magalang at matiyagang naghihintay sa pagtugon ng ating puso.
tl.reflection: Kapag tiningnan ng mga tao ang buhay ko, anong "testimonya" ang nakikita nila tungkol sa kung sino si Jesus para sa akin?

en.understanding: At that time, the Jewish people were eagerly waiting for their promised Savior, whom they called the "Messiah" or the "Christ." John the Baptist's powerful ministry made many wonder if he was this long-awaited leader. But John quickly and humbly made it clear that he was not the one.
en.livingItOut: Like John, let's be clear about our role: it's not about us, it's about Jesus. In our successes or when people praise us, let's humbly point the attention and glory back to Him. Our lives should be a sign that leads everyone to Christ.
en.godsLove: God's loving plan for our salvation was so perfect that He sent a messenger to prepare our hearts for Jesus. John's humility shows God's careful design to make sure we wouldn't miss our true Savior. He lovingly paves the way for us to meet Him.
en.reflection: In what area of my life can I step back so that Jesus can step forward and receive more glory?

tl.understanding: Noong panahong iyon, sabik na naghihintay ang mga Judio sa kanilang Tagapagligtas, na tinatawag nilang "Messiah" o "Kristo." Dahil sa lakas ng ministeryo ni Juan Bautista, inakala ng marami na siya na ang hinihintay nila. Ngunit buong-kababaang-loob at malinaw niyang sinabi na hindi siya ang Kristo.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ni Juan, maging malinaw sana tayo sa ating papel: hindi ito tungkol sa atin, kundi tungkol kay Hesus. Sa ating mga tagumpay o kapag pinupuri tayo, ibalik natin ang papuri at atensyon sa Kanya. Nawa'y ang buhay natin ay maging isang sign na nagtuturo sa lahat patungo kay Kristo.
tl.godsLove: Napakaganda ng plano ng Diyos para sa ating kaligtasan; nagpadala Siya ng mensahero para ihanda ang puso natin para kay Hesus. Ang pagsunod ni Juan ay nagpapakita ng maingat na pagmamahal ng Diyos para masiguro na hindi natin palalampasin ang ating tunay na Tagapagligtas. Buong pagmamahal Niyang inihahanda ang daan para makilala natin Siya.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay ko ako pwedeng magpakumbaba para si Hesus naman ang mas makilala at mabigyan ng papuri?

en.understanding: People at that time expected the great prophet Elijah to return before the Messiah arrived, based on prophecy. John the Baptist was fulfilling that special role, but he humbly said "no" to being Elijah himself. He knew his mission was not to become famous, but to point everyone to Jesus.
en.livingItOut: Like John, we can live a life that points others to Jesus, not to ourselves. When we are praised for our skills or achievements, let's use it as a chance to give the glory back to God. Our purpose is to make Jesus known, not to make our own name great.
en.godsLove: God's love is so thoughtful that He sent a messenger to prepare the way for Jesus. He didn't want people to miss His arrival, showing His deep desire for everyone to know His Son. This reveals a God who lovingly plans every detail for our salvation.
en.reflection: In what specific area of my life can I be more like John the Baptist, pointing others to Jesus instead of seeking praise for myself?

tl.understanding: Inaasahan ng mga tao noon na babalik ang sikat na propetang si Elijah bago dumating ang Mesiyas. Kahit na si John the Baptist ang tumupad sa role na iyon, mapagkumbaba niyang sinabing hindi siya si Elijah. Alam niyang ang misyon niya ay ituro ang lahat kay Hesus, hindi para sumikat siya.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni John, mamuhay tayo sa paraang nagtuturo sa iba patungo kay Hesus, hindi sa ating sarili. Kapag pinupuri tayo sa ating mga talento o nagawa, gamitin natin itong pagkakataon para ibalik ang papuri sa Diyos. Ang layunin natin ay ipakilala si Hesus, hindi ang pasikatin ang ating pangalan.
tl.godsLove: Napakamaalalahanin ng pag-ibig ng Diyos dahil nagpadala Siya ng mensahero para ihanda ang daan para kay Hesus. Ayaw Niyang may makaligtaan sa pagdating ni Kristo, na nagpapakita ng Kanyang pagnanais na makilala natin ang Kanyang Anak. Ipinapakita nito ang isang Diyos na buong pagmamahal na pinaplano ang bawat detalye para sa ating kaligtasan.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay ko ako pwedeng maging mas katulad ni John the Baptist—na nagtuturo sa iba patungo kay Hesus sa halip na naghahanap ng papuri para sa sarili?

en.understanding: This question, "Who are you?", sets the stage for the whole story of Jesus. As Jesus revealed Himself through His words and miracles, people had to choose a side: either believe in Him or oppose Him. Everyone, then and now, has to decide where they stand with Jesus.
en.livingItOut: Just like the people back then, we too must answer the question: Who is Jesus to us? Let's not just be observers in our faith, but actively decide to place our trust in Him as our Lord and Savior every single day.
en.godsLove: God's love is so patient. He doesn't force us to believe, but He consistently reveals Himself and invites us into a personal relationship. His greatest desire is for us to truly know Him and choose to walk with Him.
en.reflection: If someone asked you today, "Who is Jesus to you?", what personal story or reason would you share to explain your answer?

tl.understanding: Ang tanong na "Sino ka?", ay ang simula ng buong kwento ni Hesus. Habang ipinapakilala ni Hesus ang Kanyang sarili sa pamamagitan ng mga salita at himala, kailangang pumili ng mga tao: maniniwala ba sila o sasalungatin Siya. Lahat tayo ay kailangang magdesisyon kung sino si Hesus sa buhay natin.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ng mga tao noon, kailangan din nating sagutin ang tanong: Sino nga ba si Hesus para sa atin? Huwag lang tayong maging tagapanood; piliin nating ilagay ang ating tiwala sa Kanya bilang ating Panginoon at Tagapagligtas sa bawat araw.
tl.godsLove: Napakatiyaga ng pag-ibig ng Diyos. Hindi Niya tayo pinipilit maniwala, pero patuloy Siyang nagpapakilala at nag-aanyaya sa atin na magkaroon ng personal na relasyon sa Kanya. Ang pinakadakilang nais Niya ay makilala natin Siya at piliing sumunod sa Kanya.
tl.reflection: Kung may magtanong sa'yo ngayon, "Sino si Hesus para sa'yo?", anong personal na kwento o dahilan ang ibabahagi mo para ipaliwanag ang iyong sagot?

en.understanding: John the Baptist's job was to introduce Jesus to the world. As Jesus began His ministry with amazing miracles and teachings, people had to make a choice: to believe in Him or to oppose Him. This is a central theme in the book of John.
en.livingItOut: Just like the people in Jesus' time, we are also presented with a choice to believe in Him. We can't stay on the fence; we are invited to actively choose to follow Jesus not just once, but in our daily decisions.
en.godsLove: God's love is so respectful that He doesn't force us to believe. He reveals Himself through His Son, Jesus, and patiently invites us into a relationship with Him, giving us the freedom to choose.
en.reflection: In the small and big moments of your day, how are you actively choosing to believe in and follow Jesus?

tl.understanding: Ang gawain ni Juan na Tagapagbautismo ay ang ihanda ang daan para kay Hesus. Nang si Hesus ay nagsimula na sa Kanyang mga himala at turo, ang mga tao ay nahati at kinailangang pumili: maniniwala ba sila o kokontrahin Siya. Ito ay isang mahalagang tema sa buong aklat ni Juan.
tl.livingItOut: Katulad ng mga tao noong panahon ni Hesus, tayo rin ay may pagpipilian kung mananampalataya tayo sa Kanya. Hindi tayo pwedeng manatili sa gitna lang; inaanyayahan tayong aktibong piliin na sumunod kay Hesus, hindi lang minsan kundi sa araw-araw nating mga desisyon.
tl.godsLove: Napakagalang ng pag-ibig ng Diyos dahil hindi Niya tayo pinipilit na maniwala. Ipinakilala Niya ang Kanyang sarili sa pamamagitan ni Hesus, at matiyaga Niya tayong inaanyayahan sa isang relasyon, na binibigyan tayo ng laya na pumili.
tl.reflection: Sa mga maliliit at malalaking sandali ng iyong araw, paano mo aktibong pinipiling maniwala at sumunod kay Hesus?

en.understanding: The Pharisees weren't just "bad guys"; they were deeply serious about God's Word and tried hard to live righteously. They were looking for the promised Messiah, which is why they were investigating John the Baptist. It’s important to remember that some of them, like the apostle Paul, later became passionate followers of Jesus.
en.livingItOut: Like the Pharisees, we can love studying the Bible, but let's be careful not to let our knowledge make us proud. We should always keep our hearts open and humble, ready to see and accept what God is doing right in front of us. True faith is about relationship, not just rules.
en.godsLove: God's love is so patient and powerful that it reaches everyone, even those who might seem like His opponents at first. His grace can transform the most religious and rule-focused heart into one that is full of love for Him, just as it did with Paul. No one is too far gone for His amazing grace.
en.reflection: In what area of my life might my own ideas or "religious rules" be keeping me from simply seeing and following Jesus today?

tl.understanding: Hindi lang basta kontrabida ang mga Pariseo; seryoso sila sa Salita ng Diyos at sinikap nilang mamuhay nang matuwid. Naghahanap sila ng ipinangakong Mesiyas, kaya sila nag-iimbestiga tungkol kay Juan. Mahalagang tandaan na ang ilan sa kanila, tulad ni apostol Pablo, ay naging masugid na tagasunod ni Hesus.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ng mga Pariseo, maaaring mahilig tayong mag-aral ng Bibliya, pero mag-ingat tayo na huwag maging sanhi ng pride ang ating kaalaman. Panatilihin nating bukas at mapagkumbaba ang ating mga puso, para handa tayong makita at tanggapin ang ginagawa ng Diyos sa ating harapan. Ang tunay na pananampalataya ay tungkol sa relasyon, hindi lang sa mga patakaran.
tl.godsLove: Napakamaunawain at makapangyarihan ng pag-ibig ng Diyos dahil abot Niya ang lahat, kahit pa ‘yung mga mukhang kalaban Niya sa simula. Kayang-kayang baguhin ng Kanyang biyaya kahit ang pinakarelihiyosong puso para magmahal sa Kanya, tulad ng ginawa Niya kay Pablo. Walang sinuman ang hindi kayang abutin ng Kanyang biyaya.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng aking buhay maaaring nagiging hadlang ang sarili kong mga ideya o "panuntunang panrelihiyon" para makita ko at masundan si Hesus ngayon?

en.understanding: This verse gives us a peek into the division that Jesus’ coming would create. The religious leaders had their own ideas about who the Messiah would be, and they questioned anyone who didn't fit their expectations. This kind of doubt and questioning would only get stronger once Jesus started His ministry.
en.livingItOut: Let's check our own hearts to see if we have rigid expectations of how God should work. Instead of putting God in a box, let's be open to Him working in ways we don't expect. Let's ask Him to show us where He is moving today, even if it looks different from what we're used to.
en.godsLove: Even when faced with skepticism and doubt, God’s loving plan never stopped moving forward. He patiently sent messengers and ultimately His own Son to give everyone a chance to believe. His love is persistent and doesn't give up on us easily, always reaching out.
en.reflection: In what area of my life might I be limiting God with my own expectations, instead of trusting His surprising and wonderful ways?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita ng talatang ito ang simula ng pagkakahati-hati na idudulot ng pagdating ni Jesus. May sariling ideya ang mga lider ng relihiyon kung sino ang Mesiyas, at kinuwestiyon nila ang sinumang hindi tugma sa kanilang inaasahan. Ang ganitong pagdududa ay lalo pang titindi nang magsimula na si Jesus sa Kanyang ministeryo.
tl.livingItOut: Suriin natin ang ating puso kung mayroon tayong mga inaasahan kung paano dapat kumilos ang Diyos. Sa halip na ikahon Siya, maging bukas tayo sa Kanyang pagkilos sa mga paraang hindi natin inaasahan. Hilingin nating ipakita Niya kung saan Siya kumikilos ngayon, kahit na iba ito sa ating nakasanayan.
tl.godsLove: Kahit may pagdududa at pagtatanong, tuloy pa rin ang plano ng pag-ibig ng Diyos. Matiyaga Siyang nagpadala ng mga sugo, at sa huli, ang sarili Niyang Anak, para bigyan ang lahat ng pagkakataong maniwala. Ang pag-ibig Niya ay mapursigi at hindi tayo basta-basta sinusukuan.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay ko ako naglalagay ng limitasyon sa Diyos dahil sa sarili kong inaasahan, sa halip na magtiwala sa Kanyang mga kamangha-manghang paraan?

en.understanding: In Bible times, untying someone's sandals was a task for the lowest-ranking slave. When John the Baptist said this, he was expressing extreme humility. He meant that compared to Jesus' greatness, he wasn't even worthy to be His lowliest servant.
en.livingItOut: Like John, we can live with a humble heart that points people to Jesus, not to ourselves. When you receive a compliment or achieve something great, take a moment to thank God and give Him the glory. Our lives should be an arrow pointing to how wonderful He is.
en.godsLove: John felt unworthy to even touch Jesus' sandals, yet this same Jesus willingly touched the sick and washed His disciples' feet. God’s love is so amazing that the King of all humbled Himself to serve us. He doesn't see us as unworthy; He sees us as beloved children worth dying for.
en.reflection: In what area of my life do I need to decrease so that Jesus can increase?

tl.understanding: Noong panahon nila, ang pagtatanggal ng sandalyas ay trabaho ng pinakamababang alipin. Sa sinabing ito ni John the Baptist, ipinapahayag niya ang kanyang lubos na pagpapakumbaba. Para sa kanya, sa sobrang kadakilaan ni Hesus, hindi man lang siya karapat-dapat maging pinakamababang alipin Niya.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ni John, mamuhay tayo nang may mapagkumbabang puso na nagtuturo sa mga tao patungo kay Hesus, hindi sa ating sarili. Kapag nakatanggap ka ng papuri o may naabot kang maganda, magpasalamat ka sa Diyos at ibigay sa Kanya ang lahat ng karangalan. Ang buhay natin ay dapat parang sign na nagsasabing, "Si Hesus ang a-amazing!"
tl.godsLove: Pakiramdam ni John ay hindi siya karapat-dapat na humawak man lang sa sandalyas ni Hesus, pero itong si Hesus ang Siyang kusang-loob na humipo sa mga may sakit at naghugas ng paa ng Kanyang mga disipulo. Ganyan kahanga-hanga ang pag-ibig ng Diyos; ang Hari ng lahat ay nagpakumbaba para pagsilbihan tayo. Hindi ka Niya tinitingnan bilang hindi karapat-dapat, kundi bilang isang minamahal na anak.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay ko ako kailangang magpakumbaba para mas lumitaw ang kadakilaan ni Hesus?

en.understanding: This verse names the exact place where John the Baptist introduced Jesus to the world. As Jesus began His ministry, people's reactions were divided—some chose to believe in Him, while others chose to oppose Him. This choice to believe or not is a central theme all throughout the Gospel of John.
en.livingItOut: Just like the people in Jesus' time, we are also faced with a choice every day: will we believe and follow Him? Let's choose to actively trust Jesus with our decisions, our worries, and our plans, not just on Sundays but in our everyday moments.
en.godsLove: God's love is so personal that He doesn't force us to follow Him; instead, He reveals Himself clearly through Jesus and invites us into a relationship. He patiently waits for us to respond to His loving invitation to believe and trust Him.
en.reflection: What is one area in your life this week where you can consciously choose to trust in Jesus' way instead of your own?

tl.understanding: Tinutukoy ng talatang ito ang eksaktong lugar kung saan ipinakilala ni Juan Bautista si Hesus sa mga tao. Mula nang magsimula ang ministeryo ni Hesus, nahati ang reaksyon ng mga tao—may mga piniling maniwala sa Kanya, at mayroon ding tumanggi. Ang pagpiling ito kung mananampalataya o hindi ay isang mahalagang tema sa buong aklat ni Juan.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ng mga tao noong panahon ni Hesus, tayo rin ay may pagpipilian araw-araw: maniniwala ba tayo at susunod sa Kanya? Piliin nating pagkatiwalaan si Hesus sa ating mga desisyon, alalahanin, at plano, hindi lang tuwing Linggo kundi sa bawat sandali ng ating buhay.
tl.godsLove: Napaka-personal ng pag-ibig ng Diyos; hindi Niya tayo pinipilit na sumunod. Sa halip, malinaw Niyang ipinakilala ang Kanyang sarili sa pamamagitan ni Hesus at inaanyayahan tayo sa isang relasyon. Matiyaga Siyang naghihintay sa ating tugon sa Kanyang paanyaya na manampalataya at magtiwala.
tl.reflection: Sa anong isang bahagi ng buhay mo ngayong linggo ka maaaring sadyang magpasya na pagkatiwalaan ang paraan ni Hesus kaysa sa sarili mong paraan?

en.understanding: When John the Baptist called Jesus the "Lamb of God," he was using a powerful picture his listeners understood. In the Old Testament, a lamb was sacrificed to cover people's sins, especially during Passover. John was declaring that Jesus is the ultimate sacrifice, the one who truly deals with our sin once and for all.
en.livingItOut: Because Jesus took our sins away, we can stop carrying the heavy weight of our past mistakes. Today, if you feel guilt or shame, consciously give it to Jesus, the Lamb of God. You can walk in the freedom He bought for you, not in the shadow of what you've done.
en.godsLove: Instead of asking us to find a way to fix our own sin, God lovingly provided the solution Himself. He sent His one and only Son, Jesus, to be the perfect Lamb. This shows just how far His love will go to bring us back into a relationship with Him.
en.reflection: Is there a specific sin or burden you are still carrying that you need to surrender to the Lamb of God today?

tl.understanding: Nang tawagin ni John the Baptist si Jesus na "Kordero ng Diyos," gumamit siya ng isang imahe na madaling naiintindihan ng mga tao noon. Sa Old Testament, isang tupa ang isinasakripisyo para sa kasalanan. Ipinapahayag ni John na si Jesus ang pinakahuling sakripisyo na tunay na tumutubos sa ating mga kasalanan.
tl.livingItOut: Dahil inalis na ni Jesus ang ating mga kasalanan, hindi na natin kailangang pasanin pa ang bigat ng ating mga pagkakamali. Kung mayroon kang nararamdamang guilt o hiya ngayon, sadyain mong isuko ito kay Jesus, ang Kordero ng Diyos. Pwede kang mamuhay sa kalayaang ibinigay Niya para sa'yo.
tl.godsLove: Sa halip na hayaan tayong humanap ng paraan para ayusin ang ating kasalanan, ang Diyos mismo ang nagbigay ng solusyon dahil sa Kanyang pag-ibig. Ipinadala Niya ang Kanyang kaisa-isang Anak, si Jesus, bilang perpektong Kordero, na nagpapakita kung gaano kalalim ang pagmamahal Niya para maibalik lang tayo sa Kanya.
tl.reflection: Mayroon bang partikular na kasalanan o pasanin na dala-dala mo pa rin hanggang ngayon na kailangan mong isuko sa Kordero ng Diyos?

en.understanding: John the Baptist clearly understood his mission was to introduce Jesus. He wasn't the star of the show; his purpose was to point everyone to the one who truly mattered. This verse shows John humbly declaring that Jesus is far greater because He is eternal and has always existed.
en.livingItOut: Like John the Baptist, our lives should be a sign that points to Jesus. In our conversations, decisions, and actions, let's seek to make Jesus more known and ourselves less of the focus. Our goal is for Him to increase while we decrease.
en.godsLove: God's love is seen in His perfect plan of salvation. He didn't just send Jesus; He lovingly prepared people's hearts by sending a messenger first. This shows how thoughtful and patient God is in revealing His Son to the world.
en.reflection: In what specific area of your life this week can you intentionally step back so that Jesus can be more visible to others?

tl.understanding: Malinaw kay John the Baptist na ang misyon niya ay ipakilala si Jesus. Hindi siya ang bida; ang layunin niya ay ituro ang lahat sa Tunay na Bida. Pinapakita sa talatang ito ang pagpapakumbaba ni John, na si Jesus ay mas dakila dahil Siya ay walang hanggan.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni John the Baptist, sana ang buhay natin ay maging sign na nagtuturo kay Jesus. Sa ating mga usapan, desisyon, at gawa, sikapin nating mas makilala si Jesus at hindi ang ating sarili. Ang goal natin ay Siya ang lumago habang tayo ay lumiliit.
tl.godsLove: Makikita ang pag-ibig ng Diyos sa Kanyang perpektong plano ng kaligtasan. Hindi Niya basta-basta isinugo si Jesus; buong pagmamahal Niyang inihanda ang puso ng mga tao sa pamamagitan ng isang mensahero. Pinapakita nito kung gaano ka-maalalahanin at ka-pasensyoso ang Diyos sa pagpapakilala ng Kanyang Anak sa atin.
tl.reflection: Sa anong partikular na bahagi ng buhay mo ngayong linggo ka maaaring sadyang "umatras" para mas makita ng iba si Jesus sa iyo?

en.understanding: John the Baptist's main job wasn't to become famous, but to prepare the way for Jesus. Even though he had his own followers, his entire ministry was designed to be a giant signpost pointing everyone to the true Savior. His mission was complete when he revealed Jesus to the world.
en.livingItOut: Like John, our lives can be a signpost that points others to Jesus. In our work, family, or friendships, let's aim to make Jesus the main character, not ourselves. Let our actions and words show people His goodness so they will want to know Him more.
en.godsLove: God loves us so much that He didn't just send Jesus; He also lovingly sent a messenger to prepare our hearts for Him. This shows His thoughtful and detailed plan to make sure we wouldn't miss the arrival of our Savior. He always makes a way for us to find Him.
en.reflection: In what area of your life today can you intentionally make Jesus the center, instead of yourself?

tl.understanding: Ang pangunahing misyon ni John the Baptist ay hindi para sa kanyang sarili, kundi para ihanda ang daan para kay Hesus. Kahit may sarili siyang mga tagasunod, ang buong ministeryo niya ay para ituro sa lahat kung sino ang tunay na Tagapagligtas. Naging kumpleto ang misyon niya noong naipakilala na niya si Hesus sa mga tao.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni John, ang buhay natin ay pwedeng maging isang signpost na nagtuturo sa iba papunta kay Hesus. Sa ating trabaho, pamilya, o pakikipagkaibigan, hangarin nating si Hesus ang maging bida, hindi tayo. Hayaan nating ang ating mga kilos at salita ang magpakita ng Kanyang kabutihan para hanap-hanapin Siya ng iba.
tl.godsLove: Sadyang mahal tayo ng Diyos na hindi lang Niya basta ipinadala si Hesus; nagpadala pa Siya ng mensahero para ihanda ang mga puso natin. Pinapakita nito ang Kanyang maingat na plano para siguraduhing hindi natin mapalampas ang pagdating ng ating Tagapagligtas. Palagi Siyang gumagawa ng paraan para makilala natin Siya.
tl.reflection: Sa anong aspeto ng buhay mo ngayon ang maaari mong sadyain na itaas si Hesus, sa halip na ang iyong sarili?

en.understanding: John saw the Holy Spirit coming down on Jesus to *stay*. In the Old Testament, the Spirit's anointing was often for a specific time or task. But on Jesus, the Spirit "rested," showing that His divine power and anointing from the Father were permanent.
en.livingItOut: Because the Spirit rests permanently on Jesus, we who are in Christ can be confident that the Holy Spirit lives in us always. Today, let's intentionally ask for the Spirit's guidance in our conversations and decisions, trusting that He is with us.
en.godsLove: God's love is so personal that He didn't want us to have any doubts about Jesus. He gave a visible sign—the Spirit like a dove—to publicly declare His approval and love for His Son. This was His way of saying to the world, "This is my beloved Son; trust Him completely."
en.reflection: In which area of your life do you need to more fully trust the Holy Spirit's permanent presence and guidance today?

tl.understanding: Nakita ni Juan Bautista ang Banal na Espiritu na hindi lang dumapo kay Hesus, kundi "namahinga" o nanatili sa Kanya. Sa Lumang Tipan, ang presensya ng Espiritu ay madalas pansamantala lang para sa isang gawain. Ngunit ang pananatili ng Espiritu kay Hesus ay nagpapakita na ang kapangyarihan ng Diyos ay permanente sa Kanya.
tl.livingItOut: Dahil nananatili ang Espiritu kay Hesus, tayo na mga tagasunod Niya ay makakaasa na ang Banal na Espiritu ay nananahan din sa atin palagi. Ngayong araw, sadyain nating kausapin ang Holy Spirit at hingin ang Kanyang gabay sa ating mga desisyon at pakikipag-usap.
tl.godsLove: Napakabuti ng Diyos dahil ayaw Niyang mag-alinlangan tayo kung sino si Hesus. Nagbigay Siya ng malinaw na tanda—ang Espiritung parang kalapati—upang ipahayag sa lahat ang Kanyang pagmamahal at pagkilala sa Kanyang Anak. Ito ang Kanyang paraan para sabihing, "Ito ang Anak ko, lubos ninyo Siyang pagkatiwalaan."
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon ang kailangan mong mas pagtiwalaan ang palaging presensya at gabay ng Banal na Espiritu?

en.understanding: This verse shows John the Baptist's incredible humility and clear mission. His main job wasn't to gather followers for himself, but to correctly point everyone to Jesus. He was like a signpost, making sure all the attention went to the Savior.
en.livingItOut: Like John, our lives should be a big arrow pointing to Jesus. In our words and actions, let's aim to make Jesus look great, not ourselves. The goal is for people to see Him more clearly because of us.
en.godsLove: Isn't God's love amazing? He didn't want us to be confused about who the Savior was. He lovingly sent a messenger, John the Baptist, with a clear sign so everyone would know for sure that Jesus is the One.
en.reflection: In what small way this week can I decrease, so that people around me can see more of Jesus's love?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita sa talatang ito ang kababaang-loob at malinaw na misyon ni Juan Bautista. Ang trabaho niya ay hindi para magkaroon ng sariling followers, kundi para ituro ang lahat kay Hesus. Para siyang isang signpost, sinisigurong lahat ng atensyon ay mapupunta sa ating Tagapagligtas.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ni Juan, sana ang buhay natin ay maging isang malaking arrow na nakaturo kay Hesus. Sa ating mga salita at gawa, layunin nating si Hesus ang maging bida, hindi tayo. Ang goal natin ay mas makita Siya ng mga tao dahil sa atin.
tl.godsLove: Grabe ang pag-ibig ng Diyos, 'di ba? Ayaw Niyang malito tayo kung sino ang Tagapagligtas. Nagpadala Siya ng mensahero, si Juan Bautista, na may malinaw na sign para sigurado tayong lahat na si Hesus nga ang hinihintay natin.
tl.reflection: Sa anong maliit na paraan ako pwedeng "mag-decrease" ngayong linggo, para mas makita ng mga tao sa paligid ko ang pag-ibig ni Hesus?

en.understanding: When John the Baptist called Jesus the "Son of God," he was also declaring Him as God's "Chosen One." This was a powerful title that fulfilled the Old Testament prophecies, like the one in Isaiah 42. John was essentially shouting, "The One we've all been waiting for is finally here!"
en.livingItOut: John saw something amazing and he couldn't keep quiet about it. In the same way, when we see God work in our lives—big or small—let's not keep it a secret. This week, find a simple way to share one good thing God has done for you with a friend or family member.
en.godsLove: God's love for us is so personal and intentional. He didn't send just anyone; He sent His very own "Chosen One," the One His heart delights in. This shows how incredibly valuable you are to God—He sent His absolute best for you.
en.reflection: What is one thing you have "seen" God do in your life that you can confidently share with someone else?

tl.understanding: Nang tawagin ni John the Baptist si Jesus na "Anak ng Diyos," ipinapahayag niya rin na si Hesus ang "Hinirang ng Diyos." Isa itong napakahalagang titulo na katuparan ng mga hula sa Old Testament, tulad ng nasa Isaias 42. Para na ring sinabi ni John, "Dumating na ang matagal na nating hinihintay!"
tl.livingItOut: May nakitang kamangha-mangha si John at hindi niya ito kayang sarilinin. Ganoon din tayo, kapag nakita nating kumilos ang Diyos sa buhay natin—maliit man o malaki—huwag natin itong itago. Ngayong linggo, magbahagi tayo ng isang mabuting bagay na ginawa ng Diyos sa isang kaibigan o kapamilya.
tl.godsLove: Sadyang plano at personal ang pag-ibig ng Diyos para sa atin. Hindi Siya basta nagpadala ng kung sino lang; isinugo Niya ang Kanyang sariling "Hinirang," ang kinalulugdan ng Kanyang puso. Pinapakita nito kung gaano ka kahalaga sa Kanya—dahil ipinadala Niya ang Kanyang "the best" para sa'yo.
tl.reflection: Ano ang isang bagay na "nakita" mong ginawa ng Diyos sa buhay mo na kaya mong ibahagi sa iba?

en.understanding: This verse shows a beautiful moment of transition. John the Baptist's main purpose wasn't to gather followers for himself, but to point them to Jesus. We see his mission succeeding as his own disciples begin to turn their attention to the One he was announcing.
en.livingItOut: Like John the Baptist, our greatest success is when we make Jesus famous, not ourselves. In our work, family, or ministry, let's joyfully point others to Jesus' goodness instead of seeking our own credit. This is true humility in action.
en.godsLove: God's love is seen in His beautiful and orderly plan to bring us to Jesus. He honors and uses humble servants like John to guide people to the true source of life. He lovingly makes a way for us to meet His Son.
en.reflection: In what area of my life can I step back this week so that others can see more of Jesus through me?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita ng talatang ito ang isang magandang yugto ng pagbabago. Ang layunin ni Juan Bautista ay hindi para magkaroon ng sarili niyang followers, kundi para ituro sila kay Hesus. Dito, nakikita natin na nagtatagumpay ang kanyang misyon dahil ang sarili niyang mga disipulo ay nagsisimula nang tumingin kay Hesus.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni Juan Bautista, ang pinakadakilang tagumpay natin ay kapag si Hesus ang sumisikat, at hindi tayo. Sa ating trabaho, pamilya, o ministeryo, masaya nating ituro ang iba sa kabutihan ni Hesus sa halip na hanapin ang sarili nating papuri. Ito ang tunay na pagpapakumbaba.
tl.godsLove: Nakikita ang pag-ibig ng Diyos sa Kanyang maganda at maayos na plano para madala tayo kay Hesus. Pinapahalagahan at ginagamit Niya ang mga mapagkumbabang lingkod tulad ni Juan para akayin ang mga tao sa tunay na bukal ng buhay. Maingat Siyang gumagawa ng paraan para makilala natin ang Kanyang Anak.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay ko ako pwedeng mag-step back ngayong linggo para mas makita ng iba si Hesus sa pamamagitan ko?

en.understanding: John the Baptist understood his mission was not about gaining his own followers, but about pointing others to Jesus. When his own disciples started following Jesus, he saw it as a success. He joyfully led people to the One who truly mattered.
en.livingItOut: Like John the Baptist, we can use our influence to point people to Jesus, not to ourselves. When someone compliments you, find a simple way to give the glory to God. Let your life be a sign that says, “Look, there’s Jesus!”
en.godsLove: God's love is so deep that He sent the perfect "Lamb of God" to take away our sins once and for all. He also shows His love by giving each of us a special purpose, just like John, to be part of His amazing story.
en.reflection: In what area of my life this week can I consciously shift the spotlight from myself to Jesus?

tl.understanding: Alam ni John the Baptist na ang misyon niya ay hindi para magkaroon ng sariling followers, kundi para ituro ang mga tao kay Hesus. Kaya nang ang sarili niyang mga disipulo ay sumunod kay Hesus, tagumpay ito para sa kanya. Masaya niyang itinuro sa lahat kung sino ang tunay na Bida.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni John, gamitin natin ang ating impluwensya para maituro ang mga tao kay Hesus, hindi sa ating sarili. Kapag may pumuri sa iyo, humanap ng simpleng paraan para maibalik ang papuri sa Diyos. Hayaan mong ang buhay mo ay maging parang sign na nagsasabing, “Tingnan ninyo, si Hesus!”
tl.godsLove: Napakalalim ng pag-ibig ng Diyos kaya't isinugo Niya ang perpektong "Kordero ng Diyos" para alisin ang ating mga kasalanan. Ipinapakita rin Niya ang Kanyang pagmamahal sa pagbibigay sa atin ng layunin, tulad ni John, na maging bahagi ng Kanyang dakilang kwento.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay ko ngayong linggo ko maaaring sadyang ilipat ang spotlight mula sa aking sarili patungo kay Hesus?

en.understanding: John the Baptist’s main purpose was to point people directly to Jesus. When his own disciples heard his testimony, they immediately left him to follow the true Messiah. This wasn't a failure for John; it was the ultimate success of his mission.
en.livingItOut: Like John, our lives should be a sign pointing others to Jesus, not to ourselves. Let your greatest success be when someone you've encouraged starts following Jesus more closely. Our goal is to decrease so that Christ can increase in the lives of others.
en.godsLove: God's love is so personal that He places people in our lives to guide us to Him. Just as He sent John to prepare the way, He still uses friends, family, and pastors to introduce us to the life-changing love of Jesus. He actively makes a way for us to find Him.
en.reflection: Who is God using in your life today to point you closer to Jesus, and how are you responding to their call?

tl.understanding: Ang pangunahing misyon ni John the Baptist ay ituro ang mga tao papunta kay Hesus. Nang marinig ng sarili niyang mga alagad ang kanyang patotoo, agad nila siyang iniwan para sumunod sa tunay na Mesiyas. Hindi ito kabiguan para kay John; ito ang pinakamatagumpay na bahagi ng kanyang ministeryo.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ni John, nawa'y ang buhay natin ay maging isang sign na nagtuturo sa iba patungo kay Hesus, hindi sa ating sarili. Hayaan mong ang pinakamalaking tagumpay mo ay kapag ang isang taong ginabayan mo ay nagsimulang mas tapat na sumunod kay Hesus. Ang layunin natin ay magpakumbaba para si Kristo ang mas makilala sa buhay ng iba.
tl.godsLove: Personal ang pag-ibig ng Diyos kaya naglalagay Siya ng mga tao sa buhay natin para akayin tayo palapit sa Kanya. Tulad ng pagpapadala Niya kay John, gumagamit pa rin Siya ng mga kaibigan, pamilya, at pastor para ipakilala sa atin ang pag-ibig ni Hesus na nakapagpapabago. Aktibo Siyang gumagawa ng paraan para matagpuan natin Siya.
tl.reflection: Sino ang ginagamit ng Diyos sa buhay mo ngayon para ituro ka palapit kay Hesus, at paano ka tumutugon sa kanilang tawag?

en.understanding: This moment is a beautiful picture of John the Baptist's successful mission. His whole purpose was to point people to Jesus, and here we see his own disciples doing just that. They are transitioning from following the messenger to following the Messiah.
en.livingItOut: Like these first disciples, our faith calls for action, not just belief. We can follow Jesus today by intentionally spending time with Him through prayer and His Word. It's about moving from simply hearing about Him to actively seeking His presence in our daily lives.
en.godsLove: Notice how Jesus turns and welcomes them with a question; He doesn't dismiss their curiosity. This shows us God's inviting heart—He is always ready to welcome us when we take a step toward Him. He isn't a distant God, but a personal Savior who is interested in what we are seeking.
en.reflection: If Jesus turned to you today and asked, “What do you want?”, what would your honest answer be?

tl.understanding: Napakagandang tagpo ito na nagpapakita ng tagumpay ng misyon ni John the Baptist. Ang layunin niya ay ituro ang mga tao kay Hesus, at dito, mismong mga disipulo na niya ang sumusunod sa Kanya. Ito ang paglipat ng pagsunod mula sa mensahero patungo sa Mesiyas.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ng mga unang alagad, ang ating pananampalataya ay nangangailangan ng pagkilos, hindi lang basta paniniwala. Sundan natin si Hesus ngayon sa pamamagitan ng paglalaan ng oras sa Kanya sa panalangin at pagbabasa ng Salita Niya. Hindi sapat na naririnig lang natin Siya; kailangan nating hanapin ang presensya Niya sa ating araw-araw.
tl.godsLove: Pansinin kung paano humarap si Hesus at tinanggap sila sa pamamagitan ng isang tanong; hindi Niya sila isinantabi. Pinapakita nito ang pusong mapag-anyaya ng Diyos—lagi Siyang handang tanggapin tayo kapag lumalapit tayo sa Kanya. Hindi Siya isang Diyos na malayo, kundi isang personal na Tagapagligtas na interesado sa kung ano ang hinahanap natin.
tl.reflection: Kung haharap sa iyo si Hesus ngayon at magtatanong, “Ano ang gusto mo?”, ano ang magiging tapat na sagot ng puso mo?

en.understanding: This verse shows the successful mission of John the Baptist. His whole purpose was to point people to Jesus, and here we see his own disciples taking that step. They are moving from following the messenger to following the Messiah Himself.
en.livingItOut: Jesus’ invitation to "Come and see" is for us too. Let's accept it daily by setting aside time to simply be with Him in prayer and in His Word. Don't just learn *about* Him; choose to spend your day *with* Him.
en.godsLove: Notice that Jesus doesn't give a complicated lecture, but a simple, warm invitation. This shows God's loving heart—He doesn't want distant admirers, but friends who come close and share life with Him. He is always inviting us into a personal and intimate relationship.
en.reflection: When Jesus says "Come and see," what is one simple way you can respond and spend quality time with Him this week?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita sa talatang ito ang tagumpay ng misyon ni John the Baptist. Ang layunin niya ay ituro ang mga tao kay Hesus, at dito na mismo lumalapit sa Kanya ang mga sariling alagad ni John. Ito ang paglipat ng kanilang pagsunod, mula sa mensahero patungo sa mismong Mesiyas.
tl.livingItOut: Ang paanyaya ni Hesus na "Halikayo at tingnan ninyo" ay para rin sa atin ngayon. Tanggapin natin ito araw-araw sa pamamagitan ng paglalaan ng oras para makasama Siya sa panalangin at pagbabasa ng Salita Niya. Huwag lang Siyang pag-aralan, kundi piliing samahan Siya sa ating buong araw.
tl.godsLove: Pansinin na hindi kumplikadong turo ang ibinigay ni Hesus, kundi isang simple at mainit na paanyaya. Pinapakita nito ang mapagmahal na puso ng Diyos—hindi Siya naghahanap ng malayong tagahanga, kundi mga kaibigang lumalapit at nakikibahagi sa Kanya. Palagi Niya tayong inaanyayahan sa isang personal na relasyon.
tl.reflection: Sa paanyaya ni Hesus na "Halikayo at tingnan ninyo," ano ang isang simpleng paraan na maaari mong gawin para makasama Siya nang personal ngayong linggo?

en.understanding: This verse shows a beautiful moment of transition. John the Baptist's whole mission was to point people to Jesus, and here we see it happening! When Andrew heard John's message, he didn't just stay with John; he immediately went to follow the One John was talking about.
en.livingItOut: Like John the Baptist, our role is not to draw attention to ourselves, but to point others to Jesus. In our conversations and actions, let's make it our goal to introduce people to the Savior, not just to our own good deeds or opinions.
en.godsLove: God's love is so personal that He uses people to invite others into His family. He used John's faithful testimony to call Andrew, and He still uses our stories today to draw others to Himself. God loves connecting people to His Son, Jesus, through those who already know Him.
en.reflection: In my life this week, whose attention can I lovingly direct away from me and towards Jesus?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita sa talatang ito ang isang magandang paglilipat ng focus. Ang misyon ni John the Baptist ay ituro ang mga tao kay Hesus, at dito natin nakikita na nagtagumpay siya! Nang marinig ni Andrew ang sinabi ni John, agad siyang sumunod sa Panginoon na tinutukoy nito.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ni John the Baptist, ang ating papel ay hindi para makuha ang atensyon ng tao, kundi para ituro sila kay Hesus. Sa ating mga salita at gawa, gawin nating layunin na ipakilala ang Tagapagligtas, at hindi lang ang ating sariling galing o opinyon.
tl.godsLove: Personal ang pag-ibig ng Diyos; gumagamit Siya ng mga tao para mag-imbita ng iba pa sa Kanyang pamilya. Ginamit Niya ang tapat na patotoo ni John para tawagin si Andrew, at ginagamit pa rin Niya ang ating mga kwento ngayon para ilapit ang iba sa Kanya. Mahal ng Diyos na iugnay ang mga tao sa Kanyang Anak na si Hesus.
tl.reflection: Sa buhay ko ngayong linggo, kaninong atensyon ang maaari kong dahan-dahang ituro palayo sa akin at papunta kay Hesus?

en.understanding: Andrew was a follower of John the Baptist, whose whole mission was to point people to Jesus. So when Andrew finally met Jesus, he knew this was the Messiah he had been waiting for. This moment shows that John the Baptist's ministry was a success—he led his followers right to the Savior!
en.livingItOut: The very first thing Andrew did was run to his brother, Simon, to share the good news. Let's follow his example and not keep the joy of knowing Jesus to ourselves. Think of one family member or close friend you can share God’s goodness with this week.
en.godsLove: God’s love is so personal that it often reaches us through the people we know and trust. He loves our families so much that He uses us to invite our loved ones into a relationship with Him. His great plan of salvation spreads through personal, loving connections.
en.reflection: Who is the "Simon" in your life—that one person God is putting on your heart to share the good news with?

tl.understanding: Si Andrew ay isa sa mga alagad ni John the Baptist, na ang misyon ay ituro ang mga tao patungo kay Hesus. Kaya naman nang makilala ni Andrew si Hesus, alam niyang Siya na ang Messiah na matagal na nilang hinihintay. Ipinapakita nito na naging matagumpay ang misyon ni John—dinala niya ang kanyang mga alagad sa mismong Tagapagligtas!
tl.livingItOut: Ang pinakaunang ginawa ni Andrew ay hanapin ang kapatid niyang si Simon para ibahagi ang magandang balita. Tularan natin ang kanyang halimbawa at huwag sarilinin ang galak ng pagkakilala kay Hesus. Mag-isip ng isang kapamilya o kaibigan na pwede mong bahaginan ng kabutihan ng Diyos ngayong linggo.
tl.godsLove: Napakapersonal ng pag-ibig ng Diyos, at madalas itong dumarating sa atin sa pamamagitan ng mga taong kilala at pinagkakatiwalaan natin. Mahal na mahal Niya ang ating mga pamilya kaya ginagamit Niya tayo para anyayahan ang ating mga mahal sa buhay na makilala Siya. Ang Kanyang dakilang plano ng kaligtasan ay kumakalat sa pamamagitan ng pagmamahal ng isang tao para sa kanyang kapwa.
tl.reflection: Sino ang "Simon" sa buhay mo—yung isang taong inilalagay ng Diyos sa puso mo para bahaginan ng Mabuting Balita?

en.understanding: This verse shows a beautiful chain reaction that started with John the Baptist. John's purpose was to point people to Jesus, and when his follower Andrew heard this, he immediately went and brought his own brother, Peter, to meet Him too. The mission was passed from one person to another.
