Pinapakita nito na ang pag-ibig ng Diyos ay hindi nakabase sa ating perpektong gawa; mapagpasensya Niya tayong minamahal kahit alam Niyang bibiguin natin Siya.
tl.reflection: Saang bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon mo gustong hilingin sa Diyos na suriin ang tunay na motibo ng puso mo sa pagsunod sa Kanya?

en.understanding: The "300 denarii" Judas mentioned was a huge amount of money, equal to about a full year's salary for a regular worker back then. This shows us that Mary's gift to Jesus wasn't just a small gesture. It was an incredibly costly and sacrificial act of worship from a loving heart.
en.livingItOut: True worship often costs us something, whether it's our time, our comfort, or our resources. Let's not give God our leftovers, but instead offer Him our very best with a joyful heart. Our offering, big or small, becomes beautiful when it's a sacrifice for Him.
en.godsLove: Notice that Jesus didn't see Mary's gift as a waste; He saw it as beautiful worship. This reveals God’s heart: He treasures our extravagant love for Him. He doesn't just look at the price tag of our gift, but at the love in our hearts when we give it.
en.reflection: What is one "precious" thing in your life (like your time, a talent, or your comfort) that you can offer to Jesus this week as an act of worship?

tl.understanding: Ang "300 denarii" na binanggit ni Hudas ay napakalaking halaga, katumbas ng sahod sa isang buong taon para sa isang karaniwang manggagawa noon. Ipinapakita nito na ang handog ni Maria kay Hesus ay hindi basta-basta. Ito ay isang napakamahal at mapagsakripisyong pagsamba mula sa isang pusong nagmamahal.
tl.livingItOut: Ang tunay na pagsamba ay madalas may kapalit—ito man ay ating oras, kaginhawaan, o yaman. Huwag nating ibigay sa Diyos ang ating mga tira-tira, kundi ihandog natin sa Kanya ang ating pinakamahusay nang may galak. Ang ating handog, maliit man o malaki, ay nagiging maganda kapag ito ay sakripisyo para sa Kanya.
tl.godsLove: Pansinin na hindi itinuring ni Hesus na "sayang" ang handog ni Maria; nakita Niya ito bilang isang magandang pagsamba. Inihahayag nito ang puso ng Diyos: pinahahalagahan Niya ang ating lubos na pagmamahal para sa Kanya. Hindi Siya tumitingin sa presyo ng ating regalo, kundi sa pag-ibig sa ating puso kapag ibinibigay natin ito.
tl.reflection: Ano ang isang "mahalagang" bagay sa buhay mo (tulad ng iyong oras, talento, o comfort) na maaari mong ihandog kay Hesus ngayong linggo bilang iyong pagsamba?

en.understanding: This verse gives us a peek into the growing danger around Jesus. While the religious leaders were plotting against Him from the outside, this detail about Judas shows that a hidden darkness—betrayal and greed—was also growing right inside His inner circle. The conflict wasn't just external; it was deeply personal, too.
en.livingItOut: This reminds us to honestly check our own hearts for any "hidden" sins or wrong motives. Let's ask God to help our private lives honor Him just as much as our public ones. Our goal is a genuine love for Jesus that is true both when people are watching and when no one is.
en.godsLove: Even though Jesus knew Judas's heart and his secret sin, He kept him close and continued to teach him. This reveals God's incredible patience and His loving desire for everyone, even those who will hurt Him, to have a chance to repent. He never gives up on us easily.
en.reflection: Is there any area of my heart that I have been keeping in the shadows, and how can I bring it into God's loving light today?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita ng talatang ito ang lumalaking panganib sa paligid ni Jesus. Habang may mga plano laban sa Kanya ang mga religious leaders sa labas, ang ginagawa ni Judas ay nagpapakita na may lihim na kasamaan—pagtataksil at kasakiman—na lumalago sa loob mismo ng Kanyang grupo. Ang laban ay hindi lang panlabas, kundi personal din.
tl.livingItOut: Paalala ito na suriin nating mabuti ang ating mga puso para sa anumang lihim na kasalanan o maling motibo. Hilingin natin sa Diyos na tulungan tayong maging tunay sa Kanya, sa pribado man o sa pampublikong buhay. Nais natin na ang pag-ibig natin kay Jesus ay totoo, hindi lang pakitang-tao.
tl.godsLove: Kahit na alam ni Jesus ang puso ni Judas at ang pagnanakaw nito, hindi Niya ito agad itinaboy at binigyan pa rin ng pagkakataong magbago. Ipinapakita nito ang sobrang haba ng pasensya ng Diyos at ang Kanyang pag-ibig na naghahangad na ang lahat, kahit ang mga sasakit sa Kanya, ay magsisi at manumbalik.
tl.reflection: Mayroon bang bahagi ng puso ko na itinatago ko sa dilim, at paano ko ito maaaring dalhin sa mapagmahal na liwanag ng Diyos ngayon?

en.understanding: Jesus defends Mary by revealing the true meaning of her beautiful act. This expensive perfume wasn't wasted; it was her special way of preparing Him for His coming death and burial. While others saw waste, Jesus saw worship and preparation.
en.livingItOut: We can worship Jesus by giving Him our very best, just like Mary did. This might be our time, our talents, or our deepest love, offered to Him without worrying what others might think. Our acts of love for Jesus are never wasted.
en.godsLove: God's love is so personal; He sees and values the love in our hearts, even when others misunderstand our actions. Jesus defended Mary, showing that He cherishes every act of worship offered to Him. He sees you and your heart's devotion, too.
en.reflection: What is one "precious" thing—your time, a special skill, or your heartfelt praise—that you can pour out for Jesus this week as an act of love?

tl.understanding: Ipinagtanggol ni Jesus si Maria sa pamamagitan ng pagpapaliwanag sa tunay na kahulugan ng ginawa niya. Hindi nasayang ang mamahaling pabango; ito ang paraan niya para ihanda si Jesus sa Kanyang nalalapit na kamatayan at libing. Sa mata ng iba, aksaya ito, pero sa mata ni Jesus, ito ay pagsamba.
tl.livingItOut: Sambahin natin si Jesus sa pamamagitan ng pagbibigay ng ating "best," tulad ni Maria. Maaaring ito ang ating oras, talento, o taos-pusong pagmamahal, na inaalay sa Kanya kahit hindi naiintindihan ng iba. Hinding-hindi nasasayang ang anumang pag-aalay natin para sa Kanya.
tl.godsLove: Napaka-personal ng pag-ibig ng Diyos; nakikita at pinapahalagahan Niya ang laman ng ating puso, kahit na mali ang pagkakaintindi ng iba. Ipinagtanggol ni Jesus si Maria, na nagpapakitang mahalaga sa Kanya ang bawat gawa ng pagsamba. Nakikita rin Niya ang iyong puso at debosyon.
tl.reflection: Anong "mamahaling pabango"—ang iyong oras, talento, o papuri—ang maibubuhos mo para kay Jesus ngayong linggo bilang tanda ng iyong pagmamahal?

en.understanding: Jesus wasn't dismissing the poor; He cares for them deeply. He was highlighting that this moment to anoint Him before His death was a unique, once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. Helping the poor is a lifelong calling, but His physical presence was a precious, limited time.
en.livingItOut: Be faithful in serving others daily, but also be sensitive to special moments God gives you for worship. When the Holy Spirit prompts you, don't hesitate to pour out your love for Jesus in a unique and personal way.
en.godsLove: Our God desires a close relationship with us and treasures our heartfelt worship. He doesn't just want our service; He longs for our affection. Your moments of pure devotion are a beautiful and precious gift to Him.
en.reflection: What is one special way you can worship Jesus this week, going beyond your usual routine?

tl.understanding: Hindi minamaliit ni Jesus ang mga mahihirap; mahalaga sila sa Kanya. Sinasabi lang Niya na ang pagkakataong iyon na pahiran Siya ng pabango bago Siya mamatay ay isang espesyal na sandali na hindi na mauulit. Ang pagtulong sa kapwa ay palaging nandiyan, pero ang makasama Siya nang pisikal ay isang napakahalagang pagkakataon na may hangganan.
tl.livingItOut: Maging tapat tayo sa pagtulong sa iba araw-araw, pero maging bukas din tayo sa mga espesyal na sandali ng pagsamba na bigay ng Diyos. Kapag kinilos ka ng Banal na Espiritu, 'wag mag-atubiling ibuhos ang iyong pagmamahal kay Jesus sa isang kakaiba at personal na paraan.
tl.godsLove: Nais ng Diyos na magkaroon tayo ng malapit na relasyon sa Kanya at pinahahalagahan Niya ang ating taos-pusong pagsamba. Hindi lang serbisyo natin ang gusto Niya; hinahanap-hanap Niya ang ating pagmamahal. Ang mga sandali ng iyong wagas na pagsamba ay isang maganda at mahalagang regalo para sa Kanya.
tl.reflection: Ano ang isang espesyal na paraan na maaari mong gawin para sambahin si Jesus ngayong linggo, na iba sa karaniwan mong ginagawa?

en.understanding: This verse shows a turning point where Jesus' fame is exploding. Because He raised Lazarus from the dead, huge crowds were coming to see the proof of His power. This growing popularity also increased the danger from the religious leaders who wanted to stop Him.
en.livingItOut: The crowd came to see the miracle, a good reminder for us to check our own hearts. Let's make sure we are following Jesus for who He is, not just for the blessings or miracles He can give us. Our relationship with Him is the greatest gift.
en.godsLove: God's life-changing love can't be hidden! Even with threats around Him, Jesus didn’t hide. He continued to reveal His power over death, showing us that His love is bold, public, and powerful enough to overcome anything for our sake.
en.reflection: What draws you closer to Jesus today—the things He can do for you, or simply who He is?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita sa talatang ito ang isang mahalagang sandali kung saan sumisikat na nang husto si Jesus. Dahil binuhay Niya si Lazaro, dagsaan ang mga tao para makita ang katibayan ng Kanyang kapangyarihan. Ngunit habang Siya ay sumisikat, lalo ring tumitindi ang panganib mula sa mga lider ng relihiyon na gustong pigilan Siya.
tl.livingItOut: Pumunta ang mga tao para makita ang himala, at ito'y isang paalala na suriin din natin ang ating puso. Siguraduhin nating sinusundan natin si Jesus dahil sa kung sino Siya, hindi lang dahil sa mga biyaya at himalang kaya Niyang ibigay. Ang ating relasyon sa Kanya ang pinakadakilang regalo.
tl.godsLove: Hindi kayang itago ang pag-ibig ng Diyos na bumabago ng buhay! Kahit may banta sa Kanyang paligid, hindi nagtago si Jesus. Patuloy Niyang ipinakita ang kapangyarihan Niya laban sa kamatayan, patunay na ang pagmamahal Niya ay matapang, hayagan, at sapat ang lakas para pagtagumpayan ang lahat para sa atin.
tl.reflection: Ano ang humihila sa iyo palapit kay Jesus ngayon: ang mga magagawa Niya para sa iyo, o simpleng Siya lang mismo?

en.understanding: This verse shows how desperate the religious leaders were becoming. As more people believed in Jesus because He raised Lazarus from the dead, the leaders wanted to destroy the living proof. They didn't just want to stop Jesus; they wanted to erase the evidence of His power.
en.livingItOut: When God does something wonderful in our lives, not everyone will be happy about it. Let's be brave like Lazarus, who kept on living his new life, and not hide our testimony out of fear. Our changed lives are a powerful witness that points people to Jesus.
en.godsLove: Even in the face of such hatred, God's power and purpose cannot be stopped. He gave Lazarus a new life, a powerful testimony that no human plan could ultimately erase. God’s love is so great that He uses our stories, even when they attract opposition, to draw more people to Him.
en.reflection: Is there any fear that holds you back from sharing the new life God has given you?

tl.understanding: Pinapakita sa talatang ito kung gaano na ka-desperado ang mga lider ng relihiyon. Dahil dumarami ang naniniwala kay Jesus nang buhayin Niya si Lazaro, gusto nilang alisin ang buhay na ebidensya. Hindi lang si Jesus ang gusto nilang patahimikin, kundi pati ang patunay ng Kanyang kapangyarihan.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag may ginawang maganda ang Diyos sa buhay natin, hindi lahat ay matutuwa para sa atin. Maging matapang tayo tulad ni Lazaro na pinagpatuloy lang ang kanyang bagong buhay, at huwag nating itago ang ating testimonyo dahil sa takot. Ang ating binagong buhay ang pinakamalakas na patotoo para kay Jesus.
tl.godsLove: Kahit sa gitna ng matinding galit, hindi mapipigilan ang kapangyarihan at plano ng Diyos. Binigyan Niya si Lazaro ng bagong buhay—isang patotoo na hindi kayang burahin ng sinuman. Ganyan kalaki ang pag-ibig ng Diyos; ginagamit Niya ang ating mga kwento, kahit may kumokontra, para mas marami ang lumapit sa Kanya.
tl.reflection: Mayroon bang takot na pumipigil sa'yo na ibahagi sa iba ang bagong buhay na bigay sa'yo ng Diyos?

en.understanding: This verse highlights a growing tension right before Jesus' crucifixion. As more and more people witnessed His miracles and truly believed in Him, the religious leaders became more determined to stop Him. People were choosing sides, and many were choosing Jesus.
en.livingItOut: When we truly encounter Jesus, it should change us. Our belief isn't just a quiet thought; it's a public choice that might even separate us from old ways of thinking or old crowds. Let your faith be a visible, life-changing decision that points others to Him.
en.godsLove: God's love is so powerful and attractive that it can't be hidden. Jesus' life and miracles were a public display of God's heart, drawing people in and changing their lives completely. He doesn't force us, but His goodness is so compelling it invites us to leave everything else behind for Him.
en.reflection: In what area of your life is Jesus inviting you to "desert" an old way of thinking so you can believe and trust in Him more fully?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita ng talatang ito ang lumalaking tensyon bago ipako si Hesus sa krus. Habang dumarami ang mga taong nakakakita sa Kanyang mga himala at naniniwala sa Kanya, lalo namang nagagalit ang mga lider ng relihiyon. Kailangang pumili ng panig ng mga tao, at marami ang pumili kay Hesus.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag tunay nating nakilala si Hesus, dapat may magbago sa atin. Ang ating pananampalataya ay hindi lang isang tahimik na isipin; ito ay isang desisyon na nakikita ng iba at maaaring maglayo sa atin sa mga dating kaisipan o barkada. Hayaan nating ang ating pananampalataya ay maging isang kitang-kitang desisyon na nagtuturo sa iba patungo sa Kanya.
tl.godsLove: Napakabisa at kaakit-akit ng pag-ibig ng Diyos kaya hindi ito maitatago. Ang buhay at mga himala ni Hesus ay pagpapakita ng puso ng Diyos na umakit sa mga tao at lubos na nagpabago sa kanila. Hindi Niya tayo pinipilit, pero ang Kanyang kabutihan ay sapat na para anyayahan tayong iwan ang lahat para sa Kanya.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ikaw inaanyayahan ni Hesus na "iwanan" ang isang lumang pag-iisip upang mas lubusan kang maniwala at magtiwala sa Kanya?

en.understanding: This verse marks the beginning of what we call Holy Week, on a Sunday. A huge crowd of people, many from Jesus' home region, were in town for a big festival. They were so excited to hear He was finally arriving in Jerusalem, an event so important it's recorded in all four Gospels.
en.livingItOut: Just as the crowd eagerly welcomed Jesus, we can welcome Him into our day with the same excitement. Let's not just go through our routines, but actively look for Him and celebrate His presence in our work, our family, and our quiet moments.
en.godsLove: God’s love is seen in Jesus' willingness to enter the city, even knowing it would lead to the cross. He didn't turn back from the path that would bring our salvation. His arrival was a deliberate act of love, stepping closer to paying the price for us.
en.reflection: How can I prepare my heart to joyfully welcome Jesus into every part of my life this week?

tl.understanding: Dito nagsisimula ang tinatawag nating Holy Week, sa araw ng Linggo. Isang napakalaking grupo ng tao, na karamihan ay mga kababayan ni Jesus, ang nasa siyudad para sa isang malaking Pista. Sobrang sabik nilang marinig na paparating na si Jesus sa Jerusalem, at napaka-importante ng pangyayaring ito kaya nakasulat ito sa lahat ng apat na Gospels.
tl.livingItOut: Kung paanong sabik na sinalubong ng mga tao si Jesus, pwede rin natin Siyang salubungin nang may parehong pananabik sa ating araw-araw. Huwag lang nating daanan ang ating mga gawain, kundi hanapin natin Siya at ipagdiwang ang Kanyang presensya sa ating trabaho, pamilya, at sa mga sandali ng katahimikan.
tl.godsLove: Makikita natin ang pag-ibig ng Diyos sa pagpasok ni Jesus sa siyudad, kahit alam Niyang ito ang daan patungo sa krus. Hindi Siya tumalikod sa landas na magdadala ng ating kaligtasan. Ang Kanyang pagdating ay isang sinadyang kilos ng pagmamahal para iligtas tayo.
tl.reflection: Paano ko maihahanda ang aking puso para masayang salubungin si Jesus sa bawat bahagi ng buhay ko ngayong linggo?

en.understanding: The palm branches were like a national flag, a symbol of celebration and hope for freedom. The crowd welcomed Jesus as a conquering hero, a king they believed would save them from their enemies. They were cheering for a political king, not fully understanding His true mission.
en.livingItOut: Let's check our own hearts. Do we sometimes celebrate Jesus more for the blessings He can give us, rather than for who He truly is? Let's worship Him as our Lord and Savior, not just as a problem-solver who fits our plans.
en.godsLove: Isn't God's love amazing? Jesus knew the crowd misunderstood His purpose, and that many would soon turn against Him. Yet, He still rode into Jerusalem toward the cross, because His love for them—and for us—was that deep and determined.
en.reflection: In what area of my life do I need to let go of my own expectations and fully trust Jesus' plan for me as King?

tl.understanding: Ang mga sanga ng palma ay parang watawat ng kanilang bansa, isang simbolo ng selebrasyon at pag-asang makalaya. Sinalubong nila si Jesus na parang isang matagumpay na bayani, isang hari na inakala nilang magliligtas sa kanila mula sa mga kaaway. Ang hinihiyawan nila ay isang haring pulitikal, hindi pa nila lubos na nauunawaan ang Kanyang tunay na misyon.
tl.livingItOut: Suriin natin ang ating mga puso. Minsan ba, ipinagdiriwang natin si Jesus dahil lang sa mga biyayang makukuha natin, sa halip na para sa kung sino talaga Siya? Sambahin natin Siya bilang ating Panginoon at Tagapagligtas, hindi lang bilang solusyon sa mga problemang umaayon sa ating mga plano.
tl.godsLove: Hindi ba't kamangha-mangha ang pag-ibig ng Diyos? Alam ni Jesus na mali ang pagkaunawa ng mga tao sa Kanyang misyon, at marami sa kanila ang tatalikod din sa Kanya. Ngunit, pumasok pa rin Siya sa Jerusalem patungo sa krus, dahil ganoon kalalim at katatag ang pagmamahal Niya sa kanila—at sa atin.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay ko kailangan kong bitawan ang sarili kong mga inaasahan at lubos na magtiwala sa plano ni Jesus bilang Hari para sa akin?

en.understanding: Jesus chose a humble donkey instead of a powerful warhorse to enter Jerusalem. This showed everyone He was not a king who came to fight, but a King who came to bring peace. His entrance fulfilled a prophecy and revealed the gentle nature of His kingdom.
en.livingItOut: In our own conflicts, we can choose the "donkey" path of humility instead of the "warhorse" path of aggression. Let's try to bring peace and understanding to our relationships, rather than trying to win every argument. True strength is often found in gentleness.
en.godsLove: God's love is so gentle that He didn't come to us with force, but with humility and an invitation. This picture of Jesus on a donkey shows us that our King is approachable, kind, and wants to give us life, not conquer us. He meets us where we are with incredible tenderness.
en.reflection: In what area of your life is God inviting you to show His gentle strength instead of your own forceful power?

tl.understanding: Pinili ni Jesus ang isang mapagkumbabang asno sa halip na isang kabayong pandigma sa pagpasok Niya sa Jerusalem. Ipinakita nito sa lahat na Siya ay hindi isang haring dumating para makipaglaban, kundi isang Hari na nagdadala ng kapayapaan. Tinupad nito ang isang hula at ipinakita ang kabutihan ng Kanyang kaharian.
tl.livingItOut: Sa mga hindi pagkakaunawaan, pwede nating piliin ang daan ng "asno"—ang pagpapakumbaba—sa halip na ang daan ng "kabayong pandigma" na laging nakikipag-away. Subukan nating magdala ng kapayapaan sa ating mga relasyon, sa halip na laging ipilit na tayo ang panalo.
tl.godsLove: Napakabuti ng pag-ibig ng Diyos; hindi Niya tayo pinilit, kundi lumapit Siya nang may pagpapakumbaba at paanyaya. Ang larawang ito ni Jesus sa asno ay nagpapakita na ang ating Hari ay madaling lapitan, mabait, at nais tayong bigyan ng buhay, hindi sakupin.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ka inaanyayahan ng Diyos na ipakita ang Kanyang mahinahong lakas sa halip na ang sarili mong pwersa?

en.understanding: This verse describes Jesus's Triumphal Entry, but the happy scene had a dangerous background. As crowds cheered for Jesus as their King, the religious leaders were secretly plotting to arrest and kill Him. This moment of public praise was filled with tension and risk for Jesus.
en.livingItOut: Like the people then, we face a choice to either praise Jesus or stay silent. Let's choose to worship Him openly in our lives, even when it's not popular or understood by others. Don't let fear quiet your praise for the King.
en.godsLove: God’s love is revealed in the kind of King Jesus is—He is humble and gentle, not a terrifying warrior. He knew the cross was waiting for Him in Jerusalem, but His love for you was so great that He bravely rode in to complete His mission of salvation.
en.reflection: In what area of my life do I need to stop being afraid and start welcoming Jesus as my gentle and humble King?

tl.understanding: Inilalarawan ng talatang ito ang Triumphal Entry ni Hesus, pero may panganib sa likod ng masayang tagpong ito. Habang sumisigaw ng papuri ang mga tao para kay Hesus bilang kanilang Hari, ang mga pinuno ng relihiyon ay lihim na nagpaplanong arestuhin at patayin Siya. Kaya ang sandali ng papuri ay puno rin ng tensyon para kay Hesus.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ng mga tao noon, may pagpili tayong gagawin: ang purihin si Hesus o manahimik na lang. Piliin nating sambahin Siya nang hayagan sa ating buhay, kahit hindi ito sikat o naiintindihan ng iba. Huwag mong hayaang patahimikin ng takot ang iyong papuri para sa Hari.
tl.godsLove: Makikita ang pag-ibig ng Diyos sa klase ng Hari na si Hesus—Siya ay mapagkumbaba at mahinahon, hindi isang nakakatakot na mandirigma. Alam Niyang naghihintay ang krus sa Jerusalem, pero dahil sa tindi ng pagmamahal Niya sa'yo, matapang pa rin Siyang pumasok para tapusin ang Kanyang misyon na iligtas tayo.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay ko ako kailangang tumigil sa pagkatakot at simulang tanggapin si Hesus bilang aking mahinahon at mapagkumbabang Hari?

en.understanding: At the time, even Jesus' closest friends didn't fully grasp what was happening. It was only after His resurrection and the coming of the Holy Spirit that everything "clicked" for them. They finally saw how Jesus was the perfect fulfillment of what the Old Testament had promised all along.
en.livingItOut: There may be things in our lives right now that don't make sense. Like the disciples, let's trust that God has a plan, and ask the Holy Spirit to give us understanding and clarity in His perfect time. We don't have to figure everything out today.
en.godsLove: God is so patient with our process of understanding. He doesn't get upset when we're confused; instead, He lovingly provides the Holy Spirit to be our Teacher and Helper. He delights in revealing truth to us, step by step.
en.reflection: Is there something you're struggling to understand in your life, where you can ask the Holy Spirit for peace and trust in God's timing?

tl.understanding: Noong una, kahit ang mga alagad ni Jesus ay nalilito at hindi lubos na naiintindihan ang mga pangyayari. Matapos lang Siyang muling mabuhay at dumating ang Banal na Espiritu, doon lang nila na-realize ang lahat. Nakita nila na si Jesus pala ang katuparan ng mga isinulat sa Kasulatan.
tl.livingItOut: Minsan, may mga bagay sa buhay natin na hindi natin maintindihan sa ngayon. Tulad ng mga alagad, magtiwala lang tayo na may plano ang Diyos, at hilingin sa Banal na Espiritu na bigyan tayo ng kaliwanagan sa Kanyang tamang panahon.
tl.godsLove: Napakapasensyoso ng pag-ibig ng Diyos sa atin. Hindi Siya naiinis kapag nalilito tayo; sa halip, buong pagmamahal Niyang ibinibigay ang Banal na Espiritu para maging Guro at Gabay natin. Nais Niyang unti-unti nating maunawaan ang Kanyang kalooban.
tl.reflection: Mayroon bang sitwasyon sa buhay mo ngayon na hindi mo maintindihan, kung saan maaari mong hilingin sa Banal na Espiritu ang kapayapaan habang nagtitiwala ka sa panahon ng Diyos?

en.understanding: This verse captures a moment of growing excitement and growing danger for Jesus. As eyewitnesses shared the incredible news of Lazarus being raised, a crowd of followers grew, but so did the plot of the religious leaders to stop Him. The testimony of God’s power was spreading like fire, forcing everyone to choose a side.
en.livingItOut: Like the people who saw Lazarus, we are also eyewitnesses to God's work in our own lives. Don't keep the good news to yourself; share your testimony of how Jesus has changed you, big or small. Your story can be the miracle someone else needs to hear today.
en.godsLove: God's love is so powerful that it can't be hidden, just like the news about Lazarus couldn't be contained. Even though Jesus knew that His growing fame would lead to the cross, He continued to show His power and love openly. He willingly walked toward danger for our sake.
en.reflection: What is one specific way God has been good to you this week that you can share with someone else?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita sa talatang ito ang sabay na paglago ng kasikatan at panganib sa buhay ni Jesus. Habang ibinabahagi ng mga nakasaksi ang himala ng pagkabuhay ni Lazarus, lalong dumarami ang sumusunod sa Kanya, pero lalo ring tumitindi ang plano ng mga lider na hulihin Siya. Ang testimonyo ng kapangyarihan ng Diyos ay kumakalat na parang apoy, na nag-uudyok sa lahat na mamili ng panig.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ng mga taong nakakita kay Lazarus, mga saksi rin tayo sa gawa ng Diyos sa ating buhay. Huwag nating sarilinin ang mabuting balita; ibahagi natin ang ating testimonyo kung paano binago ni Jesus ang buhay natin, maliit man o malaki. Ang kwento mo ay maaaring ang himalang kailangang marinig ng iba ngayon.
tl.godsLove: Napakalakas ng pag-ibig ng Diyos kaya hindi ito maitatago, tulad ng balita tungkol kay Lazarus na kumalat. Kahit alam ni Jesus na ang Kanyang kasikatan ay hahantong sa krus, patuloy pa rin Siyang nagpakita ng Kanyang kapangyarihan at pagmamahal. Hinarap Niya ang panganib nang kusa para sa atin.
tl.reflection: Ano ang isang partikular na kabutihan na ginawa ng Diyos para sa'yo nitong linggo na maaari mong ibahagi sa iba?

en.understanding: This verse shows us that as Jesus performed miracles, two things were happening at once. A huge crowd was getting excited and praising Him, but at the same time, the religious leaders were plotting against Him. Jesus' power and popularity were creating a big stir, attracting both followers and enemies.
en.livingItOut: Just like the news of Jesus' miracle spread and drew a crowd, our stories about what God has done can draw others to Him. Let's not be shy about sharing our testimony or a simple story of God's goodness in our lives this week. You never know whose heart might be stirred by hearing how He has worked.
en.godsLove: Jesus performed this incredible miracle out of deep love, not for a show. He knew that His growing fame would lead to His death, but His love for people was more important than His own safety. He willingly walked into Jerusalem, a city full of both praise and peril, all for us.
en.reflection: The crowd was drawn to Jesus because of a big miracle they heard about. What is it about Jesus that draws you to Him today, beyond just the amazing things He can do?

tl.understanding: Pinapakita ng talatang ito na habang gumagawa ng himala si Jesus, dalawang bagay ang sabay na nangyayari. Dumarami ang mga taong humahanga at pumupuri sa Kanya, pero kasabay nito, lalong tumitindi ang galit ng mga religious leaders. Ang kapangyarihan ni Jesus ay lumikha ng ingay na umakit sa marami at nagpagalit naman sa iba.
tl.livingItOut: Kung paanong kumalat ang balita tungkol sa himala ni Jesus at nakaakit ng maraming tao, ganoon din ang ating mga kwento ng kabutihan ng Diyos. Huwag tayong mahiyang mag-share ng ating testimony o simpleng kwento kung paano kumilos ang Diyos sa buhay natin. Hindi natin alam kung sino ang makakarinig at mapapalapit din sa Kanya.
tl.godsLove: Ginawa ni Jesus ang himala dahil sa tindi ng Kanyang pagmamahal at habag, hindi para magpasikat. Kahit alam Niyang magdudulot ito ng panganib sa Kanyang buhay, mas pinili Niyang ipakita ang pag-ibig Niya sa mga tao. Hinarap Niya ang papuri at panganib sa Jerusalem nang kusa, para sa ating lahat.
tl.reflection: Naakit ang mga tao kay Jesus dahil sa himalang nabalitaan nila. Ikaw, ano ang naglalapit sa'yo kay Jesus ngayon, bukod sa mga kamangha-manghang bagay na kaya Niyang gawin?

en.understanding: The Pharisees were complaining that their efforts to stop Jesus were failing. In their frustration, they said "the whole world" was following Him, but they didn't realize they were speaking a deeper truth. Jesus really did come to reach and save people from all over the world!
en.livingItOut: This reminds us that no human plan or opposition can ever stop God's work from moving forward. Let's live with confidence, knowing that when we are part of His mission, His purpose will ultimately succeed. Don't be discouraged by what looks like opposition.
en.godsLove: This verse reveals God's huge, inclusive heart for everyone. His love isn't just for one group of people; it's for the "whole world," and that includes you and me. God's plan of salvation was always meant to reach every single person.
en.reflection: Who is one person in your 'world' that you can pray for or share God's love with this week?

tl.understanding: Nagrereklamo ang mga Pariseo dahil bigo ang mga plano nilang pigilan si Jesus. Sa kanilang inis, sinabi nilang "ang buong mundo" na ang sumusunod sa Kanya, pero hindi nila alam na nagkatotoo ang sinabi nila. Dahil si Jesus ay tunay ngang naparito para iligtas ang mga tao sa buong mundo!
tl.livingItOut: Pinapaalala nito sa atin na walang sinumang tao o anumang pagkontra ang makakapigil sa plano ng Diyos. Kaya't mamuhay tayo nang may tiwala, dahil alam nating kapag kasama tayo sa Kanyang misyon, ang Kanyang layunin ay tiyak na magtatagumpay.
tl.godsLove: Ipinapakita nito kung gaano kalaki at bukas ang puso ng Diyos para sa lahat. Ang pag-ibig Niya ay hindi lang para sa iisang grupo ng tao; ito ay para sa "buong mundo," at kasama ka at ako doon.
tl.reflection: Sino ang isang tao sa 'mundo' mo na maaari mong ipagdasal o bahaginan ng pag-ibig ng Diyos ngayong linggo?

en.understanding: This verse shows us that even people from other nations, not just the Jews, were drawn to Jesus. It’s a beautiful picture that Jesus’ mission was never meant for just one group of people. His arms were, and still are, open to the entire world.
en.livingItOut: Just as the Greeks were welcomed, we are called to welcome others who may be different from us. Look for opportunities this week to share God’s love with a coworker, neighbor, or friend from a different background. Let’s be people who invite everyone to come and see Jesus.
en.godsLove: This small detail reveals God's huge, inclusive heart! His love isn't limited by borders, language, or culture; it's for everyone, everywhere. He sees and values every person and desires for them to know Him personally.
en.reflection: Who is a "Greek" in your life—someone different from you—that you can show God's welcoming love to this week?

tl.understanding: Pinapakita sa talatang ito na kahit ang mga taga-ibang bansa, hindi lang mga Hudyo, ay gustong makilala si Jesus. Ito ay isang magandang paalala na ang misyon ni Jesus ay para sa lahat ng tao. Bukas ang Kanyang mga kamay para sa buong mundo.
tl.livingItOut: Kung paanong tinanggap ang mga Griyego, tinatawag din tayong maging bukas sa mga taong iba sa atin. Humanap tayo ng pagkakataon ngayong linggo na ibahagi ang pag-ibig ng Diyos sa isang katrabaho, kapitbahay, o kaibigan na may ibang lahi o kultura. Maging tulay tayo para makalapit din sila kay Jesus.
tl.godsLove: Inihahayag ng maliit na detalyeng ito ang napakalaking puso ng Diyos para sa lahat! Ang pag-ibig Niya ay walang pinipiling lahi, salita, o kultura; ito ay para sa bawat isa. Nakikita at pinapahalagahan Niya ang lahat ng tao at nais Niyang makilala Siya ng personal.
tl.reflection: Sino ang "Griyego" sa buhay mo ngayon—isang taong iba sa iyo—na maaari mong pagpakitaan ng pag-ibig at pagtanggap ng Diyos ngayong linggo?

en.understanding: Ever wonder why these Greeks chose Philip? His Greek name likely made him seem approachable and familiar to them. He acted as a friendly bridge, connecting people from a different culture directly to Jesus.
en.livingItOut: We can be a 'Philip' to someone today. Our background, job, or even our hobbies can make us relatable to others who don't know Jesus yet. Let's be the friendly face that helps someone take their first step toward Him.
en.godsLove: This little detail shows God's big heart for everyone, no matter their background. He lovingly places people like Philip—and like you—in specific circles to be a welcoming connection to Him. His invitation to 'see Jesus' is open to all.
en.reflection: What part of your unique story or background can be a bridge to help someone you know 'see Jesus'?

tl.understanding: Naisip mo ba kung bakit si Philip ang nilapitan ng mga Griyego? Dahil sa kanyang pangalang Griyego, naging palagay siguro ang loob nila at madali siyang lapitan. Nagsilbi siyang tulay para maipakilala si Jesus sa mga taong mula sa ibang kultura.
tl.livingItOut: Pwede tayong maging isang 'Philip' sa isang tao ngayon. Ang ating background, trabaho, o hobbies ay pwedeng maging dahilan para maging komportable ang iba sa atin. Maging friendly face tayo na tutulong sa kanila na makalapit kay Hesus.
tl.godsLove: Ipinapakita ng maliit na detalyeng ito ang malaking puso ng Diyos para sa lahat, anuman ang kanilang pinagmulan. Magiliw Niyang inilalagay ang mga taong tulad ni Philip—at tulad mo—sa mga partikular na grupo para maging tulay patungo sa Kanya.
tl.reflection: Anong bahagi ng iyong kwento o background ang pwedeng maging tulay para matulungan ang isang kakilala mo na 'makita si Jesus'?

en.understanding: This simple act happens during a very tense time for Jesus. As His popularity was growing, so was the danger from the religious leaders who wanted to stop Him. In the middle of this rising conflict, Philip and Andrew show us that their focus remained on one thing: bringing people to Jesus.
en.livingItOut: Like Philip, sometimes we need a friend to help us share our faith or serve others. We don't have to bring people to Jesus all by ourselves. Partnering with a fellow believer can give us the courage and support we need to step out in faith.
en.godsLove: God's love is so welcoming. Even with the cross just days away and His enemies plotting against Him, Jesus never turned away those who were sincerely seeking Him. His heart was, and still is, always open to everyone.
en.reflection: Who is the "Andrew" in your life that you can partner with this week to help introduce someone to Jesus?

tl.understanding: Nangyari ang simpleng eksenang ito sa isang napakatensyonadong panahon. Habang sumisikat si Jesus, lalo ring tumitindi ang panganib mula sa mga lider ng relihiyon na gustong pumigil sa Kanya. Sa gitna ng lahat ng ito, ipinapakita nina Felipe at Andres na iisa lang ang focus nila: ang ilapit ang mga tao kay Jesus.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ni Felipe, minsan kailangan din natin ng kasama para magbahagi ng ating pananampalataya o maglingkod sa iba. Hindi natin kailangang mag-isang magdala ng mga tao kay Jesus. Ang pakikipag-partner sa isang kapanalig ay makapagbibigay sa atin ng lakas ng loob na humakbang para sa Kanya.
tl.godsLove: Ang pag-ibig ng Diyos ay laging bukas para tumanggap. Kahit ilang araw na lang bago Siya ipako sa krus at may mga planong masama ang Kanyang mga kaaway, hindi Niya tinalikuran ang sinumang tunay na naghahanap sa Kanya. Ang puso Niya ay laging bukas para sa lahat.
tl.reflection: Sino ang ‘Andres’ sa buhay mo na maaari mong maging kasama ngayong linggo para tulungang ipakilala ang isang tao kay Jesus?

en.understanding: For a long time, Jesus said it wasn't the right time for his mission's climax. But when these non-Jews (Greeks) came seeking him, it was a sign that the moment had finally arrived. This "hour" of glory wasn't just about praise; it was about His coming sacrifice on the cross and His victory through resurrection, meant for the whole world.
en.livingItOut: God has a perfect time for everything in our lives, even the difficult things He calls us to do. Let's be sensitive to His leading and be ready to obey when He says, "The hour has come" for us to step out in faith. This could be for a new ministry, a challenging conversation, or a big life change.
en.godsLove: God's love is so immense that He saw the cross not as a defeat, but as the path to glory and salvation for all people. Jesus' heart was for the whole world, and His death was the ultimate act of love to bring everyone, including you and me, back to Him.
en.reflection: Is there an area in your life where you feel God might be saying, "The hour has come" for you to trust and obey Him, even if it looks difficult?

tl.understanding: Matagal nang sinasabi ni Jesus na hindi pa ito ang tamang oras para sa Kanyang misyon. Pero nang may mga Griyego (hindi Hudyo) na lumapit para makita Siya, naging hudyat ito na dumating na ang sandali. Ang "oras ng Kanyang kaluwalhatian" ay hindi lang tungkol sa papuri; ito ay tungkol sa Kanyang sakripisyo sa krus at tagumpay sa muling pagkabuhay para sa buong mundo.
tl.livingItOut: May perpektong timing ang Diyos para sa lahat ng bagay sa buhay natin, kahit sa mga mahihirap na ipinapagawa Niya. Maging sensitibo tayo sa Kanyang pagkilos at maging handang sumunod kapag sinabi Niyang, "Dumating na ang oras" para tayo ay humakbang sa pananampalataya.
tl.godsLove: Napakalawak ng pag-ibig ng Diyos na nakita Niya ang krus hindi bilang pagkatalo, kundi bilang daan patungo sa kaluwalhatian at kaligtasan ng lahat. Ang puso ni Jesus ay para sa buong mundo, at ang Kanyang kamatayan ang sukdulang pagpapakita ng pag-ibig para maibalik tayong lahat, kasama ka, sa Kanya.
tl.reflection: Mayroon bang bahagi ng buhay mo kung saan nararamdaman mong sinasabi ng Diyos, “Dumating na ang oras,” para magtiwala ka at sumunod sa Kanya, kahit na ito ay mukhang mahirap?

en.understanding: Jesus uses a simple picture of a seed to explain a powerful truth about His own death. Just like a single seed must be buried and "die" to grow into a plant with many fruits, His death on the cross was necessary to bring new and abundant life to all of us. Through His great sacrifice, a huge spiritual harvest became possible.
en.livingItOut: This verse also calls us to "die" to our own selfish desires, pride, and personal plans. When we surrender our will to God, He can work through us to produce spiritual fruit, like love and kindness, that blesses the people around us. Letting go of our control allows God to bring forth something new and beautiful in our lives.
en.godsLove: See the incredible depth of God's love in this verse. Jesus willingly chose the path of the cross, the ultimate act of "dying," so that He wouldn't remain alone but could bring you and me into His family. His death was the ultimate sacrifice, all done so we could have abundant life with Him.
en.reflection: In what area of your life is God gently asking you to "die" to your own plans so He can produce new fruit?

tl.understanding: Gumamit si Jesus ng isang simpleng halimbawa ng buto para ipaliwanag ang isang malalim na katotohanan. Tulad ng isang buto na kailangang "mamatay" sa lupa para tumubo at magbunga nang marami, kailangan din Niyang mamatay sa krus para mabigyan tayo ng bago at masaganang buhay. Dahil sa Kanyang sakripisyo, naging posible ang isang malaking espirituwal na anihan.
tl.livingItOut: Tinatawag din tayo ng talatang ito na "mamatay" sa ating mga sariling kagustuhan, pride, at personal na plano. Kapag isinuko natin ang ating kalooban sa Diyos, mas malaya Siyang makakakilos sa atin para magbunga ng pag-ibig at kabutihan na magpapala sa iba. Ang pagbitaw natin ay nagbibigay-daan sa Diyos na lumikha ng bago at maganda sa ating buhay.
tl.godsLove: Damhin ang napakalalim na pag-ibig ng Diyos dito. Kusang-loob na pinili ni Jesus ang daan ng krus, ang sukdulang sakripisyo, para hindi Siya manatiling nag-iisa at para maisama ka Niya sa Kanyang pamilya. Ang Kanyang kamatayan ang nagbigay daan para magkaroon tayo ng masaganang buhay kasama Siya.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon ang marahan kang tinatawag ng Diyos na isuko ang iyong sariling plano para Siya naman ang makapagpatubo ng bagong bunga?

en.understanding: Jesus is teaching us a surprising truth: holding on too tightly to our own plans and worldly comforts can make us miss the true, eternal life He offers. When we choose to put Him first, even when it means sacrifice, we are actually gaining a life that is fuller and lasts forever.
en.livingItOut: This means choosing God's will over our own comfort, even in small ways. It could be as simple as putting our phone down to listen to a friend, or choosing to serve others when we'd rather relax. These small sacrifices show that we value Jesus more than our own temporary desires.
en.godsLove: This isn't a command from a harsh God, but an invitation from a loving Father. He knows that true, lasting joy isn't found in this world, but in Him. He asks us to let go of things that will fade so He can give us something that will last forever: Himself.
en.reflection: What is one area of my life—my time, my plans, or my desires—that I can open up and surrender to Jesus today?

tl.understanding: Itinuturo sa atin ni Jesus ang isang nakakagulat na katotohanan: kung masyado tayong kumakapit sa ating mga plano at sa mga bagay dito sa mundo, baka hindi natin makuha ang tunay na buhay na walang hanggan. Kapag pinili nating unahin Siya, kahit na may kasamang sakripisyo, doon natin makakamit ang buhay na mas ganap at magpakailanman.
tl.livingItOut: Ibig sabihin nito ay piliin ang kalooban ng Diyos kaysa sa ating sariling kaginhawahan, kahit sa maliliit na paraan. Pwedeng kasing simple ng pagbaba ng phone para makinig sa kaibigan, o pagpiling mag-serve sa iba kahit gusto nating magpahinga. Ang mga maliliit na sakripisyong ito ay nagpapakita na mas mahalaga sa atin si Jesus kaysa sa ating mga pansamantalang kagustuhan.
tl.godsLove: Hindi ito utos mula sa isang malupit na Diyos, kundi isang paanyaya mula sa isang mapagmahal na Ama. Alam Niya na ang tunay at pangmatagalang kagalakan ay hindi matatagpuan sa mundong ito, kundi sa Kanya. Hinihiling Niya na bitawan natin ang mga bagay na lilipas din para maibigay Niya ang pinakamahalaga sa lahat: Siya mismo.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng aking buhay—oras, plano, o pangarap—ang maaari kong buksan at ipagkatiwala kay Jesus ngayon?

en.understanding: Jesus spoke these words as crowds were praising Him, but also as leaders were plotting against Him. Following Him wasn't just about joining a popular movement; it was a call to commit to Him even when the path gets difficult and dangerous. True service means following Jesus wherever He leads.
en.livingItOut: This encourages us to go beyond just admiring Jesus and actually walk in His steps daily. It might mean choosing honesty at work when others are not, or showing kindness to someone who is difficult. We follow Him not just when it’s easy, but especially when it’s a challenge.
en.godsLove: Isn't it amazing that God doesn't just ask us to follow, but promises to be *with* us wherever we go? His love is shown in His incredible promise: while the world may not always approve, our Heavenly Father sees our quiet acts of service and will personally honor us. That’s how much our faithfulness means to Him.
en.reflection: In what area of my life is Jesus inviting me to follow Him more closely, trusting that His presence and the Father's honor are my greatest rewards?

tl.understanding: Sinabi ni Jesus ang mga salitang ito noong kasagsagan ng Kanyang kasikatan, pero kasabay nito ay ang pagpaplano ng mga lider na saktan Siya. Ang pagsunod sa Kanya ay hindi lang pagsali sa kung ano ang uso; ito ay panawagan na manindigan para sa Kanya kahit na ang daan ay maging mahirap at delikado.
tl.livingItOut: Hinihikayat tayo nito na hindi lang hangaan si Jesus, kundi talagang lakaran ang Kanyang mga yapak sa araw-araw. Maaaring ito ay pagpili ng katapatan sa trabaho kahit hindi ito ginagawa ng iba, o pagiging mabait sa taong mahirap pakisamahan. Sinusundan natin Siya hindi lang kapag madali, kundi lalo na kapag ito ay isang hamon.
tl.godsLove: Hindi ba't kamangha-mangha na hindi lang tayo inuutusang sumunod, kundi pinapangakuan pa Niya na sasamahan tayo saan man tayo magpunta? Dito natin nakikita ang Kanyang pag-ibig: kahit hindi man tayo sang-ayunan ng mundo, nakikita ng ating Ama sa langit ang ating simpleng paglilingkod at Siya mismo ang magpaparangal sa atin. Ganoon kahalaga sa Kanya ang ating katapatan.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay ko ako inaanyayahan ni Jesus na mas malapit na sumunod sa Kanya, na may tiwalang ang Kanyang presensya at ang parangal mula sa Ama ang aking pinakadakilang gantimpala?

en.understanding: Jesus was fully human, and in this moment, He felt deep emotional pain. The word "troubled" means serious anguish, showing He wasn't a robot without feelings. Yet, even in His distress, He chose to follow the Father's purpose for His life instead of running from the pain.
en.livingItOut: When you feel overwhelmed or afraid, remember Jesus' example. It’s okay to tell God you’re hurting, but then choose to trust His purpose over your comfort. Your calling in Christ is so much greater than your temporary feelings of fear or pain.
en.godsLove: This verse reveals a profound love. Jesus willingly faced unimaginable anguish not for Himself, but for you and me. His love was so strong that it overcame His human desire to escape, all to bring us back to the Father.
en.reflection: In what area of your life right now is God inviting you to trust His purpose, even when your feelings are telling you to pull back?

tl.understanding: Si Hesus ay totoong tao, at dito'y nakaramdam Siya ng matinding pagkabagabag. Ang salitang "troubled" ay nangangahulugan ng sobrang bigat sa puso, patunay na hindi Siya robot na walang emosyon. Sa kabila ng Kanyang nararamdaman, pinili pa rin Niyang sundin ang layunin ng Ama kaysa takasan ang sakit.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag ikaw ay nakakaramdam ng bigat o takot, alalahanin natin ang halimbawa ni Hesus. Okay lang na sabihin sa Diyos na nasasaktan ka, pero piliin pa ring magtiwala sa Kanyang layunin kaysa sa sarili mong kaginhawaan. Mas mahalaga ang purpose mo sa Kanya kaysa sa pansamantalang takot o sakit.
tl.godsLove: Ipinapakita ng talatang ito ang napakalalim na pag-ibig. Hinarap ni Hesus ang matinding pagdurusa hindi para sa Kanyang sarili, kundi para sa ating lahat. Napakatindi ng pag-ibig Niya kaya't nadaig nito ang natural na pagnanais na umiwas sa sakit, para lang maibalik Niya tayo sa Ama.
tl.reflection: Sa anong aspeto ng buhay mo ngayon ka tinatawag ng Diyos na magtiwala sa Kanyang layunin, kahit na ang nararamdaman mo ay gusto nang umatras?

en.understanding: When Jesus prayed for the Father's name to be glorified, God's voice from heaven confirmed something amazing. God said He had *already* shown His glory through Jesus' life and miracles, and He would show it again in the most powerful way at the cross. For Jesus, the cross wasn't just a moment of suffering; it was His moment of ultimate glory and victory.
en.livingItOut: Just as Jesus' life was all about glorifying the Father, we can make that our goal too. In our work, in our families, and even in our difficult moments, we can pause and ask, "God, how can I bring honor to Your name in this situation?" Our lives become an act of worship when we live for His glory.
en.godsLove: Isn't it beautiful that God's greatest moment of glory is also His greatest act of love for us? The cross, where His name was glorified, is the very place where He paid for our sins. His perfect glory and His deep love for you are forever intertwined in that one powerful moment.
en.reflection: In what small, everyday area of your life can you intentionally choose to glorify God's name this week?

tl.understanding: Nang manalangin si Jesus na luwalhatiin ang pangalan ng Ama, may boses mula sa langit na kumumpirma ng isang napakagandang bagay. Sinabi ng Diyos na naipakita na Niya ang Kanyang kaluwalhatian sa pamamagitan ng buhay at mga himala ni Jesus, at ipapakita Niya itong muli sa pinakamakapangyarihang paraan—sa krus. Para kay Jesus, ang krus ay hindi lang pagdurusa, kundi ito ang sandali ng Kanyang pinakadakilang tagumpay at kaluwalhatian.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ni Jesus na ang layunin ay bigyang-luwalhati ang Ama, maaari din nating gawing layunin ito. Sa ating trabaho, pamilya, at kahit sa gitna ng pagsubok, huminto tayo sandali at itanong, "Panginoon, paano po Kita mapaparangalan sa sitwasyong ito?" Nagiging pagsamba ang ating buhay kapag namumuhay tayo para sa Kanyang kaluwalhatian.
tl.godsLove: Hindi ba't napakaganda na ang pinakadakilang sandali ng kaluwalhatian ng Diyos ay Siya ring pinakadakilang pagpapakita ng pag-ibig Niya para sa atin? Ang krus, kung saan naluwalhati ang Kanyang pangalan, ang mismong lugar kung saan Niya binayaran ang ating mga kasalanan. Ang Kanyang kaluwalhatian at pag-ibig para sa'yo ay magkaugnay magpakailanman.
tl.reflection: Sa anong maliit at pang-araw-araw na bahagi ng buhay mo ang maaari mong sadyain na piliing luwalhatiin ang pangalan ng Diyos sa linggong ito?

en.understanding: When God the Father spoke from heaven, the crowd was confused and couldn't understand what was happening. They thought it was just thunder or an angel. This shows us that spiritual truth isn't always obvious, and we often need the Holy Spirit to help us recognize God's voice.
en.livingItOut: Sometimes, we may not understand what God is doing in our lives right away. Instead of getting discouraged, we can be patient and ask the Holy Spirit for wisdom. Trust that in His perfect time, He will make His will and His ways clear to us.
en.godsLove: Even though the crowd was confused, God the Father spoke to publicly honor and validate His Son, Jesus. This is a beautiful picture of the Father's deep love and pride in Jesus. It reminds us that God always affirms and stands by His Son, and through Him, He stands by us.
en.reflection: In what area of your life do you need to patiently trust God for understanding, believing He will make things clear at the right time?

tl.understanding: Nang magsalita ang Diyos Ama mula sa langit, nalito ang mga tao at hindi nila naintindihan ang nangyayari. Akala nila ay kulog lang ito o isang anghel. Pinapakita nito na minsan, hindi agad malinaw ang mga bagay na espirituwal, at kailangan natin ang tulong ng Banal na Espiritu para makilala ang boses ng Diyos.
tl.livingItOut: May mga pagkakataon na hindi natin agad naiintindihan ang plano ng Diyos sa ating buhay. Sa halip na panghinaan ng loob, maging pasensyoso tayo at hilingin sa Banal na Espiritu na bigyan tayo ng karunungan. Magtiwala tayo na sa Kanyang tamang panahon, lilinawin Niya ang Kanyang kalooban para sa atin.
tl.godsLove: Kahit hindi naintindihan ng mga tao, nagsalita ang Diyos Ama para parangalan at ipakilala ang Kanyang Anak na si Hesus. Ito ay isang magandang larawan ng malalim na pagmamahal at pagiging proud ng Ama kay Hesus. Pinapaalala nito na laging sinusuportahan ng Diyos ang Kanyang Anak, at dahil kay Hesus, sinusuportahan din Niya tayo.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon kailangan mong magtiwala nang may pasensya sa Diyos, na manalig na lilinawin Niya ang lahat sa tamang oras?

en.understanding: This event happened at a crucial time, with many people praising Jesus while leaders plotted against Him. The powerful voice from heaven wasn't to convince Jesus—He was secure in His mission. It was a clear sign for the crowd, meant to strengthen the faith of everyone who was listening.
en.livingItOut: God still gives us moments of confirmation—through a Bible verse that speaks to our heart, wise advice from a friend, or an answered prayer. Let's not just be amazed by these moments; let's allow them to truly build our faith and change how we live.
en.godsLove: This reveals a loving Father who goes out of His way to help us believe. That voice from heaven was a personal gift of encouragement for the people. God's love is so kind that He gives us the assurance we need to strengthen our faith journey.
en.reflection: When was a time God gave you a "voice"—a verse, a song, or a word from a friend—that felt like it was meant just for you?

tl.understanding: Nangyari ito sa isang mahalagang panahon kung saan marami ang naniniwala kay Hesus, pero marami ring kumakalaban sa Kanya. Ang boses mula sa langit ay hindi para kay Hesus, kundi para sa mga taong nakikinig, para tulungan silang manampalataya.
tl.livingItOut: Nagbibigay pa rin ang Diyos ng mga pagkakataon para patunayan ang Kanyang salita sa atin—sa isang Bible verse na tumagos sa puso, payo mula sa kaibigan, o sinagot na panalangin. Huwag lang tayong mamangha; hayaan nating patatagin nito ang ating pananampalataya at baguhin ang ating pamumuhay.
tl.godsLove: Ipinapakita nito ang isang mapagmahal na Ama na gumagawa ng paraan para tulungan tayong manalig. Ang boses mula sa langit ay isang personal na regalo para palakasin ang loob ng mga tao. Napakabuti ng pag-ibig ng Diyos; binibigyan Niya tayo ng katiyakan na kailangan natin para tumibay ang ating tiwala sa Kanya.
tl.reflection: Kailan ka huling binigyan ng Diyos ng "boses"—isang talata, isang awit, o isang salita mula sa kaibigan—na naramdaman mong para talaga sa iyo?

en.understanding: This verse was spoken at a crucial time when praise for Jesus and plots against Him were both at their peak. Jesus is revealing the true meaning of His coming death: it’s not a defeat, but a divine judgment that will defeat Satan, the "prince of this world." This is the ultimate spiritual showdown.
en.livingItOut: Because Satan has been defeated at the cross, we don't have to be controlled by fear, sin, or worldly pressures. Walk in the victory Jesus has already won for you today, knowing that the enemy's ultimate power over you is broken.
en.godsLove: God's love is so fierce that He didn't just leave us under the enemy's rule. He sent Jesus to fight our greatest battle and disarm the "prinsipe of this world" on our behalf. This verse shows a protective, powerful love that rescues us from darkness.
en.reflection: In which area of your life do you need to remember and apply the truth that Jesus has already defeated the enemy for you?

tl.understanding: Sinabi ang talatang ito sa isang mahalagang panahon kung saan dumarami ang pumupuri kay Jesus, pero lumalakas din ang plano laban sa Kanya. Ipinapaliwanag ni Jesus ang tunay na kahulugan ng Kanyang paparating na kamatayan: hindi ito pagkatalo, kundi isang banal na paghatol na tatalo kay Satanas, ang "prinsipe ng sanlibutang ito."
tl.livingItOut: Dahil talo na si Satanas sa krus, hindi na tayo kailangang kontrolin ng takot, kasalanan, o ng mga panggigipit ng mundo. Mamuhay ka sa tagumpay na ipinanalo na ni Jesus para sa'yo, dahil alam mong wala nang tunay na kapangyarihan sa'yo ang kaaway.
tl.godsLove: Napakatindi ng pag-ibig ng Diyos kaya hindi Niya tayo basta iniwan sa ilalim ng kapangyarihan ng kaaway. Ipinadala Niya si Jesus upang labanan ang pinakamalaki nating laban at talunin ang "prinsipe ng sanlibutang ito" para sa atin. Ito ay pag-ibig na nagpoprotekta at nagliligtas mula sa kadiliman.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon kailangan mong alalahanin at isabuhay ang katotohanang natalo na ni Jesus ang kaaway para sa iyo?

en.understanding: Jesus said this during a very tense time, right before His crucifixion. While some people were celebrating Him, the leaders were planning to kill Him. Jesus explains that His death on the cross—being "lifted up"—wasn't a failure, but the very event that would draw all people to find salvation in Him.
en.livingItOut: Jesus is still drawing people to Himself today, and we get to be part of it. Let's look for opportunities to share His love and our own story with the people around us. Our simple testimony can be the way God helps draw someone closer to Jesus.
en.godsLove: This verse reveals God's huge, inclusive heart—He wants *everyone* to come to Him. Jesus’ death on the cross wasn't just for a small group, but was an open invitation for all people, from all places, to find forgiveness and new life in Him.
en.reflection: How has Jesus personally drawn you to Himself, and who is one person you can pray for to experience that same draw?

tl.understanding: Sinabi ito ni Jesus sa isang panahon na matindi ang tensyon, bago Siya ipako sa krus. Habang pinupuri Siya ng mga tao, plano naman ng mga lider na patayin Siya. Ipinaliwanag ni Jesus na ang Kanyang pagkamatay sa krus—ang pagiging "itataas"—ay hindi kabiguan, kundi ito mismo ang paraan para ilapit ang lahat ng tao sa Kanya para sa kaligtasan.
tl.livingItOut: Hanggang ngayon, patuloy na inilalapit ni Jesus ang mga tao sa Kanya, at kasama tayo sa misyon na ito. Humanap tayo ng pagkakataon na ibahagi ang pag-ibig Niya at ang ating kwento sa mga taong nakapaligid sa atin. Ang simpleng patotoo natin ay maaaring gamitin ng Diyos para mapalapit ang isang tao kay Jesus.
tl.godsLove: Ipinapakita ng talatang ito ang napakalaki at bukas na puso ng Diyos—nais Niyang lumapit sa Kanya ang *lahat*. Ang pagkamatay ni Jesus sa krus ay hindi para sa iilang tao lang, kundi isang bukas na paanyaya para sa lahat, saan man sila galing, para makatanggap ng kapatawaran at bagong buhay.
tl.reflection: Sa paanong paraan ka personal na inilapit ni Jesus sa Kanya, at sino ang isang tao na maaari mong ipanalangin na maranasan din ang paglapit na ito?

en.understanding: The Tyndale note explains that as Jesus' popularity grew, so did the plot to kill Him. In the middle of this rising tension, Jesus wasn't surprised or afraid. This verse shows that He was fully aware of His mission and was preparing His followers for the specific way He would die for them—by being "lifted up" on a cross.
en.livingItOut: Like Jesus, we can face pressure from both praise and criticism. Let's ask God for the grace to stay focused on our purpose, not on the changing opinions of others. When things get hard, we can trust that God’s plan is still at work, just as it was for Jesus.
en.godsLove: God’s love is so intentional. Jesus knew the immense suffering of the cross that awaited Him, yet He walked toward it willingly for you and me. His death was not a tragic accident; it was a purposeful act of rescue, planned out of His deep love for us.
en.reflection: In what area of your life do you need to trust God's plan, even when the path forward seems difficult or unclear?

tl.understanding: Paliwanag ng Tyndale note, habang dumarami ang humahanga kay Jesus, lumalakas din ang plano na patayin Siya. Sa gitna ng lahat ng ito, hindi Siya nagulat o natakot. Ipinapakita ng talatang ito na alam na alam ni Jesus ang Kanyang misyon at inihahanda Niya ang mga alagad sa uri ng kamatayan na haharapin Niya—ang maitaas sa krus.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni Jesus, nakakaranas din tayo ng pressure mula sa papuri at sa kritisismo. Humingi tayo sa Diyos ng tulong para manatiling nakatutok sa layunin Niya, at hindi sa pabago-bagong opinyon ng iba. Kapag mahirap ang sitwasyon, pwede tayong magtiwala na kumikilos pa rin ang plano ng Diyos, tulad ng nangyari kay Jesus.
tl.godsLove: Hindi aksidente ang pag-ibig ng Diyos; ito ay laging may plano. Alam ni Jesus ang matinding paghihirap sa krus na naghihintay sa Kanya, pero kusa Niya itong hinarap para sa iyo at sa akin. Ang Kanyang kamatayan ay hindi isang trahedya, kundi isang sinadyang pagliligtas na nagmula sa sobrang pagmamahal Niya sa atin.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon kailangan mong magtiwala sa plano ng Diyos, kahit na parang mahirap o hindi malinaw ang daan?

en.understanding: The people back then expected the Messiah to be a powerful king who would reign forever and defeat all their enemies. Jesus' talk about being "lifted up" to die on a cross didn't fit their picture of a Savior. They couldn't understand a Messiah who came to suffer first before reigning.
en.livingItOut: Sometimes, we also have our own ideas about how God should solve our problems. This verse reminds us to surrender our expectations to Him, trusting that His ways are higher and better than ours. Let's practice trusting His plan, even when it looks different from what we hoped for.
en.godsLove: God's deep love is shown in the very thing the crowd misunderstood—the cross. He didn't just send a political king; He sent a loving Savior willing to be "lifted up" to die for our sins. His plan wasn't just about earthly victory, but about your eternal rescue.
en.reflection: Is there an area in your life where you are holding onto your own plan, and you need to trust God's unexpected way instead?

tl.understanding: Inaasahan ng mga tao noon na ang Mesiyas ay isang makapangyarihang hari na maghahari habang-buhay at tatalunin ang lahat ng kalaban. Kaya't nang sabihin ni Jesus na kailangan Siyang "maitaas" para mamatay, hindi ito tugma sa kanilang inaasahan. Nalito sila sa konsepto ng isang Tagapagligtas na kailangang magdusa bago maghari.
tl.livingItOut: Minsan, tulad ng mga tao sa kwento, may sarili rin tayong ideya kung paano dapat ayusin ng Diyos ang ating mga problema. Paalala ito na isuko natin ang ating mga inaasahan sa Kanya, at magtiwalang mas mabuti ang Kanyang plano. Sanayin nating magtiwala sa Kanyang paraan, kahit iba ito sa ating inaasahan.
tl.godsLove: Makikita ang lalim ng pag-ibig ng Diyos sa mismong bagay na ikinalito ng mga tao—ang krus. Hindi lang Siya nagpadala ng isang hari, kundi isang maawaing Tagapagligtas na handang "maitaas" para sa ating mga kasalanan. Ang Kanyang plano ay hindi lang para sa panalo dito sa lupa, kundi para sa iyong walang hanggang kaligtasan.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon ka mahigpit na kumakapit sa sarili mong plano, at kailangan mo nang magtiwala sa hindi mo inaasahang paraan ng Diyos?

en.understanding: Jesus spoke these words during His final days in Jerusalem, right before He was crucified. As His popularity grew, the religious leaders were finalizing their plot to arrest Him. This verse is His loving and urgent warning for people to believe in Him while He was still physically there with them.
en.livingItOut: When God's Word or the Holy Spirit prompts our hearts, let's choose to obey right away. Let's not delay in following Jesus' teachings, treating every moment as a precious opportunity to walk in His light. Our best response to His leading is always "yes" and "now."
en.godsLove: God's love is so clear in this warning. He doesn't want us to get lost or stumble in the darkness of sin and confusion. Jesus’ urgent plea is a beautiful reminder that He lovingly calls us into the safety and clarity found only in Him.
en.reflection: What is one area in your life where you feel God is calling you to step out of the darkness and walk in His light today?

tl.understanding: Sinabi ito ni Hesus sa mga huling araw Niya sa Jerusalem, bago Siya ipako sa krus. Habang dumarami ang pumupuri sa Kanya, lalo namang nagiging matindi ang plano ng mga lider na ipahuli Siya. Ang talatang ito ay ang Kanyang mapagmahal at apurahang paalala na manalig na sila habang Siya ay kasama pa nila.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag nangusap ang Salita ng Diyos o ang Banal na Espiritu sa puso natin, piliin nating sumunod agad. Huwag na nating ipagpabukas ang pagsunod sa turo ni Hesus, at ituring ang bawat sandali bilang isang mahalagang pagkakataon na lumakad sa Kanyang liwanag.
tl.godsLove: Napakalinaw ng pag-ibig ng Diyos sa babalang ito. Ayaw Niyang maligaw tayo o madapa sa dilim ng kasalanan at pagkalito. Ang pakiusap ni Hesus ay isang magandang paalala na tinatawag Niya tayo patungo sa kaligtasan at kaliwanagan na sa Kanya lang matatagpuan.
tl.reflection: Saang bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon ka tinatawag ng Diyos na iwanan ang dilim at magsimulang maglakad sa Kanyang liwanag?

en.understanding: Jesus calls Himself "the Light" and gives the people an urgent choice. He is telling them to believe in Him while they still have the chance, because His time with them on earth is short. By believing in Him, we are transformed and become "sons of light" ourselves.
en.livingItOut: This verse reminds us not to delay our decision to follow Jesus wholeheartedly. Today is the day to respond to His invitation and walk closely with Him. Let's not take His presence and grace in our lives for granted.
en.godsLove: God's love is so great that He sent Jesus, the Light of the World, to find us in our darkness. He doesn't want anyone to miss the chance to know Him, so He lovingly warns us to come to Him now. Becoming a "son of light" is His beautiful gift and invitation to each of us.
en.reflection: In what area of your life is Jesus inviting you to stop delaying and fully step into His light today?

tl.understanding: Tinutukoy ni Jesus ang Kanyang sarili bilang "ang Ilaw" at binibigyan Niya ang mga tao ng isang mahalagang paalala. Sinasabi Niyang maniwala sila sa Kanya habang may pagkakataon pa, dahil limitado lang ang oras Niya sa mundo. Sa pamamagitan ng pananampalataya, tayo ay nababago at nagiging "mga anak ng liwanag."
tl.livingItOut: Paalala ito na huwag na nating ipagpabukas pa ang desisyong sumunod nang buong puso kay Jesus. Ngayon ang araw para tumugon sa Kanyang tawag at mamuhay nang malapit sa Kanya. Huwag nating balewalain ang Kanyang presensya at biyaya sa ating buhay.
tl.godsLove: Napakadakila ng pag-ibig ng Diyos kaya't sinugo Niya si Jesus, ang Ilaw ng Sanlibutan, para hanapin tayo sa ating kadiliman. Ayaw Niyang may makaligtaan sa pagkakataong makilala Siya, kaya't buong pagmamahal Niya tayong inaanyayahan. Ang pagiging "anak ng liwanag" ay Kanyang magandang regalo at imbitasyon sa atin.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ka inaanyayahan ni Jesus na huwag nang mag-atubili at tuluyan nang lumapit sa Kanyang liwanag ngayon?

en.understanding: Even after witnessing all of Jesus' incredible miracles and hearing His teachings, many people still refused to believe in Him. Jesus had shown them more than enough proof of who He was, but their hearts remained closed to the truth. His work was complete, but He was still rejected.
en.livingItOut: This reminds us that seeing God's blessings isn't enough; we must actively choose to believe and trust Him. Let's ask God to open our eyes to the everyday "signs" of His goodness around us and respond with a heart of faith, not doubt.
en.godsLove: Even in their unbelief, God's love is revealed through His incredible patience. Jesus didn't perform just one miracle; He performed "so many," giving them every possible chance to believe. His heart is to keep reaching out to us, even when we are slow to see or respond.
en.reflection: In what area of your life is God showing you a "sign" of His presence, inviting you to trust Him more deeply today?

tl.understanding: Kahit nakita na nila ang lahat ng mga himala ni Hesus at narinig ang Kanyang mga turo, marami pa rin ang hindi sumampalataya sa Kanya. Ipinakita na ni Hesus ang sapat na katibayan kung sino Siya, pero nanatiling sarado ang kanilang mga puso sa katotohanan.
tl.livingItOut: Paalala ito na hindi sapat na makita lang ang mga biyaya ng Diyos; kailangan nating piliing manalig at magtiwala sa Kanya. Hilingin natin sa Diyos na buksan ang ating mga mata sa mga pang-araw-araw na "himala" ng kabutihan Niya, at tumugon tayo nang may pananampalataya, hindi pagdududa.
tl.godsLove: Kahit sa gitna ng kanilang kawalan ng pananampalataya, makikita pa rin ang pag-ibig ng Diyos sa Kanyang pambihirang pasensya. Hindi lang isang himala ang ginawa ni Hesus, kundi "napakarami," para bigyan sila ng lahat ng pagkakataong maniwala. Nais ng puso Niya na patuloy na abutin tayo, kahit mabagal tayong makakita o tumugon.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon nagpapakita ang Diyos ng "tanda" ng Kanyang presensya, na nag-aanyayang magtiwala ka sa Kanya nang mas malalim?

en.understanding: John shows us two things happening at once: many people were praising Jesus, while the leaders were plotting against Him. This verse tells us that the people's unbelief, even after seeing so many miracles, was not a surprise to God. It was actually fulfilling a prophecy written by Isaiah hundreds of years before.
en.livingItOut: Sometimes, people may not understand our faith or things in our life don't make sense. This verse reminds us that God is always in control, working out His perfect plan even amidst confusion or rejection. Let's focus on being faithful to Him, trusting that He is sovereign over every situation.
en.godsLove: God's love is so powerful that nothing can stop His plan to save us. He knew that many would reject Jesus, but He sent His Son anyway because of His great love for you and me. His plan for our salvation was set in motion long ago and is completely unstoppable.
en.reflection: In what area of your life do you need to trust that God is in control, even when you can't see the full picture yet?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita ni John na may dalawang bagay na sabay na nangyayari: marami ang pumupuri kay Jesus, pero gusto Siyang pigilan ng mga lider. Sinasabi sa talatang ito na hindi ikinagulat ng Diyos ang hindi paniniwala ng mga tao, kahit nakakita sila ng mga himala. Sa katunayan, katuparan ito ng isang propesiya na isinulat ni Isaiah daan-daang taon na ang nakalipas.
tl.livingItOut: Minsan, maaaring hindi maunawaan ng iba ang ating pananampalataya o may mga bagay sa buhay natin na mahirap intindihin. Pinapaalala sa atin ng talatang ito na ang Diyos pa rin ang may kontrol sa lahat, na isinasakatuparan ang Kanyang perpektong plano kahit sa gitna ng gulo o pagtanggi. Magpokus tayo sa pagiging tapat sa Kanya, na may tiwalang hawak Niya ang bawat sitwasyon.
tl.godsLove: Napakalakas ng pag-ibig ng Diyos kaya walang makakapigil sa Kanyang plano na iligtas tayo. Alam Niyang marami ang tatanggi kay Jesus, pero isinugo pa rin Niya ang Kanyang Anak dahil sa laki ng pagmamahal Niya sa iyo at sa akin. Ang Kanyang plano para sa ating kaligtasan ay matagal nang itinakda at hinding-hindi mapipigilan.
tl.reflection: Saang bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon kailangan mong magtiwala na ang Diyos ang may hawak ng kontrol, kahit hindi mo pa nakikita ang kabuuan ng Kanyang plano?

en.understanding: John is explaining the two very different reactions people had to Jesus. While crowds were praising Him, many others, especially the religious leaders, were hardening their hearts. This verse shows that their stubborn unbelief wasn't a surprise to God; it was actually fulfilling what the prophet Isaiah wrote about long ago.
en.livingItOut: Every day, we face a choice to either soften our hearts to Jesus or harden them. Let’s actively choose faith by spending time in His Word and listening to His Spirit. We can protect our hearts from the kind of unbelief seen in this chapter by making a daily decision to trust Him.
en.godsLove: God's love is so faithful that His plan of salvation was never defeated by human rejection. He knew that many would not believe, yet He sent Jesus anyway for the sake of all who would receive Him. His love is powerful enough to work through even the most difficult circumstances to fulfill His promises.
en.reflection: In what area of your life do you need to intentionally keep your heart soft and open to what Jesus is saying to you today?

tl.understanding: Pinapakita dito ni John ang dalawang magkaibang reaksyon ng mga tao kay Jesus. Habang may mga pumupuri sa Kanya, marami naman, lalo na ang mga lider ng relihiyon, ang nagpatigas ng kanilang puso. Ang talatang ito ay nagsasabing hindi ikinagulat ng Diyos ang kanilang pagmamatigas; sa katunayan, ito ay katuparan ng isinulat ni propeta Isaias noon pa man.
tl.livingItOut: Araw-araw, hinaharap natin ang pagpili na palambutin o patigasin ang ating puso para kay Jesus. Piliin nating manampalataya sa pamamagitan ng paglaan ng oras sa Kanyang Salita at pakikinig sa Banal na Espiritu. Mapoprotektahan natin ang ating puso mula sa kawalan ng pananampalataya kung araw-araw tayong magdedesisyon na magtiwala sa Kanya.
tl.godsLove: Napakabuti ng pag-ibig ng Diyos dahil ang Kanyang plano ng kaligtasan ay hindi kailanman natalo ng pagtanggi ng tao. Alam Niyang marami ang hindi maniniwala, ngunit isinugo pa rin Niya si Jesus para sa lahat ng tatanggap sa Kanya. Ang pag-ibig Niya ay sapat ang lakas upang gumawa kahit sa gitna ng mahihirap na sitwasyon para matupad ang Kanyang mga pangako.
tl.reflection: Saang bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon ang kailangan mong sadyang panatilihing malambot at bukas ang iyong puso sa sinasabi sa iyo ni Jesus?

en.understanding: As Jesus’ ministry grew, so did the opposition from those who refused to believe. This verse explains the spiritual consequence of that refusal. When people persistently reject God's truth, He may allow their hearts to become hardened, making it difficult for them to see, understand, and turn to Him for healing.
en.livingItOut: Let's check our own hearts today. When God reveals a truth from His Word or convicts us of a sin, let’s respond with a soft heart and immediate obedience. Don't let pride or doubt harden your heart to what He is trying to show you.
en.godsLove: God’s heart is never to condemn, but to heal and save. This verse is a sorrowful warning, not a happy declaration from God. His love is shown in the countless opportunities He gives us to turn to Him before a heart becomes completely hard.
en.reflection: In what area of my life do I need to soften my heart and simply say "yes" to what God is asking of me today?

tl.understanding: Habang dumarami ang sumusunod kay Hesus, lumalakas din ang pagtanggi ng mga ayaw maniwala. Ipinaliliwanag ng talatang ito ang espirituwal na resulta ng pagmamatigas. Kapag patuloy na tinatanggihan ng tao ang katotohanan ng Diyos, hinahayaan Niyang tumigas ang kanilang puso, kaya nahihirapan na silang makakita, umunawa, at lumapit sa Kanya.
tl.livingItOut: Kumustahin natin ang ating mga puso ngayon. Kapag may itinuturo sa atin ang Diyos mula sa Kanyang Salita, tumugon tayo agad nang may malambot na puso at pagsunod. Huwag nating hayaang patigasin ng pride o pagdududa ang ating puso sa nais Niyang ipagawa.
tl.godsLove: Hindi kailanman nais ng Diyos na tayo ay mapahamak, kundi ang paghilumin at iligtas tayo. Ang talatang ito ay isang malungkot na babala, hindi isang masayang pahayag mula sa Diyos. Ang pag-ibig Niya ay makikita sa napakaraming pagkakataon na ibinibigay Niya para manumbalik tayo bago pa man tuluyang tumigas ang ating puso.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay ko kailangan kong palambutin ang aking puso at magsabi ng "oo" sa ipinapagawa ng Diyos sa akin ngayon?

en.understanding: This verse is a powerful reminder that the whole Bible is about Jesus. Centuries before Jesus was born, the prophet Isaiah was given a vision of His divine glory. So when Isaiah wrote his prophecies, he was actually writing about Jesus and how people would respond to Him.
en.livingItOut: Let's not just read the Old Testament as old stories, but as a book that points to our Savior. When you read the prophets or the Psalms, ask God to show you how they reveal Jesus's character and plan. This makes the entire Bible come alive in a new way!
en.godsLove: God's love is so patient and detailed. He didn't just suddenly send Jesus; He prepared His people for centuries, giving them glimpses of the Savior to come. This shows His plan to save us was always in His heart, woven through all of history.
en.reflection: As you read the Old Testament this week, how can you look for glimpses of Jesus's glory and love?

tl.understanding: Isang paalala ang talatang ito na ang buong Bibliya ay tungkol kay Hesus. Daan-daang taon bago pa isinilang si Hesus, nakita na ni propeta Isaias sa isang pangitain ang Kanyang kaluwalhatian. Kaya nang siya'y sumulat, si Hesus at ang magiging pagtanggap sa Kanya ng mga tao ang kanyang tinutukoy.
tl.livingItOut: Huwag nating basahin ang Old Testament na parang mga lumang kwento lang, kundi bilang aklat na nagtuturo sa ating Tagapagligtas. Kapag nagbabasa ka ng mga propeta o ng Psalms, hilingin mo sa Diyos na ipakita sa'yo si Hesus. Mas magiging buhay na buhay ang buong Bibliya para sa atin!
tl.godsLove: Napakatiyaga at detalyado ng pag-ibig ng Diyos. Hindi Niya biglaang isinugo si Hesus; inihanda Niya ang Kanyang bayan sa loob ng daan-daang taon, binibigyan sila ng mga sulyap sa darating na Tagapagligtas. Pinapakita nito na ang plano Niyang iligtas tayo ay laging nasa puso Niya, mula pa noon.
tl.reflection: Habang nagbabasa ka ng Old Testament ngayong linggo, paano mo hahanapin ang mga sulyap ng kaluwalhatian at pag-ibig ni Hesus?

en.understanding: This verse happens during a very tense time when Jesus' popularity was growing, but so was the anger of the religious authorities. The leaders mentioned here secretly believed in Jesus, but they were caught in the middle. They were too afraid of losing their status and being rejected by their powerful community.
en.livingItOut: Sometimes, we can be like these leaders, staying quiet about our faith because we're afraid of what others might think or say. Let's ask God for the courage to live out our faith openly, not letting fear of rejection hold us back from honoring Him in our daily lives.
en.godsLove: Even when these leaders were too afraid to stand up for Him, Jesus' love never wavered. He knew their hearts and still moved forward with His plan to save them, and to save us. God's love is not based on our perfect courage, but on His perfect grace.
en.reflection: Is there any area in my life where fear of what others think is keeping me from fully living for Jesus?

tl.understanding: Nangyari ito sa isang panahong napaka-tense. Habang dumarami ang sumasampalataya kay Jesus, lalo namang tumitindi ang galit ng mga religious leaders. Yung mga leader na nabanggit dito ay lihim na naniniwala kay Jesus, pero takot silang mawala ang kanilang posisyon at itakwil ng kanilang komunidad.
tl.livingItOut: Minsan, nagiging katulad din natin ang mga leader na ito—tahimik lang tungkol sa ating pananampalataya dahil takot tayo sa sasabihin ng iba. Humingi tayo sa Diyos ng lakas ng loob na hayagang isabuhay ang ating faith, at huwag hayaang pigilan tayo ng takot na parangalan Siya sa ating araw-araw.
tl.godsLove: Kahit na duwag ang mga leader na ito na manindigan para sa Kanya, hindi nagbago ang pag-ibig ni Jesus. Alam Niya ang nasa puso nila, pero tinuloy pa rin Niya ang Kanyang plano para iligtas sila, at para iligtas tayo. Ang pag-ibig ng Diyos ay hindi nakabase sa ating perpektong katapangan, kundi sa Kanyang walang-hanggang biyaya.
