But when the leaders revealed Jesus' claim to be the "Son of God," Pilate's plan backfired, and his political fear turned into a deeper, more personal terror.
en.livingItOut: Like Pilate, we can be tempted to make decisions based on the fear of what other people think. Let's ask God for the courage to stand for what is right, even when it's unpopular. Compromising with the world to find peace often leads to more fear and trouble, not less.
en.godsLove: Even when powerful men were trapped by fear, God's loving plan for our salvation was never at risk. Jesus faced this injustice with strength and purpose because His love for you is greater than any human plan or political pressure. God's will to save you cannot be stopped.
en.reflection: In what area of my life am I tempted to compromise what is right because of fear of what others might say or think?

tl.understanding: Sinubukan ni Pilato na humanap ng paraan para maiwasan ang gulo. Pinahagupit niya si Jesus sa pag-aakalang sapat na iyon para sa mga tao at mapapalaya na Niya Siya. Ngunit nang sabihin ng mga lider na si Jesus ay "Anak ng Diyos," lalo lang siyang natakot dahil nabigo ang kanyang plano.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ni Pilato, maaari tayong matuksong magdesisyon dahil sa takot sa sasabihin ng iba. Humingi tayo sa Diyos ng lakas ng loob na manindigan sa tama, kahit hindi ito gusto ng karamihan. Ang pakikipag-kompromiso sa mali para lang magkaroon ng kapayapaan ay madalas nagdudulot ng mas matinding takot.
tl.godsLove: Kahit na ang mga makapangyarihang tao ay binalot ng takot, hindi kailanman napigilan ang mapagmahal na plano ng Diyos para sa ating kaligtasan. Hinarap ni Jesus ang lahat ng ito dahil ang pag-ibig Niya para sa'yo ay mas dakila kaysa sa anumang takot o plano ng tao.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay ko ako natutuksong isuko ang tama dahil sa takot sa sasabihin o iisipin ng ibang tao?

en.understanding: This part of the story shows Pilate was trying to find a way out of a difficult situation. He had Jesus beaten, not as a final sentence, but hoping the crowd would feel it was enough punishment and let Jesus go free. It was his failed attempt to avoid the crucifixion everyone was demanding.
en.livingItOut: Pilate tried to compromise, hoping a lesser injustice would prevent a greater one. In our own lives, let's be careful not to make small compromises with sin, thinking it will solve a bigger problem. Instead, let's ask God for the courage to stand firmly for what is purely right, even when it's hard.
en.godsLove: Even in the middle of human politics and weak decision-making, God's greater plan of salvation was perfectly on track. Nothing, not even a powerful governor's failed plan, could stop Jesus from going to the cross to save us. This shows His unstoppable love and sovereign power working for our ultimate good.
en.reflection: Is there any area in my life where I am trying to make a "small" compromise, instead of fully trusting God and standing for what is right?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita sa parteng ito na si Pilato ay naghahanap ng paraan para makalusot sa mahirap na sitwasyon. Ipinahagupit niya si Jesus, hindi bilang pinal na hatol, kundi sa pag-asang makukuntento na ang mga tao at hahayaan na Siyang lumaya. Ito ay ang kanyang bigong pagtatangka na maiwasan ang pagpapako sa krus na hinihiling ng lahat.
tl.livingItOut: Sinubukan ni Pilato na makipag-kompromiso, sa pag-asang ang isang maliit na kamalian ay pipigil sa isang mas malaki. Sa ating buhay, maging maingat tayo sa paggawa ng maliliit na kompromiso sa kasalanan, sa pag-aakalang solusyon ito sa mas malaking problema. Sa halip, hingin natin sa Diyos ang lakas ng loob na manindigan para sa kung ano ang tunay na tama, kahit na ito ay mahirap.
tl.godsLove: Kahit sa gitna ng pulitika ng tao at mahinang pagpapasya, ang dakilang plano ng Diyos para sa ating kaligtasan ay perpektong nangyayari. Walang sinuman, kahit ang bigong plano ng isang makapangyarihang gobernador, ang makakapigil kay Jesus na tumuloy sa krus para iligtas tayo. Ipinapakita nito ang Kanyang hindi mapipigilang pag-ibig at kapangyarihan na kumikilos para sa ating kabutihan.
tl.reflection: Mayroon bang area sa buhay ko kung saan sinusubukan kong gumawa ng "maliit" na kompromiso, sa halip na lubos na magtiwala sa Diyos at manindigan para sa tama?

en.understanding: Pilate sounds powerful here, but he was actually in a tough spot. He had already tried to set Jesus free by having Him beaten, hoping it would satisfy the angry crowd. This verse shows Pilate's frustration as his plan to release Jesus was failing, and he was losing control.
en.livingItOut: Sometimes, people in authority or those with strong opinions will pressure us to compromise what is right. In these moments, we can remember Jesus' quiet strength and choose to stand firm in God's will. Our true security is in God's plan, not in pleasing people.
en.godsLove: God's love is powerfully seen in Jesus' silence. He wasn't a helpless victim; He was willingly heading to the cross to fulfill the Father's rescue plan for us. Even when faced with the world's power, His love for you was greater, and He never wavered from His mission to save you.
en.reflection: In what area of your life is God inviting you to trust His plan over the pressure and opinions of the world?

tl.understanding: Mukhang makapangyarihan si Pilato rito, pero sa totoo lang ay gipit na siya. Sinubukan na niyang palayain si Hesus sa pamamagitan ng pagpapahagupit, sa pag-asang makukuntento na ang galit na mga tao. Ipinapakita ng talatang ito ang pagkadismaya ni Pilato dahil bigo ang plano niyang pakawalan si Hesus.
tl.livingItOut: Minsan, may mga taong may kapangyarihan o malakas ang opinyon na pipilitin tayong talikuran ang tama. Sa mga panahong iyon, alalahanin natin ang tahimik na katatagan ni Hesus at piliing manindigan sa kalooban ng Diyos. Ang ating tunay na seguridad ay nasa plano ng Diyos, hindi sa pagbibigay-lugod sa tao.
tl.godsLove: Kitang-kita ang pag-ibig ng Diyos sa pananahimik ni Hesus. Hindi Siya isang kawawang biktima; kusa Siyang tumahak patungo sa krus para tuparin ang plano ng Ama na iligtas tayo. Kahit kaharap ang kapangyarihan ng mundo, mas dakila ang pag-ibig Niya para sa'yo at hindi Siya natinag sa misyong iligtas ka.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon ka inaanyayahan ng Diyos na magtiwala sa Kanyang plano sa halip na sa panggigipit at opinyon ng mundo?

en.understanding: Even when facing a powerful Roman governor, Jesus calmly points out that all authority, even Pilate's, ultimately comes from God. Jesus wasn't a helpless victim in this situation. He was showing that God's sovereign plan was unfolding perfectly, just as it was meant to.
en.livingItOut: When you face situations that feel unfair or people who seem to hold power over your life, remember this truth. Find peace in knowing that God is ultimately in control. Nothing and no one can touch you outside of His loving permission and perfect plan.
en.godsLove: God's love is so powerful that He sovereignly guided every step leading Jesus to the cross, even the unjust trial. Jesus willingly submitted to this plan because He knew it was the only way to rescue us. His submission to an unfair sentence was an act of ultimate love for you.
en.reflection: In what area of your life today do you need to trust that God is still in complete control, even when it doesn't look or feel like it?

tl.understanding: Kahit na kaharap ni Jesus si Pilato, isang makapangyarihang pinuno, kalmado Niyang ipinaalala na ang lahat ng kapangyarihan ay galing talaga sa Diyos. Hindi Siya isang kawawang biktima sa sitwasyong ito. Ipinapakita Niya na ang plano ng Diyos ay natutupad nang perpekto ayon sa Kanyang kalooban.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag nahaharap ka sa mga sitwasyong parang hindi patas o sa mga taong tila may kapangyarihan sa buhay mo, alalahanin mo ang katotohanang ito. Magkaroon ka ng kapayapaan sa pag-alam na ang Diyos pa rin ang may hawak ng lahat. Walang sinuman o anuman ang maaaring gumalaw sa'yo nang labas sa Kanyang mapagmahal na pahintulot at plano.
tl.godsLove: Napakalalim ng pag-ibig ng Diyos na hinayaan Niyang mangyari ang lahat, kahit ang kawalang-katarungan, para akayin si Jesus patungo sa krus. Kusang-loob na nagpasakop si Jesus sa planong ito dahil alam Niyang ito ang tanging paraan para iligtas tayo. Ang pagsunod Niya sa hindi makatarungang hatol ay tanda ng sukdulang pagmamahal Niya para sa'yo.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon kailangang ipaalala sa puso mo na ang Diyos ang may ganap na kontrol, kahit na parang hindi?

en.understanding: Pilate was under immense pressure. The title "friend of Caesar" was a special honor, and the Jewish leaders threatened to report him as a traitor if he freed Jesus. Pilate was already in a weak political position, so he was terrified of losing his job and his life.
en.livingItOut: Like Pilate, we sometimes know the right thing to do but are afraid of what others will think or say. Let's ask God for the courage to stand for what is right and to please Him rather than people. Our loyalty belongs to King Jesus first.
en.godsLove: Even in this moment of human weakness and fear, God's rescue plan was not stopped. Jesus willingly went to the cross, showing that His love for us is more powerful than any political pressure or human fear. His sacrifice was intentional and driven by His deep love for you.
en.reflection: In what area of my life am I more concerned with pleasing people than with obeying God?

tl.understanding: Grabe ang pressure na naramdaman ni Pilato. Ang titulong "kaibigan ni Cesar" ay isang malaking karangalan, at tinakot siya ng mga Judiong lider na isusumbong siya bilang traydor kapag pinalaya niya si Jesus. Dahil mahina na ang kanyang posisyon sa gobyerno, natakot siyang mawalan ng trabaho at ng buhay.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni Pilato, minsan alam natin ang tama pero natatakot tayo sa sasabihin ng iba. Humingi tayo sa Diyos ng lakas ng loob na manindigan para sa tama at piliing pasayahin Siya kaysa sa mga tao. Ang ating katapatan ay dapat laging una para kay Haring Hesus.
tl.godsLove: Kahit sa gitna ng kahinaan at takot ng tao, hindi napigilan ang plano ng Diyos para iligtas tayo. Handa si Jesus na akuin ang krus, na nagpapakitang ang pag-ibig Niya ay mas makapangyarihan kaysa sa anumang takot o pressure. Ang Kanyang sakripisyo ay sinadya at puno ng pagmamahal para sa'yo.
tl.reflection: Saang bahagi ng buhay ko ako mas nag-aalala sa sasabihin ng ibang tao kaysa sa pagsunod sa kalooban ng Diyos?

en.understanding: When Pilate sat on the "judgment seat," it was like a judge taking their official chair in a courtroom. This was not a casual conversation; it was the formal, legal moment to give the final verdict. By sitting there, Pilate was using all his official authority as the Roman governor.
en.livingItOut: Pilate sat on a throne of earthly power, but Jesus is the true King who has the ultimate authority. In our lives, let's not allow the opinions or pressures of the world to be the final judge of our worth. Let's give Jesus the final say by seating Him on the throne of our hearts and decisions.
en.godsLove: Notice the incredible humility and love of our Savior here. The true Judge of the universe stood silently before a temporary human judge, all for the sake of our salvation. He allowed Himself to be wrongly judged so that we could be declared "not guilty" before God forever.
en.reflection: Is there an area in your life where you've been letting the opinions of others be the "final judge" instead of God's loving Word?

tl.understanding: Nang umupo si Pilato sa "hukuman," para siyang isang judge na umupo sa kanyang opisyal na silya sa korte. Hindi ito isang simpleng usapan; ito na ang pormal at legal na sandali para ibigay ang pinal na hatol. Sa pag-upo niya roon, ginagamit niya ang lahat ng kanyang awtoridad bilang gobernador.
tl.livingItOut: Umupo si Pilato sa isang trono ng makamundong kapangyarihan, pero si Hesus ang tunay na Hari na may tunay na awtoridad. Sa ating buhay, huwag nating hayaang ang opinyon o pressure ng mundo ang maging huling humusga sa ating halaga. Ibigay natin kay Hesus ang huling salita sa pamamagitan ng pagluklok sa Kanya sa trono ng ating puso at mga desisyon.
tl.godsLove: Pansinin natin ang sobrang pagpapakumbaba at pag-ibig ng ating Tagapagligtas dito. Ang tunay na Hukom ng buong sanlibutan ay tahimik na tumayo sa harap ng isang pansamantalang hukom, lahat para sa ating kaligtasan. Hinayaan Niyang Siya ay mahusgahan nang mali upang tayo ay mapawalang-sala sa harap ng Diyos magpakailanman.
tl.reflection: Mayroon bang bahagi ng buhay mo kung saan mas pinapakinggan mo ang "hatol" ng ibang tao kaysa sa sinasabi ng mapagmahal na Salita ng Diyos?

en.understanding: The "Day of Preparation" mentioned here wasn't for the main Passover meal, which had already happened the night before. This was Friday, the day people got ready for the special Sabbath rest that was part of the whole week-long Passover festival. This small detail helps us understand the exact timing of Jesus' trial and crucifixion.
en.livingItOut: As the people prepared for a religious holiday, they were missing the King standing right in front of them. Let's be careful not to get so busy with our own plans, or even with church activities, that we forget to spend quality time with Jesus Himself. Our most important preparation is making room for Him in our hearts.
en.godsLove: While the world was busy with its preparations, God was preparing His greatest gift of love. He presented Jesus, our true King, as the perfect Lamb to be sacrificed for our sins. Even in this dark moment, God was making a way for us to be forgiven and welcomed into His family forever.
en.reflection: In the middle of my busy week, how can I intentionally pause and prepare my heart to welcome and listen to Jesus, my King?

tl.understanding: Ang “Araw ng Paghahanda” dito ay hindi para sa mismong Passover meal, dahil tapos na iyon noong gabi bago nito. Ito ay Biyernes, ang araw kung saan naghahanda ang mga tao para sa espesyal na Sabbath (araw ng pahinga) na bahagi ng isang linggong selebrasyon ng Passover.
tl.livingItOut: Habang abala ang mga tao sa paghahanda para sa isang religious holiday, hindi nila nakita ang kanilang Hari na nasa harap na pala nila. Maging maingat tayo na sa sobrang pagka-abala sa ating mga plano o kahit sa gawain sa church, ay hindi natin nakakalimutang maglaan ng oras para mismo kay Jesus.
tl.godsLove: Habang abala ang mundo sa mga paghahanda nito, inihahanda naman ng Diyos ang Kanyang pinakadakilang regalo ng pag-ibig. Ipinakita Niya si Jesus, ang ating tunay na Hari, bilang perpektong Kordero na isasakripisyo para sa atin. Kahit sa madilim na sandaling ito, gumagawa ang Diyos ng paraan para tayo ay mapatawad.
tl.reflection: Sa gitna ng aking abalang linggo, paano ako hihinto sandali para sadyang ihanda ang puso ko sa pagtanggap kay Jesus, ang aking Hari?

en.understanding: The chief priests' words were shocking because they went against everything Israel believed. For centuries, their identity was that God was their one true King. In rejecting Jesus, they were also rejecting God and tragically choosing a human ruler, Caesar, instead.
en.livingItOut: This verse challenges us to check our own hearts. It's easy to say Jesus is our King, but sometimes our choices show we are serving other "Caesars" like our job, money, or reputation. Let's make sure our daily decisions truly honor Jesus as the one and only Lord of our lives.
en.godsLove: Even in this moment of deep rejection, God's love is still present. Jesus stood there, hearing them choose a human ruler over Him, yet He went to the cross for them anyway. His love is so great that it extends even to those who completely turn their backs on Him.
en.reflection: Is there any area of my life where I am tempted to say, "I have no king but ________," instead of putting Jesus first?

tl.understanding: Nakakagulat ang sinabi ng mga punong pari dahil ito ay salungat sa kanilang pinaniniwalaan. Matagal nang kinikilala ng Israel na ang Diyos ang kanilang tunay at nag-iisang Hari. Sa pagtakwil nila kay Hesus, itinakwil na rin nila ang Diyos at mas pinili pa ang isang taong hari, si Cesar.
tl.livingItOut: Hinahamon tayo ng talatang ito na suriin ang ating mga puso. Madaling sabihin na si Hesus ang ating Hari, pero minsan, ipinapakita ng ating mga desisyon na mas pinaglilingkuran natin ang ibang "Cesar" tulad ng trabaho, pera, o reputasyon. Siguraduhin natin na sa araw-araw, si Hesus talaga ang tunay na Panginoon ng ating buhay.
tl.godsLove: Kahit sa gitna ng matinding pagtakwil na ito, naroon pa rin ang pag-ibig ng Diyos. Narinig ni Hesus na mas pinili nila ang isang tao kaysa sa Kanya, pero tinuloy pa rin Niya ang pagpunta sa krus para sa kanila. Ganyan kadakila ang pag-ibig ng Diyos na handa Siyang mamatay kahit para sa mga taong tumatalikod sa Kanya.
tl.reflection: Mayroon bang bahagi ng buhay ko kung saan natutukso akong sabihin na, "Wala akong ibang hari kundi ________," sa halip na si Hesus ang laging unahin?

en.understanding: This verse is more than just a simple handover. The soldiers brutally flogged Jesus for a second time, leaving Him severely wounded and close to death even before He reached the cross. He was in immense physical pain and shock as they led Him away to be crucified.
en.livingItOut: When we face unfair situations or deep pain, we can remember the suffering Jesus willingly endured for us. His strength can become our strength, helping us persevere through our own trials knowing we are not alone in our suffering.
en.godsLove: The incredible pain Jesus faced shows the depth of His love. He didn't have to go through this, but He chose to, bearing the punishment that we deserved. This is the ultimate picture of God's sacrificial love for you and me.
en.reflection: How does knowing the depth of Jesus' suffering for you change the way you see your own struggles today?

tl.understanding: Hindi lang ito basta pag-abot kay Jesus sa mga sundalo. Muli Siyang brutal na hinagupit, kaya sugatan at halos mamatay na Siya bago pa man makarating sa krus. Sobrang sakit ng katawan at pagkabigla ang dinanas Niya habang dinadala Siya palayo.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag nakakaranas tayo ng hindi patas na sitwasyon o matinding sakit, alalahanin natin ang paghihirap na kusang-loob na tiniis ni Jesus para sa atin. Ang Kanyang lakas ay maaaring maging lakas natin para malampasan ang mga pagsubok, dahil alam nating hindi tayo nag-iisa.
tl.godsLove: Ang matinding paghihirap na hinarap ni Jesus ay nagpapakita kung gaano kalalim ang pag-ibig Niya. Pinili Niyang pagdaanan ito, tiniis ang parusang para dapat sa atin. Ito ang sukdulang larawan ng mapagsakripisyong pagmamahal ng Diyos para sa iyo.
tl.reflection: Paano binabago ng pag-alam sa tindi ng paghihirap ni Jesus para sa'yo ang pagtingin mo sa mga problema mo ngayon?

en.understanding: Jesus was forced to carry the heavy crossbeam of His own cross through the public streets. This journey to a place called "Golgotha" was designed to be a walk of ultimate shame, a public warning for all to see. He was treated like the worst of criminals on His way to save us.
en.livingItOut: Jesus carried His cross in obedience to the Father. We can "carry our cross" by choosing to obey God, even when it's difficult or when our own desires pull us in another direction. It's a daily choice to surrender our will and follow Him.
en.godsLove: See the depth of God's love here: Jesus willingly carried the instrument of His death and endured public shame. He took our place and carried the weight of our sins, all because He loves you that much. His walk of shame became our path to grace.
en.reflection: As you picture Jesus carrying His cross for you, what is one area of your life that God is gently asking you to surrender to Him today?

tl.understanding: Pinasan ni Jesus ang mabigat na pahalang na bahagi ng Kanyang krus sa mga pampublikong daan. Ang paglalakbay na ito patungo sa lugar na tinawag na "Golgotha" ay sinadyang maging isang martsa ng kahihiyan, para makita at katakutan ng lahat. Itinuring Siyang pinakamasamang kriminal habang tinatahak ang daan para iligtas tayo.
tl.livingItOut: Pinasan ni Jesus ang Kanyang krus bilang pagsunod sa Ama. Sa ating buhay, maipapakita natin ang pagpasan ng ating krus sa pamamagitan ng pagsunod sa kalooban ng Diyos, lalo na kapag ito'y mahirap o salungat sa ating mga gusto. Ito ay araw-araw na desisyon na isuko ang sarili at sumunod sa Kanya.
tl.godsLove: Dito natin makikita ang lalim ng pag-ibig ng Diyos: kusang-loob na pinasan ni Jesus ang instrumento ng Kanyang kamatayan at tiniis ang matinding kahihiyan. Kinuha Niya ang ating lugar at dinala ang bigat ng ating kasalanan dahil sa sobrang pagmamahal Niya sa iyo. Ang Kanyang paglalakbay ng kahihiyan ang naging daan natin patungo sa biyaya.
tl.reflection: Habang ginugunita mo si Jesus na pasan ang Kanyang krus para sa iyo, anong isang bahagi ng buhay mo ang malumanay na hinihiling ng Diyos na isuko mo sa Kanya ngayon?

en.understanding: The Bible doesn't describe the horrors of the cross in detail because its first readers already knew how brutal it was. This wasn't just an execution; it was a slow, agonizing form of torture. Jesus endured this unimaginable pain after already being severely beaten.
en.livingItOut: When you face pain or hardship today, pause and remember the immense suffering Jesus willingly endured for you. Let the reality of His sacrifice put your own struggles into perspective and give you the strength to persevere. He understands your pain because He has experienced the very worst of it.
en.godsLove: This verse reveals the incredible depth of God's love for us. The cross wasn't an accident; it was a choice made out of love, to pay the price for our sins. See the horror of the cross not just as a historical event, but as the ultimate measure of how much you are valued and loved by God.
en.reflection: Knowing the depth of the physical pain Jesus chose to endure for you, how does it change the way you talk to Him in prayer today?

tl.understanding: Hindi na dinetalye ng Bibliya ang hirap sa krus dahil alam na ng mga tao noon kung gaano ito kalupit. Hindi lang ito basta pagpatay; ito ay isang mabagal at napakasakit na paraan ng pagpapahirap. Tiniis ni Hesus ang lahat ng ito matapos Siyang bugbugin nang husto.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag nakakaranas ka ng sakit o hirap, sandaling huminto at alalahanin ang matinding pagdurusa na kusang-loob na tiniis ni Hesus para sa iyo. Hayaan mong ang Kanyang sakripisyo ay magbigay ng bagong pananaw at lakas sa iyong mga pinagdadaanan. Naiintindihan Niya ang sakit mo dahil naranasan Niya ang pinakamatindi sa lahat.
tl.godsLove: Ipinapakita sa talatang ito ang sobrang lalim ng pag-ibig ng Diyos para sa atin. Ang krus ay hindi aksidente; ito ay isang desisyong ginawa dahil sa pagmamahal, para bayaran ang ating mga kasalanan. Tingnan mo ang hirap sa krus hindi bilang isang kwento lang, kundi bilang sukatan kung gaano ka kamahal at kahalaga sa Kanya.
tl.reflection: Ngayong mas nauunawaan mo ang tindi ng sakit na pinili ni Hesus na tiisin para sa iyo, paano nito binabago ang paraan ng pakikipag-usap mo sa Kanya sa panalangin ngayon?

en.understanding: Pilate put a sign on the cross declaring Jesus as "the King of the Jews," possibly to annoy the Jewish leaders. But God had a bigger plan! By writing it in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek—the languages of religion, government, and everyday life—Jesus' kingship was announced for the whole world to see.
en.livingItOut: This reminds us that the message of Jesus is for everyone, no matter their language or background. Let's be bold in sharing His story with the people in our lives, whether they're a co-worker, a neighbor, or a family member. God's good news breaks through all barriers.
en.godsLove: Even in Jesus' darkest moment, God's love was being declared for all to see. He made sure the truth of who Jesus is—our King—was written for every person to understand, not just one group. God's love has always been for the entire world.
en.reflection: Is there someone in my life who needs to "read the sign" about Jesus, and how can I lovingly share His story with them this week?

tl.understanding: Naglagay si Pilato ng karatula sa krus na nagsasabing si Jesus ang "Hari ng mga Judio," na posibleng pang-inis sa mga lider ng mga Judio. Pero may mas malaking plano ang Diyos! Sa pagsulat nito sa Hebrew, Latin, at Greek—mga wika para sa relihiyon, gobyerno, at pang-araw-araw na usapan—ipinahayag ang paghahari ni Jesus sa buong mundo.
tl.livingItOut: Pinapaalala nito sa atin na ang mensahe ni Jesus ay para sa lahat, anuman ang kanilang wika o pinagmulan. Huwag tayong matakot na ibahagi ang kwento Niya sa mga tao sa paligid natin, katrabaho man 'yan, kapitbahay, o kapamilya. Kayang lampasan ng Mabuting Balita ang anumang hadlang.
tl.godsLove: Kahit sa pinakamadilim na sandali ni Jesus, ang pag-ibig ng Diyos ay ipinapahayag pa rin para makita ng lahat. Siniguro Niyang ang katotohanan kung sino si Jesus—ang ating Hari—ay maisusulat para maintindihan ng bawat tao, hindi lang ng iisang grupo. Ang pag-ibig ng Diyos ay para talaga sa buong mundo.
tl.reflection: Sino sa buhay ko ang kailangang "makabasa ng karatula" tungkol kay Jesus, at paano ko maibabahagi nang may pagmamahal ang kwento Niya sa kanila ngayong linggo?

en.understanding: The Jewish leaders were angry that the sign on the cross declared Jesus as "The King of the Jews." They wanted it changed to say that Jesus only *claimed* to be their king. But Pilate, likely to annoy the leaders who pressured him, refused and let the sign publicly announce Jesus' true identity in three different languages for everyone to see.
en.livingItOut: Even when people misunderstand or try to twist the truth about our faith, God is in control. We can be confident in sharing who Jesus is, knowing that God's purpose will always prevail over the plans of men. Don't be afraid to stand for the truth, even if you stand alone.
en.godsLove: God's sovereign love is so powerful that it used an enemy's sign of mockery to declare the truth to the world. What was meant for shame, God turned into a royal proclamation for His Son. This shows us that no human plan can ever stop God's unstoppable plan to save us.
en.reflection: In what area of my life can I more boldly declare Jesus as my one true King this week?

tl.understanding: Nagalit ang mga pinunong Judio dahil sa nakasulat sa krus ni Hesus na "Ang Hari ng mga Judio." Gusto nilang palitan ito at ilagay na *sinabi lang* ni Hesus na Siya ang hari. Pero hindi pumayag si Pilato, kaya ang pagiging Hari ni Hesus ay hayagang naipahayag sa tatlong wika para makita ng lahat.
tl.livingItOut: Kahit na may mga taong hindi nauunawaan o binabaluktot ang katotohanan tungkol sa ating pananampalataya, ang Diyos pa rin ang may kontrol. Maging matatag tayo sa pagbabahagi kung sino si Hesus, dahil alam nating ang plano ng Diyos ang laging mananaig. Huwag matakot manindigan para sa katotohanan, kahit mag-isa ka pa.
tl.godsLove: Napakadakila ng pag-ibig ng Diyos na kahit ang tanda ng panunuya ng kaaway ay ginamit Niya para ipahayag ang katotohanan sa buong mundo. Ang dapat sana'y tanda ng kahihiyan, ginawa ng Diyos na proklamasyon ng paghahari ng Kanyang Anak. Ipinapakita nito na walang sinumang makakapigil sa plano ng Diyos para iligtas tayo.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay ko maipapahayag nang may katapangan na si Hesus ang aking tunay na Hari ngayong linggo?

en.understanding: Pilate's statement shows his stubborn refusal to change the sign on the cross. Though he may have meant it to mock the Jewish leaders, he ended up officially proclaiming Jesus as "the King of the Jews" in the major languages of the world for everyone to see.
en.livingItOut: This reminds us that God is sovereign, even over the actions of those who oppose Him. In our own lives, when people or circumstances seem against us, we can trust that God can turn it around to display His truth and glory. Let's look for His hand at work in every situation.
en.godsLove: Isn't it amazing how God's plan cannot be stopped by human schemes? His great love ensured that the truth of Jesus as our King was declared for all the world to see, right from the cross. God works through all things to make His loving message known.
en.reflection: Is there a difficult situation in your life right now where you need to trust that God can use it to declare His goodness?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita sa sinabi ni Pilato ang kanyang pagmamatigas na huwag baguhin ang karatula sa krus. Bagama't layunin niyang inisin ang mga lider ng mga Judio, sa huli ay opisyal niyang ipinahayag na si Hesus ang Hari sa mga pangunahing wika para makita ng lahat.
tl.livingItOut: Pinapaalala nito sa atin na ang Diyos ang may kontrol sa lahat, kahit pa sa ginagawa ng mga taong laban sa Kanya. Sa ating buhay, kapag tila may mga sitwasyon o taong kumokontra sa atin, magtiwala tayo na kayang-kaya pa ring gamitin ito ng Diyos para sa Kanyang mabuting layunin.
tl.godsLove: Kahanga-hanga na ang plano ng Diyos ay hindi kayang pigilan ng plano ng tao. Dahil sa Kanyang dakilang pag-ibig, siniguro Niyang maipapahayag sa buong mundo na si Hesus ang ating Hari, kahit pa sa krus. Laging may paraan ang Diyos para ipakilala ang Kanyang pagmamahal.
tl.reflection: Sa anong mahirap na sitwasyon sa buhay mo ngayon kailangan mong ipagkatiwala na kayang gamitin ito ng Diyos para ipakita ang Kanyang kabutihan?

en.understanding: As was the custom, the Roman soldiers divided Jesus' belongings among themselves. But His tunic was special—it was seamless and valuable, woven as a single piece. Instead of tearing it, they gambled to decide who would get to keep it whole.
en.livingItOut: This reminds us to hold our earthly possessions lightly, just as Jesus did. Let's challenge ourselves to value people and our relationship with God more than our material things. Our true treasure isn't what we own, but who we are in Christ.
en.godsLove: See the incredible love of Jesus here: He was stripped of everything, down to His very last garment, for our sake. He willingly endured complete humiliation and poverty to clothe us in His righteousness. This is how much you are worth to Him.
en.reflection: In what area of my life can I practice letting go of earthly things to cling more tightly to Jesus?

tl.understanding: Gaya ng kaugalian, pinaghatian ng mga sundalong Romano ang mga damit ni Jesus. Ngunit ang Kanyang tunika ay espesyal—walang tahi at mahalaga, kaya ayaw nilang punitin. Sa halip, nagsapalaran sila kung sino ang makakakuha nito nang buo.
tl.livingItOut: Paalala ito na huwag tayong masyadong kumapit sa mga bagay dito sa mundo. Hamunin natin ang ating sarili na mas pahalagahan ang tao at ang ating relasyon sa Diyos kaysa sa materyal na bagay. Ang tunay na yaman natin ay kung sino tayo kay Kristo.
tl.godsLove: Dito natin makikita ang tindi ng pag-ibig ni Jesus: hinubaran Siya ng lahat, hanggang sa huling saplot, para sa kapakanan natin. Tiniis Niya ang matinding kahihiyan at karukhaan para bihisan tayo ng Kanyang katuwiran. Ganyan ka kahalaga sa Kanya.
tl.reflection: Sa anong aspeto ng buhay ko ako pwedeng magsimulang bumitaw sa mga makamundong bagay para mas lalong kumapit kay Hesus?

en.understanding: The Roman soldiers followed their usual custom of dividing a prisoner's clothes among themselves. However, Jesus' robe was special and seamless, so instead of tearing it, they gambled for it. This small act by clueless soldiers was actually fulfilling a prophecy written hundreds of years before.
en.livingItOut: When life feels chaotic or when people's actions seem random and hurtful, we can trust that God is still in control. We can find peace by remembering that even in the smallest, most confusing details, God is working out His perfect plan.
en.godsLove: This verse shows God's incredible foreknowledge and sovereignty in the plan of salvation. Nothing about the cross was an accident; every single detail was part of His loving, intentional plan to save us. His love for you is not random, but a deliberate and perfect plan.
en.reflection: Is there a confusing or painful detail in your life right now where you need to trust that God is still lovingly in control?

tl.understanding: Gawain na ng mga sundalong Romano na paghatian ang damit ng isang bilanggo. Pero dahil espesyal at walang tahi ang damit ni Hesus, nag-cast lots sila (parang nag-raffle) para dito. Ang maliit na gawaing ito ng mga sundalo ay katuparan pala ng isang propesiya na isinulat matagal na.
tl.livingItOut: Kahit na magulo ang sitwasyon o tila walang kabuluhan at masakit ang gawa ng iba, makakapagtiwala tayo na kontrolado pa rin ng Diyos ang lahat. Makakahanap tayo ng kapayapaan kapag inaalala natin na sa bawat detalye, gaano man kaliit, kumikilos ang Diyos ayon sa Kanyang perpektong plano.
tl.godsLove: Ipinapakita nito ang kahanga-hangang kaalaman at kapangyarihan ng Diyos sa plano Niya ng kaligtasan. Walang aksidente sa krus; bawat detalye ay bahagi ng Kanyang sinadya at mapagmahal na plano para iligtas tayo. Ang pag-ibig Niya para sa'yo ay hindi tsamba, kundi isang perpektong plano.
tl.reflection: Mayroon bang isang magulo o masakit na detalye sa buhay mo ngayon kung saan kailangan mong magtiwala na ang Diyos pa rin ang may hawak ng lahat nang may pagmamahal?

en.understanding: This verse shows the small group of loyal women who stayed with Jesus in His darkest hour. It’s likely that some of these women were His close relatives, like His aunt, which would make the disciple John His cousin. This deep family bond and friendship was present even at the cross.
en.livingItOut: Like these brave women, we are called to stand by our loved ones during their difficult times. Let's not run away from their pain, but choose to be a steady, loving presence for those who are hurting around us. Simply being there can be the most powerful ministry.
en.godsLove: In this painful moment, we see God's tender care in providing a small, faithful community for Jesus. It shows that even in our deepest suffering, God never leaves us completely alone. He often sends people to be His loving presence with us.
en.reflection: Who in your life is going through a difficult time and needs you to simply be present with them this week?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita sa talatang ito ang grupo ng matatapat na babae na nanatili sa tabi ni Jesus sa pinakamadilim na oras Niya. Posible na ang ilan sa kanila ay malapit Niyang kamag-anak, kaya naman napakalalim ng kanilang ugnayan at samahan kahit sa paanan ng krus.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ng matapang na mga babaeng ito, tinatawag din tayong manatili sa tabi ng ating mga mahal sa buhay sa oras ng kanilang paghihirap. Huwag tayong tumakbo palayo sa sakit; piliin nating maging isang mapagmahal na presensya para sa mga nasasaktan.
tl.godsLove: Sa gitna ng matinding sakit, makikita natin ang magiliw na pag-aalaga ng Diyos na nagbigay ng isang maliit na komunidad para kay Jesus. Pinapaalala nito na kahit sa pinakamatinding pagsubok, hindi Niya tayo iniiwang mag-isa; madalas, nagpapadala Siya ng mga tao para iparamdam ang Kanyang pagmamahal.
tl.reflection: Sino sa mga kakilala mo ang dumadaan sa mahirap na sitwasyon ngayon na kailangan lang ng iyong presensya at pakikiramay ngayong linggo?

en.understanding: Even while suffering on the cross, Jesus was thinking of His mother's future care. He entrusted her to John, the disciple He loved, who may have been His own cousin. When He called her “Woman,” it was a term of deep respect and endearment in their culture, not a cold or distant word.
en.livingItOut: This verse challenges us to show practical love and care for our family, especially our parents. Even when we are facing our own difficulties, let's not forget our responsibility to honor and support them in tangible ways.
en.godsLove: Isn't it amazing that in His moment of greatest agony, Jesus' heart was filled with love and concern for His mother? This shows us a God who deeply values family and relationships. His love is not just for the whole world; it's also personal, thoughtful, and incredibly tender.
en.reflection: Is there a specific, practical way you can show love and honor to a family member, especially a parent, this week?

tl.understanding: Kahit na nagdurusa sa krus, iniisip pa rin ni Hesus ang kapakanan ng Kanyang ina. Ipinagkatiwala Niya si Maria kay Juan, ang disipulong mahal Niya, na posibleng pinsan pala Niya. Ang pagtawag Niyang "Babae" ay isang paraan ng pagpapakita ng malaking paggalang sa kanilang kultura noon.
tl.livingItOut: Hinahamon tayo ng talatang ito na magpakita ng praktikal na pagmamahal at pag-aalaga sa ating pamilya, lalo na sa ating mga magulang. Kahit may sarili tayong pinagdadaanan, huwag nating kalimutan ang ating responsibilidad na mahalin at suportahan sila sa mga konkretong paraan.
tl.godsLove: Nakakamangha na sa gitna ng matinding sakit, ang puso ni Hesus ay puno pa rin ng pagmamahal at pag-aalala para sa Kanyang ina. Pinapakita nito na mayroon tayong Diyos na lubos na nagpapahalaga sa pamilya at relasyon. Ang pag-ibig Niya ay hindi lang para sa buong mundo; ito ay personal, maalalahanin, at napakalambing.
tl.reflection: Sa anong partikular at praktikal na paraan mo maipapakita ang pagmamahal at paggalang sa isang kapamilya, lalo na sa iyong magulang, sa linggong ito?

en.understanding: On the cross, Jesus was doing more than just making sure His mother, Mary, would be cared for. He was also showing us that His followers are now a new spiritual family. This small group at the cross was like the very first picture of the church, created to love and support each other.
en.livingItOut: Let's be the kind of family Jesus wants us to be in our own church or small group. Look around for someone who might be lonely or in need, and ask God how you can be a source of practical care and support for them. We are called to be family to one another.
en.godsLove: Even in His deepest suffering on the cross, Jesus’ heart was filled with love and care for others. His love is so personal that He made sure His mother was looked after. This same love creates a spiritual family for us, so we never have to feel alone.
en.reflection: Who in your spiritual family (your church or small group) might God be asking you to "take into your home" with your love and care this week?

tl.understanding: Habang nasa krus, hindi lang basta inaalala ni Jesus ang Kanyang inang si Maria. Ipinapakita Niya rin sa atin na ang Kanyang mga tagasunod ay isa nang bagong pamilya sa espiritu. Sila sa paanan ng krus ang unang larawan ng church, na nilikha para magmahalan at magtulungan.
tl.livingItOut: Maging pamilya tayo sa ating church o small group, tulad ng gusto ni Jesus. Tumingin tayo sa ating paligid at hanapin kung sino ang nangangailangan o nalulungkot, at maging praktikal na tulong at suporta sa kanila. Tinawag tayo para maging pamilya sa isa't isa.
tl.godsLove: Kahit sa gitna ng matinding paghihirap sa krus, ang puso ni Jesus ay puno pa rin ng pagmamahal para sa iba. Tiniyak Niyang may mag-aalaga sa Kanyang ina, at ang pag-ibig ding ito ang lumikha ng spiritual family para sa atin, upang hindi tayo kailanman mag-isa.
tl.reflection: Sino sa iyong spiritual family (sa church o small group) ang nais ng Diyos na 'patuluyin mo sa iyong tahanan' sa pamamagitan ng iyong pagmamahal at pag-aaruga ngayong linggo?

en.understanding: The hyssop branch mentioned here is a powerful symbol from the Old Testament. During the first Passover, hyssop was used to apply the blood of a lamb to the doorposts to save God's people from death. This small detail shows us that Jesus is the ultimate Passover Lamb, whose blood truly saves us all.
en.livingItOut: When you feel the weight of your past mistakes, remember the hyssop branch and the Lamb it points to. You don't have to carry that guilt, because Jesus' sacrifice has already paid for it completely. Live freely and gratefully today, knowing you are fully forgiven.
en.godsLove: God’s love is woven into every detail of His rescue plan for you. Even in this dark moment on the cross, He included a small reminder of His promise from long ago. His plan to save you was not a last-minute idea, but His loving intention from the very beginning.
en.reflection: How does knowing Jesus is your Passover Lamb change the way you look at your failures and your future?

tl.understanding: Ang sanga ng hisopo na binanggit dito ay may malalim na kahulugan mula sa Lumang Tipan. Noong unang Paskuwa, ginamit ang hisopo para ipahid ang dugo ng kordero sa mga pinto para iligtas ang mga tao ng Diyos sa kamatayan. Ipinapakita ng maliit na detalyeng ito na si Hesus ang tunay na Korderong Pampaskuwa, na ang dugo ay tunay na nagliligtas sa ating lahat.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag nabibigatan ka sa iyong mga pagkakamali, alalahanin mo ang sanga ng hisopo at ang Korderong tinutukoy nito. Hindi mo na kailangang pasanin ang bigat ng kasalanan, dahil bayad na ito ng sakripisyo ni Hesus. Mamuhay ka nang malaya at may pasasalamat ngayon, dahil alam mong lubos ka nang pinatawad.
tl.godsLove: Ang pag-ibig ng Diyos ay makikita sa bawat detalye ng Kanyang plano para iligtas ka. Kahit sa madilim na sandaling iyon sa krus, isinama Niya ang isang maliit na paalala ng Kanyang matagal nang pangako. Ang Kanyang plano na sagipin ka ay hindi biglaan lang, kundi Kanyang mapagmahal na layunin mula pa sa simula.

en.understanding: When Jesus said, "It is finished," it was a shout of victory, not defeat. He wasn't a helpless victim on the cross; He was an obedient servant who had successfully completed the mission God gave Him to save us. His work was now complete.
en.livingItOut: Jesus' example encourages us to be faithful in the tasks God has given us, big or small. Let's aim to finish well what we start, serving Him obediently in our daily lives, just as He did. Your faithfulness in the small things honors Him greatly.
en.godsLove: This is the ultimate expression of God's love for you. Jesus didn't just *try* to save us; He *finished* the job completely, paying the full price for our sins so we could be with Him forever. His love for us never gives up.
en.reflection: In what specific area of your life is God inviting you to faithfully serve and "finish well" this week, trusting in His strength?

tl.understanding: Noong sinabi ni Jesus, "Naganap na," isa itong sigaw ng tagumpay at hindi ng pagkatalo. Hindi Siya isang kaawa-awang biktima, kundi isang masunuring lingkod na matagumpay na tinapos ang misyon na ibinigay ng Diyos para iligtas tayo.
tl.livingItOut: Ang halimbawa ni Jesus ay naghihikayat sa atin na maging tapat sa mga gawaing ipinagkakatiwala Niya, malaki man o maliit. Sikapin nating tapusin nang maayos ang ating mga sinimulan, naglilingkod sa Kanya sa ating pang-araw-araw na buhay, tulad ng ginawa Niya.
tl.godsLove: Ito ang pinakadakilang patunay ng pag-ibig ng Diyos para sa iyo. Hindi lang sinubukan ni Jesus na iligtas tayo; tinapos Niya nang buo ang gawain at binayaran ang lahat ng ating kasalanan para makasama natin Siya magpakailanman. Ang pag-ibig Niya ay hindi sumusuko.
tl.reflection: Sa anong partikular na bahagi ng buhay mo ka inaanyayahan ng Diyos na maglingkod nang tapat at "tapusin ito nang maayos" ngayong linggo, habang nagtitiwala sa Kanyang lakas?

en.understanding: The Jewish leaders wanted to follow the Sabbath rules, so they asked for the crucifixion to be sped up. Breaking a person's legs was a cruel but common way to do this. It made it impossible for the victim to push themselves up on the cross to take a breath, causing them to die much faster.
en.livingItOut: This verse is a powerful reminder to check our hearts. Are we more focused on following religious rules and looking "good" on the outside, or are we truly focused on loving God and people? Let's choose a real relationship with Jesus over empty traditions.
en.godsLove: Even in this moment of planned cruelty, we see the depth of God's love. Jesus willingly endured this entire horrific process, facing the possibility of even more pain, all for our salvation. His love for us was greater than any suffering He had to face.
en.reflection: In what area of your life can you shift your focus from simply "doing the right things" to truly connecting with Jesus' heart?

tl.understanding: Nais ng mga lider ng Judio na masunod ang batas tungkol sa Araw ng Pamamahinga, kaya hiniling nila na pabilisin ang kamatayan sa krus. Isang malupit ngunit karaniwang paraan para gawin ito ay ang baliin ang mga binti, dahil hindi na nila mai-aangat ang sarili para makahinga.
tl.livingItOut: Ito ay paalala na suriin natin ang ating mga puso. Mas nakatuon ba tayo sa mga tradisyon at sa pagiging "mukhang tama" sa paningin ng iba, o sa tunay na pagmamahal sa Diyos at sa kapwa? Piliin natin ang relasyon kay Hesus kaysa sa relihiyon na walang laman.
tl.godsLove: Kahit sa gitna ng matinding kalupitan, nakikita natin ang lalim ng pag-ibig ng Diyos. Buong-pusong tiniis ni Hesus ang kakila-kilabot na prosesong ito para sa ating kaligtasan. Ang pagmamahal Niya sa atin ay mas dakila kaysa sa anumang pagdurusang Kanyang hinarap.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo maaaring baguhin ang iyong pokus mula sa "paggawa lang ng tama" patungo sa tunay na pakikipag-ugnayan sa puso ni Hesus?

en.understanding: Breaking the legs of a crucified person was a harsh way to make them die faster. This was done because the Jewish leaders wanted the crucifixions finished before the Sabbath began. Without being able to push up with their legs, the victims would quickly suffocate and die.
en.livingItOut: This brutal detail reminds us that Jesus wasn't alone in His physical suffering on the cross. We can practice compassion today by remembering the suffering of others around us, not just focusing on our own problems. Let's ask God to give us a heart that sees and cares for the pain of our neighbors.
en.godsLove: Even in this dark and cruel moment, we can see God's sovereign hand at work. His plan of salvation was unfolding with perfect precision, even down to the smallest actions. This shows a God who is in control of all things, working out His loving purpose for us through the cross.
en.reflection: In what difficult or painful detail of your life do you need to trust that God is still working out His loving and perfect plan?

tl.understanding: Ang pagbali sa mga binti ng isang nakapako sa krus ay isang malupit na paraan para mapabilis ang kanilang pagkamatay. Ginawa ito dahil gusto ng mga lider ng mga Judio na matapos na ang pagpapako bago magsimula ang araw ng Sabbath. Kapag hindi na nila maitukod ang kanilang mga binti, mabilis silang hindi makahinga at mamamatay.
tl.livingItOut: Pinapaalala nito sa atin na hindi nag-iisa si Hesus sa Kanyang pisikal na paghihirap sa krus. Pagsikapan nating magpakita ng habag sa iba sa pamamagitan ng pag-alala sa kanilang mga pinagdadaanan, hindi lang sa sarili nating problema. Hilingin natin sa Diyos ang isang pusong nakakakita at nagmamalasakit sa sakit na nararamdaman ng ating kapwa.
tl.godsLove: Kahit sa madilim at malupit na detalyeng ito, makikita natin ang kamay ng Diyos na kumikilos. Ang Kanyang plano ng kaligtasan ay natutupad nang may perpektong katumpakan. Ipinapakita nito na ang Diyos natin ay may kontrol sa lahat ng bagay, at isinasakatuparan Niya ang Kanyang mapagmahal na layunin para sa atin sa pamamagitan ng krus.
tl.reflection: Sa anong mahirap o masakit na detalye ng buhay mo ngayon kailangan mong magtiwala na ang Diyos ay kumikilos pa rin ayon sa Kanyang mapagmahal at perpektong plano?

en.understanding: To speed up death, soldiers would often break the legs of those being crucified so they could no longer push up to breathe. But when they came to Jesus, they saw He was already gone, so they left His legs unbroken. This small detail is actually incredibly significant.
en.livingItOut: This reminds us that God is in control of every single detail, even the ones that seem small or random. When your life feels chaotic or a situation seems hopeless, remember that God is still working His perfect purpose behind the scenes. We can rest in His sovereignty.
en.godsLove: God's love is shown in His perfect plan. Hundreds of years before, a prophecy said the Messiah's bones would not be broken, just like the Passover lamb (Exodus 12:46). This proves Jesus was the promised Savior, and His death was not a tragic accident but a deliberate act of love to save us.
en.reflection: In what area of your life do you need to trust that God is in control of the details, even when you can't see the full picture yet?

tl.understanding: Para mapabilis ang kamatayan, karaniwang binabali ng mga sundalo ang mga binti ng mga nakapako sa krus para hindi na sila makahinga. Pero pagdating nila kay Hesus, nakita nilang pumanaw na Siya, kaya hindi na nila binali ang Kanyang mga binti. Ang maliit na detalyeng ito ay may napakalaking kahulugan.
tl.livingItOut: Ipinapaalala nito na kontrolado ng Diyos ang bawat detalye, kahit ang mga mukhang maliit o nagkataon lang. Kapag tila magulo ang buhay mo o parang wala nang pag-asa, alalahanin mong kumikilos pa rin ang Diyos para sa Kanyang perpektong layunin. Pwede tayong magpahinga sa Kanyang kapangyarihan.
tl.godsLove: Makikita ang pag-ibig ng Diyos sa Kanyang perpektong plano. Daan-daang taon bago ito, sinabi sa propesiya na hindi mababali ang mga buto ng Mesiyas, tulad ng kordero sa Passover (Exodus 12:46). Patunay ito na si Hesus ang ating Tagapagligtas, at ang Kanyang kamatayan ay hindi aksidente kundi isang kusang-loob na gawa ng pag-ibig para iligtas tayo.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon kailangan mong mas magtiwala na kontrolado ng Diyos ang bawat detalye, kahit hindi mo pa nakikita ang kabuuan ng Kanyang plano?

en.understanding: When the soldier pierced Jesus' side, it proved He was truly dead. But the blood and water that flowed out were also a beautiful picture. The blood reminds us of the Passover lamb sacrificed for our forgiveness, and the water points to the spiritual cleansing and new life He offers.
en.livingItOut: Let's carry the memory of this sacrifice in our hearts every day. When you feel weak or tempted, remember the price Jesus paid. This incredible love can empower you to live a life that honors Him.
en.godsLove: In this dark moment, God's love was poured out for all to see. The blood speaks of His complete forgiveness, while the water speaks of a fresh start and a clean heart. He held nothing back, giving His very life so we could be brought close to Him.
en.reflection: How does knowing the depth of Jesus' sacrifice—His very blood and water—personally change the way you want to talk to Him in prayer today?

tl.understanding: Nang saksakin ng sundalo ang tagiliran ni Hesus, pinatunayan nito na Siya ay talagang pumanaw na. Ngunit ang lumabas na dugo at tubig ay isa ring magandang larawan. Ang dugo ay nagpapaalala sa Korderong inialay para sa ating kapatawaran, at ang tubig ay sumisimbolo sa kalinisan at bagong buhay na alok Niya.
tl.livingItOut: Araw-araw nating baunin sa ating puso ang alaala ng sakripisyong ito. Kapag nakakaramdam ka ng panghihina o tukso, alalahanin mo ang halaga ng ibinayad ni Hesus. Ang Kanyang dakilang pag-ibig ay magbibigay sa'yo ng lakas para mamuhay sa paraang nagpaparangal sa Kanya.
tl.godsLove: Sa madilim na sandaling ito, ang pag-ibig ng Diyos ay ibinuhos para makita ng lahat. Ang dugo ay para sa Kanyang ganap na kapatawaran, at ang tubig ay para sa panibagong simula at malinis na puso. Ibinigay Niya ang lahat-lahat, ang Kanyang sariling buhay, upang tayo ay mapalapit sa Kanya.
tl.reflection: Paano personal na binabago ng pag-alam sa lalim ng sakripisyo ni Hesus—ang Kanyang mismong dugo at tubig—ang paraan ng iyong pananalangin sa Kanya ngayong araw?

en.understanding: John, who wrote this book, is telling us he was physically present at the cross. He wasn't just repeating stories he heard from others; he was an eyewitness to everything that happened. He emphasizes that his account is true so that we can have complete confidence in our faith.
en.livingItOut: Because we can trust the Gospel story, we can stand firm in what we believe. Let this truth give you the confidence to share your own story of how Jesus has worked in your life, just as John shared what he saw.
en.godsLove: God lovingly made sure that the most important event in history—the death of His Son—was recorded by someone who was actually there. He didn't want our faith to be based on rumors, but on a trustworthy and true testimony. He truly cares about helping us believe.
en.reflection: How does knowing that the story of Jesus is based on a real eyewitness account encourage you to trust Him more deeply today?

tl.understanding: Sinasabi ni Apostol John, ang sumulat ng aklat na ito, na nandoon talaga siya mismo sa paanan ng krus. Hindi lang siya nag-uulit ng mga kwentong narinig niya; siya ay isang "eyewitness" sa lahat ng nangyari. Ipinagdiinan niyang totoo ang kanyang patotoo para maging buo ang ating tiwala at pananampalataya.
tl.livingItOut: Dahil mapagkakatiwalaan natin ang kwento ng Ebanghelyo, maaari tayong manindigan nang may kapanatagan sa ating pinaniniwalaan. Hayaan mong bigyan ka nito ng lakas ng loob na ibahagi rin ang sarili mong kwento kung paano kumilos si Hesus sa buhay mo, tulad ng ginawa ni John.
tl.godsLove: Dahil sa pag-ibig ng Diyos, siniguro Niya na ang pinakamahalagang pangyayari sa kasaysayan—ang pagkamatay ng Kanyang Anak—ay maitala ng isang taong nandoon mismo. Ayaw Niyang ang pananampalataya natin ay nakabase sa tsismis, kundi sa isang tunay at mapagkakatiwalaang patotoo.
tl.reflection: Paano nakakatulong sa'yo na mas magtiwala kay Hesus ngayong alam mo na ang Kanyang kwento ay isinulat ng isang tunay na saksi o eyewitness?

en.understanding: This verse shows how Jesus is the perfect fulfillment of an Old Testament picture. The Passover lamb, which saved God's people in Egypt, was not allowed to have any broken bones. In the same way, Jesus, our ultimate Passover Lamb, perfectly fulfilled this requirement on the cross.
en.livingItOut: Since Jesus was the perfect and complete sacrifice for us, we can stop trying to earn God's favor through our own efforts. Today, let's live with confidence and rest in the finished work of Jesus, knowing He has already done everything needed for our salvation.
en.godsLove: Isn't it amazing how God planned every single detail of our salvation, even down to this one? It shows that His love for us is not an accident but a careful, perfect plan that was in His heart from the very beginning.
en.reflection: How does knowing that Jesus is the perfect, complete sacrifice change the way you face your worries or weaknesses today?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita sa talatang ito kung paano tinupad ni Hesus ang isang larawan mula sa Old Testament. Ang Korderong Pampaskwa (Passover lamb), na nagligtas sa bayan ng Diyos sa Ehipto, ay hindi dapat magkaroon ng anumang bali sa buto. Sa parehong paraan, si Hesus, ang ating tunay na Korderong Pampaskwa, ay perpektong tumupad nito sa krus.
tl.livingItOut: Dahil si Hesus ang perpekto at kumpletong sakripisyo para sa atin, hindi na natin kailangang magsumikap para maging katanggap-tanggap sa Diyos. Ngayong araw, mamuhay tayo nang may kapanatagan at magpahinga sa natapos na gawa ni Hesus, dahil alam nating ginawa na Niya ang lahat para sa ating kaligtasan.
tl.godsLove: Nakakamangha isipin na plinano ng Diyos ang bawat detalye ng ating kaligtasan, kahit ang pinakamaliit na bagay na tulad nito. Ipinapakita nito na ang pag-ibig Niya sa atin ay hindi aksidente, kundi isang maingat at perpektong plano na nasa puso Niya mula pa sa simula.
tl.reflection: Paano binabago ng kaalamang si Hesus ang perpekto at kumpletong sakripisyo ang paraan ng pagharap mo sa iyong mga alalahanin o kahinaan ngayon?

en.understanding: This verse is a quote from the Old Testament prophet Zechariah. It prophesied that people would one day look at the Messiah they had rejected and feel deep sorrow for not believing in Him. John is showing us that Jesus' crucifixion fulfilled this ancient promise.
en.livingItOut: Let's take time today to 'look' at what Jesus did on the cross for us. When we remember that our sins are what pierced Him, it should lead us to a life of gratitude and a stronger desire to turn away from sin.
en.godsLove: God's love is so incredible that He allowed His own Son to be pierced to pay for our sins. Even in His deepest pain, Jesus was thinking of our salvation, making a way for us to be forgiven and come back to Him.
en.reflection: When you 'look' at Jesus on the cross today, what is one specific thing you want to thank Him for?

tl.understanding: Ang talatang ito ay sipi mula sa Lumang Tipan, sa propeta na si Zacarias. Ito ay isang hula na balang araw, titingin ang mga tao sa Mesiyas na kanilang tinanggihan at lubos na malulungkot dahil sa hindi nila pananampalataya sa Kanya. Pinapakita ni Juan na natupad kay Hesus ang hulang ito.
tl.livingItOut: Maglaan tayo ng oras na ‘tumingin’ sa ginawa ni Hesus sa krus para sa atin. Kapag naaalala natin na ang ating mga kasalanan ang dahilan ng Kanyang sugat, akayin nawa tayo nito sa isang buhay na puno ng pasasalamat at pagnanais na talikuran ang kasalanan.
tl.godsLove: Napakadakila ng pag-ibig ng Diyos dahil hinayaan Niyang masugatan ang Kanyang sariling Anak para bayaran ang ating mga kasalanan. Kahit sa gitna ng matinding sakit, ang ating kaligtasan pa rin ang nasa isip ni Hesus, para tayo'y mapatawad at makabalik sa Diyos.
tl.reflection: Habang ‘tinitingnan’ mo si Hesus sa krus ngayon, ano ang isang partikular na bagay na gusto mong ipagpasalamat sa Kanya?

en.understanding: Joseph of Arimathea was a rich and respected leader who secretly followed Jesus because he was afraid of what others would think. Even though he was fearful, his love for Jesus pushed him to do something incredibly brave. This act of asking for Jesus's body was his way of finally and publicly showing his faith.
en.livingItOut: Like Joseph, we sometimes hide our faith because we worry about being judged or rejected. This verse encourages us to let our love for Jesus be stronger than our fear. Let's find one small, brave way this week to be more open about our faith, even if it feels a little scary.
en.godsLove: Notice how God provided for Jesus even in His death, making sure His body was cared for with honor. He used a man who was once afraid to accomplish His beautiful purpose. This shows that God's love can work through anyone, giving us the courage we need right when we need it most.
en.reflection: In what area of your life is God inviting you to move from secret faith to courageous love for Him?

tl.understanding: Si Jose ng Arimatea ay isang mayaman at respetadong lider na lihim na alagad ni Jesus dahil takot siya sa sasabihin ng ibang tao. Kahit may takot, ang pagmamahal niya kay Jesus ang nag-udyok sa kanya na gumawa ng isang napakatapang na bagay. Ang hakbang na ito ang naging paraan niya para ipahayag sa publiko ang kanyang pananampalataya.
tl.livingItOut: Tulad ni Jose, minsan ay itinatago rin natin ang ating pananampalataya dahil sa takot sa sasabihin ng iba. Hinihikayat tayo ng talatang ito na hayaang mas manaig ang pag-ibig natin kay Jesus kaysa sa ating takot. Humanap tayo ng isang maliit na paraan ngayong linggo para maging bukas tungkol sa ating pananampalataya, kahit na medyo nakakakaba.
tl.godsLove: Tingnan natin kung paano kumilos ang Diyos para kay Jesus kahit sa Kanyang kamatayan, tinitiyak na ang Kanyang katawan ay mabigyan ng dangal at pagmamahal. Ginamit Niya ang isang taong dating takot para maisakatuparan ang Kanyang layunin. Pinapakita nito na kayang kumilos ng pag-ibig ng Diyos sa kahit kanino, at binibigyan Niya tayo ng lakas ng loob sa tamang panahon.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng iyong buhay ka tinatawag ng Diyos na lumabas mula sa lihim na pananampalataya patungo sa isang matapang na pagmamahal para sa Kanya?

en.understanding: Nicodemus, the religious leader who first came to Jesus secretly at night, now steps out into the light. He brought an enormous amount of expensive spices—about 75 pounds—to prepare Jesus' body. This wasn't just a standard burial; it was a generous, costly act fit for honoring a king.
en.livingItOut: Like Nicodemus, our faith can grow from private to public. Don't be afraid to let your love for Jesus be seen through generous actions. Let's honor Him openly, not just with our words, but with the very best of our time, effort, and resources.
en.godsLove: Even in the sorrow of His death, God ensured His Son was treated with the honor of a king. He moved the heart of Nicodemus to publicly show this extravagant love. This reminds us that God is always working to reveal the supreme worth and glory of our Savior, Jesus.
en.reflection: In what small way can you be more open and generous in honoring Jesus this week?

tl.understanding: Si Nicodemo, ang lider ng relihiyon na unang lumapit kay Hesus nang palihim sa gabi, ay hayagan nang kumilos. Nagdala siya ng napakaraming mamahaling pabango—mga 75 pounds—para ihanda ang katawan ni Hesus. Hindi lang ito ordinaryong paglilibing; ito ay isang bukas-palad na gawaing nararapat para sa isang hari.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ni Nicodemo, ang ating pananampalataya ay pwedeng lumago mula sa pagiging pribado patungo sa pagiging hayag. Huwag tayong matakot na ipakita ang pagmamahal natin kay Hesus sa pamamagitan ng ating mga gawa. Parangalan natin Siya nang hayagan, hindi lang sa salita kundi sa pagbibigay ng pinakamagaling sa ating oras, gawa, at yaman.
tl.godsLove: Kahit sa gitna ng pighati ng Kanyang kamatayan, siniguro ng Diyos na si Hesus ay mabigyan ng parangal na para sa isang hari. Kanyang ginalaw ang puso ni Nicodemo para hayagang ipakita ang ganitong klase ng pagmamahal. Pinapaalala nito na laging kumikilos ang Diyos para ipakita ang tunay na halaga at kaluwalhatian ng ating Tagapagligtas.
tl.reflection: Sa anong maliit na paraan ka pwedeng maging mas hayagan at bukas-palad sa pagpaparangal kay Hesus ngayong linggo?

en.understanding: Because the Sabbath (the Jewish holy day of rest) was about to begin at sundown, they were in a hurry to bury Jesus. This was a temporary burial done quickly out of necessity. Joseph and Nicodemus planned to come back later to complete the proper burial customs.
en.livingItOut: In our busy lives, we often feel rushed and that our efforts are incomplete or not good enough. This verse reminds us that even in our hurried moments, God is still working His perfect plan. We can trust Him with our unfinished tasks and imperfect situations, knowing He is in control.
en.godsLove: God’s love is so profound that it works even in moments of haste and sorrow. What looked like a rushed, temporary end for Jesus was actually just a pause before the greatest victory in history. His plan to save us was never rushed; it was perfectly unfolding, just as He promised.
en.reflection: In what area of your life do you feel rushed or incomplete, and how can you trust God’s perfect timing in that situation today?

tl.understanding: Nagmamadali silang ilibing si Hesus dahil malapit nang magsimula ang Sabbath, isang banal na araw ng pamamahinga kung saan bawal magtrabaho. Kaya, pansamantala lang muna Siyang inilagay sa libingan na iyon. Ang plano nila ay bumalik para tapusin nang maayos ang paglilibing.
tl.livingItOut: Sa ating mga abalang araw, madalas pakiramdam natin ay nagmamadali tayo at parang laging may kulang sa ating mga ginagawa. Paalala ito na kahit sa mga panahong tila nagkukulang tayo, kumikilos pa rin ang Diyos ayon sa Kanyang perpektong plano. Pwede tayong magtiwala sa Kanya kahit hindi perpekto ang ating sitwasyon.
tl.godsLove: Pinapakita nito na ang pag-ibig ng Diyos ay kumikilos kahit sa gitna ng kalungkutan at pagmamadali. Ang tila minadaling paglilibing kay Hesus ay isa lang palang paghinto bago ang Kanyang dakilang tagumpay sa muling pagkabuhay. Ang Kanyang plano ng kaligtasan para sa atin ay hindi kailanman minadali, ito ay laging perpekto.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ka nakakaramdam ng pagmamadali o pagkukulang, at paano mo maaalalahanan ang iyong sarili na magtiwala sa perpektong plano ng Diyos sa mga sandaling iyon?

en.understanding: Mary Magdalene was a very devoted follower of Jesus. She went to the tomb while it was still dark, not expecting a miracle, but simply to perform a final act of love and service for Him. Her intention was to complete the traditional burial customs out of respect and devotion.
en.livingItOut: Like Mary, let's show our love for Jesus through faithful action, even when things feel dark or difficult. Our devotion isn't just for the good times; it's about showing up to serve Him no matter what. A simple act of service done in love is powerful in God's eyes.
en.godsLove: God sees every act of love we do for Him, no matter how small or hidden in the dark. While Mary was going to serve a dead Savior, God was preparing to reveal a living one to her. His love meets us in our sorrow with the greatest hope imaginable.
en.reflection: In what simple way can you show your faithful love for Jesus this week, especially if you're facing a difficult situation?

tl.understanding: Si Maria Magdalena ay isang tapat na tagasunod ni Jesus. Pumunta siya sa libingan habang madilim pa, hindi para umasa ng himala, kundi para gawin ang isang huling pagpapakita ng pagmamahal at paglilingkod para sa Kanya. Ang layunin niya ay tapusin ang mga nararapat na gawain para sa Kanyang libing.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ni Maria, ipakita natin ang pagmamahal natin kay Jesus sa pamamagitan ng tapat na pagkilos, kahit pa sa mga panahong tila madilim o mahirap. Ang ating debosyon ay hindi lang para sa masasayang araw; ito ay tungkol sa pagpapakita at paglilingkod sa Kanya anuman ang sitwasyon.
tl.godsLove: Nakikita ng Diyos ang bawat gawa ng pag-ibig natin para sa Kanya, gaano man ito kaliit o ginawa sa gitna ng kadiliman. Habang si Maria ay papunta para maglingkod sa isang namatay na Tagapagligtas, naghahanda naman ang Diyos na ipakilala sa kanya ang isang buhay na Kristo. Sinasalubong tayo ng Kanyang pag-ibig sa gitna ng ating lungkot dala ang pinakadakilang pag-asa.
tl.reflection: Sa anong simpleng paraan mo maipapakita ang iyong tapat na pagmamahal kay Jesus sa linggong ito, lalo na kung may pinagdadaanan kang pagsubok?

en.understanding: When Mary Magdalene found the empty tomb, she didn't think of the resurrection right away. Her first thought was that grave robbers had stolen Jesus' body, which was a common crime back then. Her panicked reaction was based on what seemed logical and possible in her world.
en.livingItOut: When we face confusing or scary situations, our minds can also jump to the worst conclusion. Instead of letting fear take over, let's make our first response a prayer. We can ask God for His perspective before we assume the worst.
en.godsLove: God is so patient with our human fears and limited understanding. He didn't get angry with Mary for her wrong assumption; instead, He was about to meet her in her distress and reveal the most wonderful news. This shows us that God's love meets us in our confusion to lead us to His truth.
en.reflection: In what area of your life do you need to stop assuming the worst and instead ask God to show you His perspective?

tl.understanding: Nang makita ni Maria Magdalena na walang laman ang libingan, hindi niya agad naisip ang muling pagkabuhay. Ang una niyang inakala ay ninakaw ang katawan ni Jesus, dahil karaniwang krimen iyon noong panahon nila. Ang kanyang pagpa-panic ay base sa kung ano lang ang lohikal at posible para sa kanya.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag tayo ay nahaharap sa nakakalito o nakakatakot na sitwasyon, madalas ang isip natin ay napupunta agad sa pinakamasamang posibleng mangyari. Sa halip na magpadala sa takot, gawin nating panalangin ang ating unang reaksyon. Pwede nating itanong sa Diyos ang Kanyang pananaw bago tayo mag-isip ng masama.
tl.godsLove: Napakapasensyoso ng Diyos sa ating mga takot at limitadong pang-unawa. Hindi Siya nagalit kay Maria sa maling akala nito; sa halip, sasalubungin Niya ito sa gitna ng kanyang pag-aalala para ibigay ang pinakamagandang balita. Pinapakita nito na ang pag-ibig ng Diyos ay sinasalubong tayo sa ating pagkalito para akayin tayo sa Kanyang katotohanan.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon kailangan mong tigilan ang pag-iisip ng masama at sa halip ay hilingin sa Diyos na ipakita sa'yo ang Kanyang pananaw?

en.understanding: This verse shows two of Jesus' closest friends, Peter and the disciple John, literally running to the tomb. After hearing Mary's surprising news, they didn't just wonder about it; they went to investigate the evidence for themselves. Their actions show a sense of urgency and a deep desire to confirm what they had just heard.
en.livingItOut: Like Peter and John, let's not just be passive hearers of God's truth. When you hear a powerful testimony or sermon, let it stir you to run to God's Word and seek Jesus for yourself. Let's be people who actively investigate the claims of our faith with eager hearts.
en.godsLove: God's love is so kind that He doesn't demand blind faith without any proof. He provided an empty tomb as powerful evidence and invited His followers to come and see for themselves. He lovingly provides reasons for our hope and welcomes our honest search for Him.
en.reflection: What news about Jesus today would make you "run" to learn more and experience it personally?

tl.understanding: Ipinapakita dito ang dalawa sa pinakamalapit na kaibigan ni Jesus, sina Pedro at Juan, na literal na tumakbo papunta sa libingan. Matapos marinig ang balita ni Maria, hindi lang sila nag-isip-isip; sinadya nilang tingnan mismo ang ebidensya. Ang kanilang pagmamadali ay nagpapakita ng matinding pagnanais na malaman ang katotohanan.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya nina Pedro at Juan, huwag lang tayong basta tagapakinig ng Salita ng Diyos. Kapag may narinig kang magandang testimony o mensahe, hayaan mo itong mag-udyok sa'yo na tumakbo sa Biblia at hanapin si Jesus para sa iyong sarili. Maging mga taong aktibong naghahanap ng katotohanan nang may pananabik sa puso.
tl.godsLove: Napakabuti ng pag-ibig ng Diyos dahil hindi Niya hinihiling na maniwala tayo nang pikit-mata. Naglaan Siya ng isang libingang walang laman bilang matibay na ebidensya at inanyayahan ang Kanyang mga alagad na tingnan ito. Ma-pagmahal Niyang binibigyan tayo ng dahilan para umasa at malugod Niyang tinatanggap ang ating tapat na paghahanap sa Kanya.
tl.reflection: Anong balita tungkol kay Jesus ngayon ang mag-uudyok sa'yo na "tumakbo" para mas makilala Siya at maranasan Siya nang personal?

en.understanding: The "other disciple" is believed to be John, the very person who wrote this book! He and Peter weren't just taking Mary's word for it; they were running with great urgency to see for themselves if Jesus' tomb was really empty.
en.livingItOut: Like John and Peter, let's not be passive in our faith. When we hear of God's promises or a prompting from the Holy Spirit, let's eagerly "run" towards Him in prayer and in His Word to discover the truth for ourselves.
en.godsLove: God delights in our desire to seek Him. He didn't see a competition between John and Peter, but two beloved friends desperately running toward a glimmer of hope. God’s heart is moved when we pursue Him eagerly because we love Him.
en.reflection: In what area of your life is God inviting you to "run" towards Him with fresh eagerness and hope today?

tl.understanding: Ang "isang alagad" ay pinaniniwalaang si Juan, ang mismong sumulat ng aklat na ito! Silang dalawa ni Pedro ay hindi lang basta naniwala sa sinabi ni Maria; nagmamadali silang tumakbo para personal na makita kung totoo ngang wala na si Jesus sa libingan.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya nina Juan at Pedro, huwag tayong manatili lang sa pakikinig tungkol sa Diyos. Kapag may narinig tayong pangako Niya o may sinasabi ang Banal na Espiritu, sabik tayong "tumakbo" palapit sa Kanya sa panalangin at sa Salita Niya para alamin ang katotohanan para sa ating sarili.
tl.godsLove: Natutuwa ang Diyos kapag nakikita Niyang sabik natin Siyang hinahanap. Hindi Niya ito nakita bilang isang karera, kundi bilang dalawang minamahal na kaibigan na tumatakbo dahil sa pag-asa. Naaantig ang puso ng Diyos kapag hinahabol natin Siya dahil mahal natin Siya.
tl.reflection: Sa anong bahagi ng buhay mo ngayon ka inaanyayahan ng Diyos na "tumakbo" palapit sa Kanya nang may pananabik at pag-asa?

en.understanding: This verse describes John, the disciple Jesus loved, arriving first at the empty tomb. He and Peter were racing to see for themselves if what Mary Magdalene had told them was true. Even though John got there first, he paused at the entrance out of respect or maybe even awe.
en.livingItOut: When we hear something amazing about God, let's be like John and Peter and eagerly investigate it for ourselves. Don't just rely on what others say is true. Open your Bible, pray, and let God confirm His truth directly in your heart.
en.godsLove: God's love is so patient and kind; He gives us space to process the incredible news of the resurrection. He doesn't rush us, but invites us to "come and see" the evidence of His victory over death. The empty tomb is an open invitation for our questions to turn into solid faith.
en.reflection: When you encounter an amazing promise from God's Word, what is your first step to personally "look in" and understand it for yourself?

tl.understanding: Inilalarawan dito si Juan, ang disipulong minamahal ni Jesus, na unang nakarating sa libingang walang laman. Nag-unahan sila ni Pedro para makita kung totoo nga ba ang sinabi ni Maria Magdalena. Kahit nauna si Juan, huminto muna siya sa labas, marahil dahil sa paggalang o pagkamangha.
tl.livingItOut: Kapag may narinig tayong magandang balita tungkol sa Diyos, tularan natin sina Juan at Pedro na sabik itong alamin para sa kanilang sarili. Huwag lang tayo umasa sa sabi-sabi; buksan mo mismo ang iyong Bibliya, manalangin, at hayaang ang Diyos ang magpatunay ng Kanyang katotohanan sa puso mo.
tl.godsLove: Napakapasensyoso ng pag-ibig ng Diyos; binibigyan Niya tayo ng pagkakataong i-proseso ang napakagandang balita ng Kanyang muling pagkabuhay. Hindi Niya tayo minamadali, sa halip ay inaanyayahan Niya tayong "lumapit at tingnan" ang katibayan ng Kanyang tagumpay. Ang libingang walang laman ay isang imbitasyon para ang ating mga tanong ay maging matibay na pananampalataya.
tl.reflection: Kapag nakabasa ka ng isang pangako mula sa Salita ng Diyos, ano ang unang hakbang mo para personal itong "silipin" at unawain para sa iyong sarili?

en.understanding: When Mary told them the tomb was empty, Peter and John ran to see for themselves. Even though John was faster, it was the bold and impulsive Peter who didn't hesitate to go right inside. This was their first step in confirming the incredible news.
en.livingItOut: Like Peter, let's not just stand on the sidelines of our faith. When we have questions or hear a promise from God's Word, let's be eager to step in and investigate it for ourselves through prayer and reading the Bible. Don't be afraid to take that next step to seek Him.
en.godsLove: God is so patient with our process of believing. He didn't scold the disciples for needing to see the evidence with their own eyes. Instead, He lovingly provided an empty tomb for them to explore, gently guiding their hearts toward the truth of the resurrection.
en.reflection: What is one step of faith, big or small, that you can take this week to "enter the tomb" and see God's truth more clearly for yourself?

tl.understanding: Nang ibalita ni Maria na walang laman ang libingan, tumakbo sina Pedro at Juan para sila mismo ang tumingin. Kahit naunang dumating si Juan, ang matapang na si Pedro ang hindi nag-atubiling pumasok agad sa loob. Ito ang unang hakbang nila para patunayan ang magandang balita.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ni Pedro, huwag lang tayong manatili sa labas pagdating sa ating faith. Kapag may tanong tayo o may narinig na pangako mula sa Salita ng Diyos, maging sabik tayong pumasok at alamin ito para sa ating sarili sa pamamagitan ng panalangin at pagbabasa ng Bibliya.
tl.godsLove: Napakamaunawain ng Diyos sa proseso ng ating pananampalataya. Hindi Niya pinagalitan ang mga disipulo dahil kailangan pa nilang makita ang ebidensya. Sa halip, buong pagmamahal Niyang ipinakita ang libingang walang laman para akayin ang kanilang mga puso patungo sa katotohanan.
tl.reflection: Ano ang isang hakbang ng pananampalataya, maliit man o malaki, na gagawin mo ngayong linggo para mas malinaw na makita ang katotohanan ng Diyos para sa iyo?

en.understanding: When Peter and John heard the tomb was empty, they ran to check for themselves. They didn't find a chaotic, messy crime scene. The neatly folded headcloth was a quiet but powerful clue that Jesus wasn't stolen but had risen with calm authority.
en.livingItOut: Like the disciples, let's not just rely on what others say about God. Let's run to His Word ourselves and look for the evidence of His work in our own lives. Pay attention to the small, "folded cloth" details where God shows He is present and in control.
en.godsLove: God's love is intentional and peaceful, not rushed or chaotic. Even in the most powerful moment in history, Jesus left a sign of deliberate care. This shows us His love for us is in every detail, assuring us that His plan is orderly and good.
en.reflection: What small, "folded cloth" moment in your life has recently reminded you that God is present and in control?

tl.understanding: Nang marinig nina Pedro at Juan na walang laman ang libingan, tumakbo sila para sila mismo ang tumingin. Hindi isang magulong libingan ang nakita nila. Ang maayos na pagkatupi ng tela ay isang tahimik pero malakas na palatandaan na si Jesus ay hindi ninakaw, kundi muling nabuhay nang may kapayapaan at kapangyarihan.
tl.livingItOut: Gaya ng mga disipulo, huwag lang tayong umasa sa kwento ng iba tungkol sa Diyos. Tayo mismo ang tumakbo sa Kanyang Salita at hanapin ang mga katibayan ng Kanyang pagkilos sa ating buhay. Pansinin natin ang mga maliliit na "nakatuping tela" na nagpapakitang kasama natin Siya at Siya ang may kontrol.
tl.godsLove: Ang pag-ibig ng Diyos ay sadya at mapayapa, hindi nagmamadali o magulo. Kahit sa pinakamakapangyarihang sandali sa kasaysayan, nag-iwan si Jesus ng tanda ng maingat na kaayusan. Pinapakita nito na ang pagmamahal Niya ay nasa bawat detalye, na nagbibigay-katiyakan na ang Kanyang plano ay maayos at mabuti.
tl.reflection: Anong maliit na "nakatuping tela" moment sa buhay mo ang nagpaalala sa'yo kamakailan na kasama mo ang Diyos at Siya ang may kontrol sa lahat?

en.understanding: The "other disciple" mentioned here is John, the very person who wrote this Gospel and a close friend of Jesus. He and Peter raced to the tomb to see for themselves after hearing Mary’s news. When John saw the empty tomb with his own eyes, his heart was filled with faith—he believed!
en.livingItOut: Like John, we are invited to investigate Jesus for ourselves, not just rely on what others tell us. Let's open our Bibles and seek a personal encounter with the risen Lord. Our faith becomes strongest when it moves from being a story we hear to an experience we have.
en.godsLove: God’s love is so personal that He doesn't just give us facts; He invites us to see the evidence for ourselves. He wants our faith to be built on a real relationship with Him, not just second-hand information. He patiently waits for us to come, see, and believe in His great love and victory.
en.reflection: What is one step you can take this week to personally "run to the tomb" and see the truth of Jesus for yourself?
